<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta http-equiv="X-UA-Compatible" content="IE=edge">
<meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=utf-8">
<title>Spaceship Command</title>

<!-- ============================================================
   HTA APPLICATION SETTINGS
   Declares this as a standalone desktop window, not a browser
   page. contextmenu="no" kills the native IE right-click menu
   so right-click can be used as the game's primary input verb.
   ============================================================ -->
<hta:application
  id="SpaceshipCommand"
  applicationname="Spaceship Command"
  border="thin"
  borderstyle="normal"
  caption="yes"
  contextmenu="no"
  innerborder="no"
  maximizebutton="yes"
  minimizebutton="yes"
  navigable="no"
  scroll="no"
  scrollflat="yes"
  selection="no"
  showintaskbar="yes"
  singleinstance="yes"
  sysmenu="yes"
  version="1.0"
  windowstate="normal">

<style type="text/css">

/* ============================================================
  SECTION 1 : BASE / RESET
  Palette is hardcoded hex throughout. CSS custom properties
  are NOT supported by Trident, so no var() anywhere.
   white      #ffffff panel    #faf7f2
   panel2 #f4efe6 panel3 #efe8dc
   border #e4dbcb borderdark #cbb89c
   coffee #8c6f4e coffeedark #6b5338
   coffeelite #b89b76 text       #3b3630
   muted       #8a7f72 terracotta #b05a42
   sage      #7f9161 amber       #c08a3e
  ============================================================ */

/* UNIVERSAL BORDER-BOX. Padding and borders are drawn INSIDE a
  declared width, which is the single rule that makes a fluid
  layout safe here: width:100% plus padding can no longer burst
  its parent, and percentage columns add up to exactly 100.
  Every fixed pixel size in this file is therefore an OUTER size. */
* { margin:0; padding:0;
   box-sizing:border-box;
   -moz-box-sizing:border-box;
   -webkit-box-sizing:border-box; }

html, body {
  width:100%; height:100%;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:#ffffff;
  color:#3b3630;
  font-family:"Segoe UI", Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
  font-size:12px;
  cursor:default;
}

.num {
   font-family:Consolas, "Lucida Console", "Courier New", monospace;
}

/* ============================================================
  SECTION 2 : WINDOW FRAME
  Absolute positioning is used instead of flexbox. Trident's
  flex support is unreliable; top/left/right/bottom anchoring
  is rock solid all the way back to IE8 standards mode.

 THE FLUID RULE OF THIS FILE:
 the side panel keeps a fixed width, and #content pins itself to
 left:166px AND right:0. That pair IS calc(100% - 166px), without
 needing calc or flexbox - the content area simply grows and
 shrinks with the window in both directions.
 ============================================================ */

#taskbar {
   position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:104px; height:35px;
   background:#f4efe6;
   border-bottom:1px solid #cbb89c;
   overflow:hidden;
   white-space:nowrap;
}

/* Keep tab overflow accessible without hiding the permanent home control. */
#taskbar-controls {
   position:absolute; top:0; right:0; width:104px; height:35px;
   padding:5px 3px; background:#f4efe6; border-bottom:1px solid #cbb89c;
   white-space:nowrap;
}
#taskbar-controls button {
   width:22px; height:24px; margin-left:2px; padding:0; cursor:pointer;
   border:1px solid #cbb89c; background:#faf7f2; color:#6b5338; font-size:11px;
}
#taskbar-controls #tab-home { width:48px; }
#taskbar-controls button:hover { background:#efe8dc; }

/* 30% narrower than the original 236px. The panel is a glance
  strip now, not a reading column: the three roster blocks fold
  away and only open when the player wants them. */
#sidepanel {
   position:absolute; top:36px; left:0; bottom:119px; width:165px;
   background:#faf7f2;
   border-right:1px solid #e4dbcb;
   overflow-y:auto;
   overflow-x:hidden;
}
/* Pinned. The ship functions and the build marker must not drift
  up and down as the blocks above them fold open and shut, and
  must not scroll away either - so they live outside the
  scrolling panel, anchored to the bottom of the window. */
#sidefoot {
   position:absolute; left:0; bottom:23px; width:165px; height:96px;
   background:#faf7f2;
   border-right:1px solid #e4dbcb;
   border-top:1px solid #e4dbcb;
   overflow:hidden;
}

#content {
  position:absolute; top:36px; left:166px; right:0; bottom:23px;
  background:#ffffff;
  overflow:auto;
}

.st-last { color:#5c5145; }
#statusbar {
   position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; height:22px;
   background:#f4efe6;
   border-top:1px solid #e4dbcb;
   color:#8a7f72;
   font-size:11px;
   line-height:22px;
   padding:0 10px;
   overflow:hidden;
}

/* ============================================================
  SECTION 3 : TASKBAR TABS
  ============================================================ */

.tab {
   display:inline-block;
   height:26px;
   line-height:25px;
   margin:6px 2px 0 0;
   padding:0 10px 0 12px;
   background:#efe8dc;
   border:1px solid #e4dbcb;
   border-bottom:none;
   color:#6b6157;
   font-size:12px;
   cursor:pointer;
   vertical-align:top;
   max-width:210px;
   overflow:hidden;
}
.tab:hover { background:#f7f2e9; color:#3b3630; }
.tab-active { background:#ffffff; border-color:#cbb89c; color:#3b3630; font-weight:bold;
height:29px; line-height:27px; margin-top:6px; }
.tab-home      { border-left:3px solid #8c6f4e; }
.tab-kind     { color:#a2947f; font-weight:normal; padding-right:5px; }
.tab-close {
   display:inline-block; width:14px; height:14px; line-height:13px;
   text-align:center; margin-left:8px; color:#a2947f;
   font-size:13px; font-weight:normal;
}
.tab-close:hover { background:#e3d3c0; color:#b05a42; }
/* reserved: unread / changed marker on a tab (Phase: event engine) */
.tab-mark {
   display:inline-block; width:6px; height:6px; margin-left:7px;
   background:#7f9161; vertical-align:middle;
}

/* ============================================================
  SECTION 4 : SIDE PANEL
  ============================================================ */

.sp-block { border-bottom:1px solid #e4dbcb; padding:9px 10px 10px 10px; }
.sp-title {
   font-size:10px; letter-spacing:1px; text-transform:uppercase;
   color:#8c6f4e; font-weight:bold; margin-bottom:8px;
}

/* --- folding blocks ---------------------------------------- */
/* A header the player can click. Closed by default: the roster
  is reference material, not something to stare at all watch. */
.sp-drop {
   font-size:10px; letter-spacing:1px; text-transform:uppercase;
   color:#8c6f4e; font-weight:bold;
   cursor:pointer; overflow:hidden; padding:1px 0;
}
.sp-drop:hover { color:#6b5338; }
.sp-drop-open { margin-bottom:7px; }
/* CSS triangle, no image and no font glyph: right when closed,
  down when open */
.sp-caret {
   float:right; width:0; height:0; margin:4px 1px 0 0;
   border-top:4px solid transparent; border-bottom:4px solid transparent;
   border-left:5px solid #a2947f;
}
.sp-caret-open {
   margin:5px 0 0 0;
   border-left:4px solid transparent; border-right:4px solid transparent;
   border-top:5px solid #8c6f4e; border-bottom:none;
}
.sp-row      { padding:2px 0; overflow:hidden; }
.sp-hr      { height:0; border-top:1px solid #ece5d8; margin:6px 0 5px 0; }
.sp-long     { padding:3px 0 4px 0; }
.sp-longk { color:#8c6f4e; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.4px; }
.sp-longv { color:#6b6157; font-size:10px; line-height:14px;
          padding-top:1px; }
.sp-key    { float:left; color:#6b6157; }
.sp-val    { float:right; color:#3b3630; }
.sp-val-dim { float:right; color:#8a7f72; }

.sp-ship   { font-size:14px; font-weight:bold; color:#3b3630; margin-bottom:2px; }
.sp-sub    { color:#8a7f72; font-size:11px; line-height:15px; }

/* --- cryptic indicators : deliberately unlabelled ----------
  Standing lines that fill from the BOTTOM UP, one per process
  the ship has running. No symbols, no captions, no numbers -
  the player learns to read the shape of the group.

 GREEN SHRINKS - work the player committed to. The line drains
        as the process nears completion, so an empty
        slot means something is ready to collect.
 RED GROWS       - something building on its own. A climbing red
        line is the only warning the ship gives.

  Half the size of the old horizontal tracks, and they no longer
  take a row each: the whole set is one strip. */
.ind-strip {
   position:relative; height:104px; overflow:hidden;
}
.ind-line {
   position:absolute; bottom:0; width:3px;
   background:#7f9161;
}
.ind-grow { background:#b05a42; }
/* the unused remainder of a line, so the eye can see how far a
  process still has to travel */
.ind-ghost {
   position:absolute; top:0; width:3px; background:#ece5d8;
}
.ind-none { color:#b3a794; font-size:10px; line-height:104px; }

/* --- ship functions : symbols, pinned bottom left ----------
  Every symbol is built out of plain divs. No image files (the
  .hta must stay a single file) and no font glyphs (a Trident
  host may not have one and would render a box). */
/* --- the events drop-down ------------------------------- */
.sp-evt {
   padding:4px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #f0e9dd; overflow:hidden;
}
.sp-evt-kind { float:left; color:#5c5145; font-size:11px; line-height:19px; }
.sp-evt-btn {
   float:right; padding:1px 8px; font-size:10px; cursor:pointer;
   background:#f4efe6; border:1px solid #cbb89c; color:#6b5338;
}
.sp-evt-btn:hover { background:#e9dcc6; border-color:#8c6f4e; }
.sp-dim { color:#b3a794; font-size:11px; }
.sp-icons { text-align:center; padding:8px 0 0 0; font-size:0; }
.sp-ico {
   display:inline-block; position:relative;
   width:26px; height:26px; margin:0 3px;
   background:#f4efe6; border:1px solid #e4dbcb;
   cursor:pointer; vertical-align:top;
}
.sp-ico:hover { background:#ffffff; border-color:#8c6f4e; }
.ico-part { position:absolute; background:#6b5338; }

/* ship hull : a wide shallow trapezoid drawn with borders, mast
   and sail above it. Wide and flat, or it reads as an arrowhead. */
.ico-hull {
    left:3px; top:15px; width:12px; height:0; background:none;
    border-left:4px solid transparent;
 border-right:4px solid transparent;
    border-top:6px solid #6b5338;
}
.ico-mast { left:12px; top:5px; width:2px; height:10px; }
.ico-sail { left:14px; top:6px; width:6px; height:6px; background:#a2947f; }

/* log : a short stack of rules */
.ico-line1 { left:6px; top:8px; width:14px; height:2px; }
.ico-line2 { left:6px; top:12px; width:14px; height:2px; }
.ico-line3 { left:6px; top:16px; width:9px; height:2px; }

/* disk : body, shutter, label - save and load are one door.
   The shutter sits off-centre and the label is short, or the two
   cut-outs meet in the middle and the icon reads as a letter H. */
.ico-disk { left:5px; top:5px; width:16px; height:16px; }
.ico-shut { left:13px; top:6px; width:4px; height:5px; background:#faf7f2; }
/* the label is PRINTED on the disk, not cut out of it - a
   background-coloured block here reads as the letter H */
.ico-lab { left:8px; top:14px; width:10px; height:7px; background:#c9b79a; }

/* cog : a ring with four teeth */
.ico-ring {
   left:7px; top:7px; width:12px; height:12px; background:none;
   border:3px solid #6b5338;
   -moz-border-radius:9px; -webkit-border-radius:9px; border-radius:9px;
}
.ico-t1 { left:11px; top:3px; width:4px; height:4px; }
.ico-t2 { left:11px; top:19px; width:4px; height:4px; }
.ico-t3 { left:3px; top:11px; width:4px; height:4px; }
.ico-t4 { left:19px; top:11px; width:4px; height:4px; }

.sp-build {
   text-align:center; color:#b3a794; font-size:10px;
   padding:6px 6px 0 6px; line-height:13px;
}

/* ============================================================
 SECTION 5 : IDLE SCREEN (the free screen - costs nothing)
 ============================================================ */

#screen-idle { padding:16px 18px 30px 18px; }

/* FLUID. The rail spans the whole content area; each cell is told
  its share as a percentage by the builder, so adding a fifth
  gauge later needs no CSS change at all. The gutter is padding
  rather than margin so it lives inside the percentage. */
.rail     { width:100%; margin:0 0 12px 0; overflow:hidden; }
.rail-cell { float:left; padding-right:8px; }
.rail-last { padding-right:0; }

.stat {
   background:#faf7f2; border:1px solid #e4dbcb;
   padding:7px 10px 8px 10px; width:100%;
}
.stat:hover { border-color:#cbb89c; background:#f7f2e9; }
.stat-label { font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.7px; text-transform:uppercase; color:#8a7f72; }
.stat-value { font-size:17px; color:#3b3630; padding:1px 0 4px 0; }
.stat-unit { font-size:11px; color:#8a7f72; }

.bar { height:6px; background:#efe8dc; border:1px solid #e4dbcb; overflow:hidden; }
.bar-in { height:6px; }

.info {
   background:#faf7f2; border:1px solid #e4dbcb;
   padding:7px 10px 8px 10px; width:100%; min-height:48px;
}
.info:hover { border-color:#cbb89c; background:#f7f2e9; }
.info-label { font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.7px; text-transform:uppercase; color:#8a7f72; }
.info-value { font-size:13px; color:#3b3630; padding-top:3px; }

/* --- the ship diagram -------------------------------------- */
/* CENTRE STAGE - DELIBERATELY NOT FLUID. The hull is a scale
  drawing, not a table: every room coordinate in ROOMS is
  measured against this 836 x 344 stage, so it keeps its exact
  size and is centred in whatever space the window gives it.
  This is the house rule for every middle-of-screen graphic in
  the project; see STAGE in the script. Everything around it
  moves, the drawing itself does not. */
#stage {
   position:relative; width:1160px; height:460px;
   margin:0 auto; background:#ffffff;
   border:1px solid #e4dbcb;
}
/* --- the silhouette : one rule per hull part, all drawn from
  the HULL table in stage coordinates --------------------- */
.hpart { position:absolute; background:#fdfbf7;
        border:2px solid #8c6f4e; }
.hp-body { -moz-border-radius:0 60px 60px 0; -webkit-border-radius:0 60px 60px 0;
        border-radius:0 60px 60px 0; }
.hp-spine{ background:#faf7f2;
        -moz-border-radius:14px 14px 0 0; -webkit-border-radius:14px 14px 0 0;
        border-radius:14px 14px 0 0; }
.hp-pod { background:#faf7f2;
        -moz-border-radius:0 0 14px 14px; -webkit-border-radius:0 0 14px 14px;
        border-radius:0 0 14px 14px; }
.hp-lens { background:#fdfbf7;
        -moz-border-radius:50%; -webkit-border-radius:50%; border-radius:50%; }
.hp-nacelle { background:#efe8dc;
        -moz-border-radius:15px; -webkit-border-radius:15px; border-radius:15px; }
.hp-pylon{ background:#e4dbcb; border:2px solid #8c6f4e; }
.nac-bar { position:absolute; background:#cbb89c; }
.conduit { position:absolute; background:#f7f2e9;
        border-top:1px dashed #ddd2bf; border-bottom:1px dashed #ddd2bf; }
.nozzle {
   position:absolute; left:-15px; width:15px; height:38px;
   background:#efe8dc; border:2px solid #8c6f4e; border-right:none;
}
.room {
   position:absolute;
   border:1px solid #cbb89c;
   overflow:hidden;
}
.room:hover { border-color:#8c6f4e; background:#f6efe3 !important; }
.room-name {
   position:absolute; left:7px; top:5px;
   font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; color:#5c5145;
   letter-spacing:.3px;
}
.room-sys {
   position:absolute; left:7px; top:20px; right:5px;
   font-size:10px; color:#9c9082; line-height:13px;
}
.room-tag {
   position:absolute; right:6px; bottom:4px;
   font-size:9px; color:#b3a794; letter-spacing:.5px;
}
/* Small instrument glyphs replace the empty floors in the deck plan.
   Every bay shares a tidy device frame, but the silhouettes change
   by function: reactor, filter, crew habitat, stores, science or signal. */
.room-glyph { position:absolute; z-index:0; right:8px; bottom:8px; width:52px; height:25px;
   overflow:hidden; background:#efe8dc; border:1px solid #d8c9b3; border-bottom-width:2px; }
.room-glyph span { position:absolute; display:block; }
.room-glyph .rg-main { left:5px; top:5px; width:15px; height:14px; border:1px solid #8c6f4e; }
.room-glyph .rg-side { right:5px; top:6px; width:20px; height:3px; background:#cbb89c; box-shadow:0 6px 0 #cbb89c, 0 12px 0 #cbb89c; }
.room-glyph .rg-light { left:8px; top:8px; width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:4px; }
.room-glyph-reactor .rg-main { border-radius:50%; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #e4dbcb, 0 0 0 4px #cbb89c; }
.room-glyph-reactor .rg-side { left:30px; right:auto; width:14px; height:2px; top:5px; }
.room-glyph-reactor .rg-light { left:10px; top:10px; width:3px; height:3px; }
.room-glyph-filter .rg-main { left:4px; top:4px; width:6px; height:15px; border-radius:4px; }
.room-glyph-filter .rg-side { left:15px; right:auto; top:4px; width:6px; height:15px; box-shadow:10px 0 0 #cbb89c, 20px 0 0 #cbb89c; }
.room-glyph-filter .rg-light { left:6px; top:8px; width:2px; height:2px; }
.room-glyph-habitat .rg-main { left:4px; top:5px; width:18px; height:12px; background:#faf7f2; }
.room-glyph-habitat .rg-side { right:4px; top:5px; width:18px; height:12px; background:#faf7f2; box-shadow:none; border:1px solid #cbb89c; }
.room-glyph-habitat .rg-light { left:11px; top:8px; width:3px; height:3px; }
.room-glyph-medical .rg-main { left:6px; top:4px; width:16px; height:16px; border-radius:50%; }
.room-glyph-medical .rg-side { left:29px; right:auto; top:7px; width:13px; height:2px; box-shadow:0 5px 0 #cbb89c, 0 10px 0 #cbb89c; }
.room-glyph-medical .rg-light { left:12px; top:6px; width:4px; height:12px; border-radius:0; }
.room-glyph-cargo .rg-main { left:4px; top:6px; width:12px; height:12px; box-shadow:13px 0 0 #cbb89c, 13px 0 0 1px #8c6f4e; }
.room-glyph-cargo .rg-side { left:5px; right:auto; top:6px; width:11px; height:1px; background:#8c6f4e; box-shadow:13px 0 0 #8c6f4e; }
.room-glyph-cargo .rg-light { display:none; }
.room-glyph-orbit .rg-main { left:5px; top:4px; width:17px; height:17px; border-radius:50%; background:none; }
.room-glyph-orbit .rg-side { left:29px; right:auto; top:6px; width:15px; height:2px; box-shadow:0 6px 0 #cbb89c, 0 12px 0 #cbb89c; }
.room-glyph-orbit .rg-light { left:11px; top:10px; width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; }
.room-glyph-network .rg-main { left:7px; top:6px; width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; }
.room-glyph-network .rg-side { left:28px; right:auto; top:5px; width:15px; height:2px; box-shadow:0 6px 0 #cbb89c, 0 12px 0 #cbb89c; }
.room-glyph-network .rg-light { left:17px; top:9px; width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:50%; }
.room-glyph-core .rg-main { left:7px; top:4px; width:16px; height:16px; border-radius:50%; background:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #e4dbcb, 0 0 0 4px #cbb89c; }
.room-glyph-core .rg-side { left:31px; right:auto; top:5px; width:13px; height:2px; box-shadow:0 6px 0 #cbb89c, 0 12px 0 #cbb89c; }
.room-glyph-core .rg-light { left:13px; top:10px; width:5px; height:5px; }
.room-glyph-garden .rg-main { left:7px; top:5px; width:3px; height:15px; border:0; }
.room-glyph-garden .rg-side { left:14px; right:auto; top:4px; width:3px; height:16px; box-shadow:7px 2px 0 #cbb89c, 14px 0 0 #cbb89c; }
.room-glyph-garden .rg-light { left:5px; top:6px; width:7px; height:4px; border-radius:7px 0 7px 0; }
.room-small .room-glyph { right:4px; left:auto; top:3px; bottom:auto; width:8px; height:8px; border:0; background:transparent; }
.room-small .room-glyph span { display:none; }
.room-small .room-glyph .rg-light { display:block; left:1px; top:1px; width:6px; height:6px; }
.room-name, .room-sys, .room-tag { z-index:1; }
.room-name { right:45px; }

/* Shared instrument-window for the remaining fitted rooms. Bespoke
   Engine, Filter, Mess and Quarters drawings keep their larger stages. */
.room-hero { position:relative; height:132px; margin:0 0 12px 0; overflow:hidden;
   background:#16232d; border:1px solid #344650; border-left:4px solid #8c6f4e; color:#e9eef0; }
.rh-scope { position:absolute; left:17px; top:14px; width:100px; height:100px; overflow:hidden;
   border:1px solid #49606b; border-radius:50%; background:#101820; }
.rh-orbit { position:absolute; left:11px; top:11px; width:76px; height:76px; border:1px solid #455660; border-radius:50%; }
.rh-orbit-two { left:23px; top:23px; width:52px; height:52px; border-style:dashed; border-color:#536873; }
.rh-core { position:absolute; left:43px; top:43px; width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:50%; }
.rh-beacon { position:absolute; width:5px; height:5px; left:21px; top:27px; border-radius:50%; background:#8aa1a8; }
.rh-beacon-two { left:75px; top:69px; width:4px; height:4px; background:#d4dfe1; }
.rh-readout { position:absolute; left:143px; top:18px; right:190px; }
.rh-code { color:#9db4bf; font:9px Consolas,"Lucida Console","Courier New",monospace; letter-spacing:1.3px; }
.rh-title { padding-top:8px; color:#f4f2eb; font-size:18px; font-weight:bold; }
.rh-caption { padding-top:4px; color:#aebdc2; font-size:11px; line-height:15px; }
.rh-meter { height:5px; margin-top:11px; white-space:nowrap; font-size:0; }
.rh-meter i { display:inline-block; width:8%; height:4px; margin-right:3px; background:#49606b; }
.rh-meter i:first-child, .rh-meter i:nth-child(2), .rh-meter i:nth-child(3), .rh-meter i:nth-child(4), .rh-meter i:nth-child(5) { background:#8c6f4e; }
.rh-status { position:absolute; top:16px; right:16px; width:152px; min-height:91px; padding:13px 12px 9px 13px;
   border-left:1px solid #344650; color:#8fa3aa; font:9px Consolas,"Lucida Console","Courier New",monospace; letter-spacing:1px; }
.rh-live-dot { display:inline-block; width:6px; height:6px; margin:0 6px 1px 0; border-radius:4px; }
.rh-status b { display:block; padding-top:8px; color:#d6e6dc; font-size:13px; letter-spacing:2px; }
.rh-status small { display:block; padding-top:7px; color:#708792; font-size:8px; line-height:11px; letter-spacing:.6px; }
.room-hero-reactor .rh-scope { border-color:#705642; }
.room-hero-reactor .rh-core { border-radius:3px; transform:rotate(45deg); }
.room-hero-filter .rh-orbit { width:56px; height:68px; left:21px; top:15px; border-radius:8px; border-style:solid; }
.room-hero-filter .rh-orbit-two { width:5px; height:35px; left:31px; top:31px; border-radius:3px; border-style:solid; }
.room-hero-filter .rh-core { left:48px; top:28px; width:6px; height:6px; box-shadow:0 18px 0 #8aa1a8, 0 36px 0 #8aa1a8; }
.room-hero-habitat .rh-orbit { width:70px; height:56px; left:14px; top:21px; border-radius:8px; }
.room-hero-habitat .rh-orbit-two { width:20px; height:48px; left:40px; top:25px; border-radius:2px; border-style:solid; }
.room-hero-habitat .rh-core { left:28px; top:42px; width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:2px; }
.room-hero-medical .rh-orbit { width:62px; height:62px; left:18px; top:18px; border-radius:5px; }
.room-hero-medical .rh-orbit-two { width:26px; height:26px; left:36px; top:36px; border-radius:50%; border-style:solid; }
.room-hero-medical .rh-core { left:48px; top:40px; width:3px; height:18px; border-radius:0; }
.room-hero-medical .rh-core:after { content:""; position:absolute; left:-7px; top:7px; width:17px; height:4px; background:inherit; }
.room-hero-cargo .rh-orbit { width:26px; height:27px; left:18px; top:20px; border-radius:2px; }
.room-hero-cargo .rh-orbit-two { width:26px; height:27px; left:54px; top:51px; border-radius:2px; border-style:solid; }
.room-hero-cargo .rh-core { left:56px; top:20px; width:25px; height:25px; border-radius:2px; }
.room-hero-orbit .rh-orbit { transform:scaleX(1.25); }
.room-hero-orbit .rh-orbit-two { transform:scaleX(.8); }
.room-hero-orbit .rh-core { width:11px; height:11px; }
.room-hero-network .rh-orbit { width:5px; height:5px; left:20px; top:21px; border-radius:50%; border:0; background:#8aa1a8; }
.room-hero-network .rh-orbit-two { width:6px; height:6px; left:69px; top:65px; border-radius:50%; border:0; background:#8aa1a8; }
.room-hero-network .rh-core { left:45px; top:25px; width:10px; height:10px; box-shadow:-24px 38px 0 #8aa1a8, 24px 38px 0 #8aa1a8; }
.room-hero-garden .rh-orbit { width:65px; height:38px; left:17px; top:30px; border-radius:3px; }
.room-hero-garden .rh-orbit-two { width:2px; height:40px; left:33px; top:28px; border:0; background:#789862; box-shadow:18px -5px 0 #789862, 37px 3px 0 #789862; }
.room-hero-garden .rh-core { width:8px; height:7px; left:27px; top:32px; border-radius:8px 0 8px 0; }
.room-hero-core .rh-scope { border-color:#70548a; }
.room-hero-core .rh-orbit { border-color:#6f5a8a; }
.room-hero-core .rh-orbit-two { border-color:#876ea3; }
.room-hero-core .rh-core { width:20px; height:20px; left:40px; top:40px; }
@media screen and (max-width:800px) { .rh-readout { right:150px; left:128px; } .rh-status { right:8px; width:130px; } }

/* a numbered shell: name only, centred, because there is nothing
  else in there for it to line up with */
.room-small .room-name { top:50%; margin-top:-8px; left:0; right:0;
                 text-align:center; font-weight:normal;
                 color:#8a7f72; }
.room-small .room-tag { bottom:2px; right:4px; font-size:8px; }
.corridor {
   position:absolute; background:#f7f2e9;
   border:1px dashed #d8cab4;
}
.divider {
   position:absolute; width:0; border-left:1px dashed #ddd2bf;
}

/* --- crew dots : cosmetic ambient drift only --------------- */
.dot {
   position:absolute; width:15px; height:15px;
   -moz-border-radius:8px; -webkit-border-radius:6px; border-radius:6px;
   border:2px solid #ffffff;
}
.dot:hover { border-color:#3b3630; }
.dot-label {
   position:absolute; font-size:9px; color:#8a7f72;
   white-space:nowrap;
}

.stage-note {
   width:100%; max-width:1160px; margin:6px auto 0 auto;
   font-size:11px; color:#a2947f; text-align:right;
}

/* --- event log / activity feed ----------------------------- */
#feedwrap { width:100%; margin:14px 0 0 0; }
.feed-head {
   font-size:10px; letter-spacing:1px; text-transform:uppercase;
   color:#8c6f4e; font-weight:bold; padding-bottom:6px;
}
/* no fixed height: layoutIdle() gives the feed whatever vertical
  space is left over, so it grows as the window grows */
#feed {
   min-height:62px; overflow-y:auto; /* matches FEED.min in the script */
   background:#faf7f2; border:1px solid #e4dbcb;
   padding:6px 10px;
}
.feed-line { padding:2px 0; color:#5c5145; line-height:15px; }
.feed-time { color:#b3a794; padding-right:8px; }

/* ============================================================
  SECTION 6 : TASK WINDOWS
  ============================================================ */

.task-screen { padding:18px 22px 30px 22px; }
.task-head { border-bottom:1px solid #cbb89c; padding-bottom:9px; margin-bottom:14px; }
.task-kind { font-size:10px; letter-spacing:1.2px; text-transform:uppercase; color:#8c6f4e; }
.task-title { font-size:19px; color:#3b3630; padding-top:2px; }
.task-sub { font-size:12px; color:#8a7f72; padding-top:3px; }

.panel      { background:#faf7f2; border:1px solid #e4dbcb; margin-bottom:12px; }
.panel-head {
   background:#f4efe6; border-bottom:1px solid #e4dbcb;
   padding:6px 11px; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:1px;
   text-transform:uppercase; color:#6b5338; font-weight:bold;
}
.panel-body { padding:11px 13px; }

.kv   { overflow:hidden; padding:3px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #f0e9dd; }
.kv-k { float:left; width:150px; color:#6b6157; }
.kv-v   { display:block; overflow:hidden; color:#3b3630; }

.act {
   display:block; width:100%; text-align:left;
   padding:7px 11px; margin-bottom:5px;
   background:#f4efe6; border:1px solid #e4dbcb;
   color:#9c9082; font-size:12px;
   font-family:"Segoe UI", Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
   cursor:default;
}
/* a wired, spendable action - visibly alive next to the dead ones */
.act-live {
   background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #8c6f4e;
   color:#3b3630; cursor:pointer;
}
.act-live:hover { background:#f6efe3; border-color:#6b5338; }
.act-live .act-cost { color:#6b5338; border-color:#cbb89c; background:#f4efe6; }
.act-cost {
   float:right; font-size:10px; color:#a2947f;
   border:1px solid #ddd2bf; padding:1px 6px; background:#faf7f2;
}
.notice {
   background:#f7f2e9; border:1px solid #ddd2bf;
   border-left:3px solid #8c6f4e;
   padding:9px 12px; color:#6b6157; line-height:17px;
}

.col-l { float:left; width:52%; }
.col-r { float:left; width:46%; margin-left:2%; }
/* used when a task window has nothing to DO, only something to
   READ - no Available Actions column, so Status takes the row. */
.col-full { float:left; width:100%; }
/* three even shelves in a row, under a full-width panel above
   them - the crew record's Profile / Personality / Employment
   line (Entry 076). Same float convention as col-l/col-r, just
   a third column, so old Trident document modes render it the
   same way they already render everything else in this file. */
.col-3 { float:left; width:32%; margin-right:2%; }
.col-3-end { float:left; width:32%; }
.clear { clear:both; height:0; overflow:hidden; }

/* ============================================================
  SECTION 7 : FLOATING POPUP WINDOWS
  Side panel items open here so the idle screen stays visible
  behind them, per manifesto 1.5.
  ============================================================ */

.pop {
   position:absolute; width:380px;
   background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #8c6f4e;
   z-index:40;
}
.pop-head {
   background:#f4efe6; border-bottom:1px solid #cbb89c;
   padding:6px 9px; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; color:#5c5145;
   cursor:move; overflow:hidden;
}
.pop-x {
   float:right; width:15px; height:15px; line-height:14px;
   text-align:center; color:#8a7f72; font-weight:normal; cursor:pointer;
}
.pop-x:hover { background:#e3d3c0; color:#b05a42; }
.pop-body   { padding:11px 13px; max-height:400px; overflow:auto; }

/* ============================================================

 SECTION 8 : PROTAGONIST MOUSE
 The cursor is the player's body in the world. A spent action
 leaves a mark exactly where the hand was. Drawn as two bars
 rather than a glyph so no font can ever fail us.
 ============================================================ */

/* pointer-events:none IS THE WHOLE FIX for clicks lost when
  clicking quickly. The mark is an 11px element at z-index 120
  dropped exactly under the cursor and left there for over half
  a second - so the NEXT click in the same spot hit the mark
  instead of the button and was silently thrown away. It must be
  scenery, never a target. Same family as Entry 015 and the
  position ring in Entry 023. */
.amark { position:absolute; width:11px; height:11px; z-index:120;
       pointer-events:none; }
.amark-h { position:absolute; left:0; top:4px; width:11px; height:2px;
       background:#7ec63f; box-shadow:0 0 5px #b6f07d;
       pointer-events:none; }
.amark-v { position:absolute; left:4px; top:0; width:2px; height:11px;
       background:#7ec63f; box-shadow:0 0 5px #b6f07d;
       pointer-events:none; }

/* ============================================================
  SECTION 9 : PROGRESS BUTTONS
  A committed process shows its progress as a filling bar and
  never as a number. The player learns to read the bar, not to
  count down from nine.
  ============================================================ */

.pbtn {
   position:relative; display:block; width:100%;
   height:31px; margin-top:4px;
   background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #8c6f4e;
   overflow:hidden; cursor:pointer;
}
.pbtn:hover     { background:#f6efe3; }
.pbtn-fill {
   position:absolute; left:0; top:0; height:100%; width:0;
   background:#dff0cc; border-right:1px solid #7ec63f;
}
.pbtn-text {
   position:relative; line-height:29px; text-align:center;
   color:#3b3630; font-size:12px;
}
/* running: inert and quiet, the bar does the talking */
.pbtn-run      { border-color:#cbb89c; cursor:default; background:#faf7f2; }
.pbtn-run:hover { background:#faf7f2; }
.pbtn-run .pbtn-text { color:#8a7f72; }
/* finished: alive again, waiting to be acknowledged */
.pbtn-done       { border-color:#7ec63f; background:#ffffff; cursor:pointer; }
.pbtn-done .pbtn-text { color:#3b3630; font-weight:bold; }
.pbtn-off      { border-color:#e4dbcb; cursor:default; }
.pbtn-off:hover { background:#ffffff; }
.pbtn-off .pbtn-text { color:#b3a794; }

/* ============================================================
  SECTION 10 : NAVIGATION SCREEN
  Flow layout, not absolute positioning. Panels size themselves
  to their content and there are no scrollbars anywhere - the
  Scan Data column in particular must be free to grow downward
  without limit as sensors improve.
  ============================================================ */

/* FLUID. The nav screen no longer has a width of its own - it is
  as wide as the content area, which is as wide as the window. */
.navwrap { width:100%; margin:0; }

/* overflow:hidden on a row is the IE-safe way to contain floats */
.navrow { overflow:hidden; }

.navpanel {
   background:#faf7f2; border:1px solid #e4dbcb;
   margin-bottom:12px;
}
.navpanel-head {
   background:#f4efe6; border-bottom:1px solid #e4dbcb;
   padding:5px 10px; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:1px;
   text-transform:uppercase; color:#6b5338; font-weight:bold;
}
/* no height, no overflow - the panel is as tall as its content */
.navpanel-body {
   padding:9px 11px;
   color:#3b3630; line-height:17px;
}
.navpanel-body .dim { color:#a2947f; }

/* PERCENTAGE COLUMNS. Under border-box the 1px panel border is
  inside the percentage, so the arithmetic is simply
  32 + 2 + 32 + 2 + 32 = 100 and nothing has to be shaved.

  The LAST column of every row floats RIGHT, not left. Trident
  rounds each percentage to whole pixels and the accumulated
  1px error would eventually wrap the final column onto its own
  line; a right float can never collide with the ones before it. */
/* THE FRAME. The chart is the centrepiece of this window, so the
  panels are arranged AROUND it and never in front of it: a
  stacked column on the left, the chart in the middle, Scan Data
  on the right.

 Three display:table-cells, not floats. Floats cannot give the
  side columns the height of the chart and cannot centre the
  chart vertically against them; table cells do both for free and
  are honoured by every document mode an HTA can land in. This is
  layout by table BEHAVIOUR, not a <table> element - the markup
  stays divs.

  The side columns are fixed pixel widths and the middle takes
  whatever is left, so the chart keeps as much room as the window
  can spare and the reading panels stay a readable, steady width
  instead of stretching on a wide monitor. */
.navmain { display:table; width:100%; table-layout:fixed;
          margin-bottom:12px; }
.navcell { display:table-cell; }
/* ALL THREE ANCHOR TO THE TOP. The chart sits centre-top, in the
  same place the ship slice sits on the idle screen, and the two
  reading columns start level with it. Consistency across task
  windows matters more than filling the lower half: a panel that
  floats to a different height depending on how much text is in
  it is a panel the eye has to hunt for. */
.navcell-l { width:214px; vertical-align:top; padding-right:12px; }
.navcell-c {          vertical-align:top; }
.navcell-r { width:252px; vertical-align:top; padding-left:12px; }
/* Give the chart and its two detail cards enough width on small windows. */
@media screen and (max-width:1100px) {
   .navwrap .navcell-l { width:170px; }
   .navwrap .navcell-r { width:190px; }
}

/* the chart and the two panels under it travel together and stay
  centred in the middle column, so the panels always line up with
  the chart edges however wide the window gets */
.navcenter { max-width:1100px; margin:0 auto; }

/* last panel in a stack - nothing below it to space away from */
.np-last { margin-bottom:0; }

/* under the map: 49 + 2 + 49 = 100 */
.np-half    { float:left; width:49%; margin-right:2%; }
.np-half-last { float:right; width:49%; }

.np-full { width:100%; }

.navname { font-size:17px; color:#3b3630; line-height:21px; }
.navsub { color:#8a7f72; padding-top:2px; font-size:11px; }
.navfield { padding:2px 0; overflow:hidden; }
.navfield-k{ float:left; width:112px; padding-right:6px; color:#6b6157; word-wrap:break-word; }
/* no fixed width - the value takes whatever the panel has left */
.navfield-v{ display:block; overflow:hidden; word-wrap:break-word; color:#3b3630; }
.np-half .navfield-k, .np-half-last .navfield-k { width:46%; }

/* a sentence of explanation under the fields of a panel */
.navnote { color:#8a7f72; font-size:11px; line-height:15px;
         padding-top:7px; margin-top:6px;
         border-top:1px solid #efe8dc; }
.scanline { padding:2px 0 4px 0; }
.scanlock { padding:2px 0 4px 0; color:#b8ab98; }

/* --- the map ------------------------------------------------ */
/* The raster is a CSS background, not DOM elements: two
  linear-gradients drawing a 1px line each, tiled by
  background-size. Solid colour is declared first as the
  fallback for any document mode without gradient support. */
/* FLUID UP TO A CEILING. The chart grows with the window but
  stops at STAGE.map (1100 x 500) and centres itself in the rest -
  the same treatment the ship slice gets. See the CENTRE STAGE
  house rule in the script. Bodies live in a fixed 638 x 278
  world and are projected onto whatever size the box settles at,
  so the stars never drift off their routes.

  The perspective raster is painted by applyRaster() as a stack
  of gradient layers, not declared here, because every line has
  to be recomputed from the live box size. The flat colour below
  is the fallback if gradients are unavailable. */
#map {
   position:relative; width:100%; max-width:1100px;
   min-height:240px; margin:0 auto 12px auto;
   background-color:#ece2d1;
   background-repeat:no-repeat;
   background-size:100% 100%;
   background-position:0 0;
   border:1px solid #8c6f4e;
   overflow:hidden;
   cursor:move;         /* the whole chart is draggable */
}

/* Zero-sized anchors, NOT sheets. A full-size transparent layer
  swallows every click meant for the bodies underneath. Do not
  give .maplayer a width or height. */
.maplayer { position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:0; height:0; }

/* routes are drawn as dot trails - no transforms, no canvas,
  works in every document mode an HTA can land in */
.rdot { position:absolute; width:2px; height:2px; background:#d3c3a8; }
.rdot-sel { background:#b9846b; width:3px; height:3px; }
/* authored lanes on the wide layers - deliberately weaker than a
  plotted course, they are context and not a route you can fly */
.rdot-faint { background:#e3d8c6; }
/* cosmetic star clusters on the galaxy layer. They live in the
  routes layer, underneath everything, so they can never take a
  click meant for a marker. */
.cdot { position:absolute; width:2px; height:2px; background:#cabca2; pointer-events:none; }
.cdot-far { width:1px; height:1px; background:#b4a388; }
.cdot-bright { width:2px; height:2px; background:#fff0c4; box-shadow:0 0 5px #e6c788; }

.mapdot {
  position:absolute; background:#6b5338;
  -moz-border-radius:8px; -webkit-border-radius:8px; border-radius:8px;
  border:2px solid #ffffff; cursor:pointer;
}
.mapdot:hover { background:#b05a42; }
.mapdot-star { background:#f1c878; box-shadow:0 0 8px #d39a51; }
.mapdot-planet { background:#7f9161; box-shadow:inset -3px -2px 0 rgba(37,53,39,.25); }
.mapdot-gas { background:#d88762; box-shadow:inset -5px -3px 0 rgba(68,39,39,.28),0 0 8px rgba(199,129,92,.5); }
.mapdot-ice { background:#8dd1df; box-shadow:inset -4px -2px 0 rgba(44,89,112,.28); }
.mapdot-ocean { background:#4f9cc9; box-shadow:inset -4px -2px 0 rgba(27,50,84,.35); }
.mapdot-rock { background:#b87961; box-shadow:inset -4px -2px 0 rgba(74,44,35,.3); }
.mapdot-moon { background:#d4d1c7; border-color:#f5f2e9; box-shadow:inset -3px -2px 0 rgba(74,74,69,.25); }
.mapdot-belt { background:#a68d6f; }
.mapdot-site { background:#9a8e83; }
.mapdot-station { background:#8c6f4e; -moz-border-radius:0; -webkit-border-radius:0; border-radius:0; }
/* a whole star system, seen from the sector scale: a light disc
  inside a coffee ring, so it reads as a container of things
  rather than as one object */
.mapdot-sys       { background:#faf7f2; border-color:#8c6f4e; }
/* a galactic region: same idea, squared off, because a region is
  an area on a chart and not a place you can park at */
.mapdot-region { background:#f4efe6; border-color:#6b5338;
              -moz-border-radius:0; -webkit-border-radius:0; border-radius:0; }
.mapdot-sel      { background:#b05a42; border-color:#3b3630; }
.maphere {
   position:absolute; border:2px solid #7f9161; background:transparent;
   -moz-border-radius:14px; -webkit-border-radius:14px; border-radius:14px;
}
.maplabel {
   position:absolute; font-size:10px;
 color:#6b5338;
   white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer;
}
/* ambient furniture - cosmetic only */
.rock { position:absolute; background:#c9b99f;
       -moz-border-radius:2px; -webkit-border-radius:2px; border-radius:2px; }
.sat { position:absolute; width:3px; height:3px; background:#7f9161; }
.beacon { position:absolute; width:4px; height:4px; background:#b05a42; }

.mapzoom { position:absolute; right:7px; top:7px; z-index:5; }
/* directly below the + / - pair. Own container rather than shared,
  so the zoom buttons keep their 21px square and these keep a
  width that fits a word. */
.maplayers { position:absolute; right:7px; top:62px; z-index:5; }
.lbtn {
   display:block; width:64px; height:19px; line-height:17px;
   text-align:center; margin-bottom:4px;
   background:#faf7f2; border:1px solid #8c6f4e; color:#6b5338;
   font-size:9px; letter-spacing:1px; cursor:pointer;
   font-family:"Segoe UI", Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
}
.lbtn:hover { background:#f0e7d8; }
.lbtn-on { background:#ffffff; border-color:#6b5338; color:#3b3630; font-weight:bold; }
.zbtn {
   display:block; width:21px; height:21px; line-height:19px;
   text-align:center; margin-bottom:4px;
   background:#faf7f2; border:1px solid #8c6f4e; color:#3b3630;
   font-size:14px; cursor:pointer;
   font-family:"Segoe UI", Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
}
.zbtn:hover { background:#f0e7d8; }
/* Both are scenery. Text painted over the chart must never be
  the thing a click lands on - Entry 015 / 023 / 026, same trap
  three times. They are children of #map, so a drag that starts
  on them still bubbles and still pans. */
.mapscale { position:absolute; left:8px; top:7px; font-size:10px;
          color:#9c8f7c; z-index:5; pointer-events:none; }
.maphint { position:absolute; right:8px; bottom:6px; font-size:10px;
        color:#9c8f7c; z-index:5; pointer-events:none; }

/* ============================================================
  SECTION 10-B : THE ENGINE MACHINE
  A fixed 650x390 illustration made of positioned divs. It never
  scales - centre-stage house rule - and every piece of it is
  scenery except the condition meter. Circles are border-radius,
  angles are Math.cos/sin scattering small dots: Trident gives us
  no transform and no canvas worth trusting, so a needle is three
  dots on a radius and a turbine blade is a dot on a circle.
  ============================================================ */

#machine {
   position:relative; margin:0 auto 12px auto;
   background:#fdfbf7;
   border:1px solid #8c6f4e;
   overflow:hidden;
}
/* scenery must never be the thing a click lands on */
.mach-part {
   position:absolute; pointer-events:none;
   font-family:"Segoe UI", Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
}

.mach-pipe { background:#efe8dc; border:1px solid #cbb89c; }
.mach-valve { background:#f4efe6; border:1px solid #8c6f4e; }
.mach-rod { background:#cbb89c; }
.mach-spoke { background:#cbb89c; }
.mach-brk { background:#cbb89c; }
.mach-mount { background:#cbb89c; border:1px solid #a89476; }
.mach-rivet { background:#cbb89c;
         -moz-border-radius:2px; -webkit-border-radius:2px; border-radius:2px; }
.mach-flow { background:#a89476;
         -moz-border-radius:2px; -webkit-border-radius:2px; border-radius:2px; }
.mach-fin { background:#ece5d8; border-left:1px solid #cbb89c; }
.mach-tick { background:#cbb89c;
         -moz-border-radius:3px; -webkit-border-radius:3px; border-radius:3px; }
.mach-nd { background:#8c6f4e;
         -moz-border-radius:2px; -webkit-border-radius:2px; border-radius:2px; }
.mach-scale { background:#ddd2bf; }

/* dial faces and the indicator bus */
.mach-dial { border:1px solid #8c6f4e; background:#fdfbf7;
          -moz-border-radius:50%; -webkit-border-radius:50%; border-radius:50%; }
.mach-hub2 { background:#cbb89c; border:1px solid #8c6f4e;
          -moz-border-radius:50%; -webkit-border-radius:50%; border-radius:50%; }
.mach-lamp { background:#efe8dc; border:1px solid #cbb89c;
          -moz-border-radius:50%; -webkit-border-radius:50%; border-radius:50%; }
.mach-lamp-on { background:#7f9161; border-color:#6b7d50; }
.mach-lamp-amb { background:#c08a3e; border-color:#a8762f; }
/* the core, as rings inside rings */
.mach-ring {
   border:2px solid #8c6f4e; background:#faf7f2;
   -moz-border-radius:50%; -webkit-border-radius:50%; border-radius:50%;
}
.mach-ring2 {
   border:1px dashed #cbb89c;
   -moz-border-radius:50%; -webkit-border-radius:50%; border-radius:50%;
}
.mach-hub {
   background:#8c6f4e; border:1px solid #6b5338;
   -moz-border-radius:50%; -webkit-border-radius:50%; border-radius:50%;
}
.mach-core {
   background:#fdfbf7;
   -moz-border-radius:50%; -webkit-border-radius:50%; border-radius:50%;
}
.mach-bolt {
   background:#f4efe6; border:1px solid #8c6f4e;
   -moz-border-radius:50%; -webkit-border-radius:50%; border-radius:50%;
}
.mach-wheel {
   border:2px solid #8c6f4e; background:#f7f2e9;
   -moz-border-radius:50%; -webkit-border-radius:50%; border-radius:50%;
}

.mach-box { background:#faf7f2; border:1px solid #e4dbcb; }
.mach-cyl { background:#efe8dc; border:1px solid #cbb89c; }

/* the small print: statistics, captions, gauge labels */
.mach-mini { font-size:8px; letter-spacing:1px; color:#a2947f; }
.mach-mini2 { font-size:8px; color:#b3a794; }
.mach-cap { font-size:8px; letter-spacing:1px; color:#a2947f;
         text-align:center; }
.mach-stat { font-size:9px; overflow:hidden; color:#6b6157;
         border-bottom:1px solid #f0e9dd; }
.mach-sk { float:left; }
.mach-sv { float:right; color:#3b3630;
         font-family:Consolas, "Courier New", monospace; }

.mach-track { background:#ece5d8; }
.mach-fillx { background:#cbb89c; }

/* THE ONE LIVE READING */
.mach-track2 { background:#ece5d8; border:1px solid #ddd2bf; }
.mach-fill2 { background:#7f9161; }
.mach-pct { font-size:26px; color:#3b3630; text-align:right;
         font-family:Consolas, "Courier New", monospace; }
.mach-word { font-size:10px; letter-spacing:2px; line-height:14px;
         text-align:right; }
.mach-plate { font-size:8px; letter-spacing:1px; color:#b3a794;
         font-family:Consolas, "Courier New", monospace; }
/* ============================================================
  SECTION 10-C : THE FILTER BANK
  A fixed 600x360 illustration. Scenery is .o2-part and takes no
  clicks; the three install buttons sit in .o2-btnwrap, which is
  the only thing in the box that does.
  ============================================================ */
#o2mach {
   position:relative; margin:0 auto 12px auto;
   background:#fdfbf7; border:1px solid #8c6f4e; overflow:hidden;
}
.o2-part { position:absolute; pointer-events:none;
         font-family:"Segoe UI", Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif; }
.o2-btnwrap{ position:absolute; z-index:5; }

.o2-duct { background:#efe8dc; border:1px solid #cbb89c; }
.o2-louvre { background:#cbb89c; }
.o2-flow { background:#e4dbcb; border:1px solid #cbb89c; }
.o2-mini { font-size:8px; letter-spacing:1px; color:#a2947f; }

/* the cabin air: stale by default, clean while the bank runs */
.o2-air     { background:#efe7d8; border:1px solid #ddd2bf; }
.o2-air-clean { background:#f1f6ea; border-color:#cfdcc0; }
.o2-dust { position:absolute; width:3px; height:3px; background:#b9a893; }
.o2-streak { position:absolute; width:72px; height:2px; background:#cfdcc0; }
.o2-airword{ position:absolute; right:10px; top:6px;
         font-size:11px; letter-spacing:2px; }
.o2-airsub { position:absolute; right:10px; top:19px;
         font-size:8px; color:#a2947f; }
.o2-airtrack { position:absolute; left:8px; top:32px;
           width:544px; height:14px;
           background:#e6ddcd; border:1px solid #d3c6b1; }
.o2-airfill { position:absolute; left:9px; top:33px; height:12px; }
.o2-airnotch { position:absolute; top:32px; width:1px; height:14px;
           background:#fdfbf7; }
.o2-airlab { position:absolute; left:8px; top:8px;
         font-size:8px; letter-spacing:1px; color:#a2947f; }

/* a slot housing and what sits in it */
.o2-slot { background:#faf7f2; border:1px solid #cbb89c; }
.o2-well { background:#f4efe6; border:1px solid #cbb89c; }
.o2-well-bare { background:#fdfbf7; border:1px dashed #cbb89c; }
.o2-can { background:#e4dbcb; border:1px solid #8c6f4e;
         -moz-border-radius:8px; -webkit-border-radius:8px;
         border-radius:8px; }
.o2-can-live { background:#dfeccd; border-color:#7f9161; }
.o2-neck { background:#cbb89c; border:1px solid #8c6f4e; }
.o2-state { font-size:10px; letter-spacing:1.5px; text-align:center; }
.o2-track { background:#ece5d8; border:1px solid #ddd2bf; }
.o2-fill { background:#7f9161; }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
  THE GALLEY COUNTER - same box-of-divs rule as the reactor and
  the filter bank, warm kitchen tones instead of engine iron or
  filter-bank green so the three rooms never read as one room.
  ------------------------------------------------------------ */
#messmach {
   position:relative; margin:0 auto 12px auto;
   background:#fdfbf7; border:1px solid #8c6f4e; overflow:hidden;
}
.mess-part { position:absolute; pointer-events:none;
         font-family:"Segoe UI", Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif; }
.mess-counter { background:#f3e6cf; border:1px solid #d2a059; }
.mess-rackbox { background:#faf7f2; border:1px solid #d2a059; }
.mess-mini { font-size:8px; letter-spacing:1px; color:#a2947f; }
.mess-track { background:#ece5d8; border:1px solid #ddd2bf; }
.mess-fill { background:#d2a059; }
.mess-fill-small { background:#7f9161; }
.mess-readout { font-size:10px; color:#6b6157; text-align:center; }
.mess-plate { background:#faf7f2; border:1px solid #cbb89c; }
.mess-plate-name { font-size:11px; color:#3b3630; font-weight:bold; }
.mess-plate-sub { font-size:9px; color:#a2947f; }

/* the proportion bar used inside the reading panels */
.navbar   { height:8px; background:#ece5d8; border:1px solid #ddd2bf;
        margin:7px 0 3px 0; }
.navbar-in { height:6px; }

/* ============================================================
  SECTION 10-D : CREW QUARTERS
  A 560x300 hallway and a sixteen-row sprite built out of five
  pixel divs. Scenery is .cq-part and takes no clicks; the
  roster rows, the job select and the order toggles are the
  live parts and sit outside the stage.
  ============================================================ */
#hallway {
   position:relative; margin:0 auto 12px auto;
   background:#fdfbf7; border:1px solid #8c6f4e; overflow:hidden;
}
.cq-part { position:absolute; pointer-events:none;
        font-family:"Segoe UI", Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif; }
.cq-wall { background:#faf7f2; }
.cq-floor { background:#f0e9dd; border-top:1px solid #cbb89c; }
.cq-board { background:#e4dbcb; }
.cq-skirt { background:#e9e0d0; border-top:1px solid #d8cab4; }
.cq-light
 { background:#f7f2e9; border:1px solid #cbb89c; }
.cq-glow { background:#f4efe6; }
.cq-door { background:#f4efe6; border:2px solid #8c6f4e; }
.cq-dpane { background:#faf7f2; border:1px solid #cbb89c; }
.cq-dhand { background:#cbb89c; }
.cq-lock { background:#f4efe6; border:1px solid #8c6f4e; }
.cq-lvent { background:#ddd2bf; }
.cq-lhand { background:#8c6f4e; }
.cq-lnum { font-size:8px; letter-spacing:1px; color:#b3a794; }
.cq-mini { font-size:8px; letter-spacing:1px; color:#a2947f;
        text-align:center; }
.cq-shadow{ background:#e4dbcb;
        -moz-border-radius:50%; -webkit-border-radius:50%;
        border-radius:50%; }
.cq-scene { position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:560px; height:300px;
        pointer-events:none; }
.cq-px { position:absolute; }

/* --- the roster ------------------------------------------- */
.cq-pay { background:#faf7f2; border:1px solid #efe8dc;
         padding:5px 7px 6px 7px; margin-bottom:6px; }
.cq-payh { font-size:9px; letter-spacing:1px; color:#8c6f4e;
         font-weight:bold; padding-bottom:3px; }
.cq-payrow{ overflow:hidden; padding:1px 0; }
.cq-payk { float:left; font-size:10px; color:#8a7f72; }
.cq-payv { float:right; font-size:10px; color:#3b3630;
         font-family:Consolas, "Courier New", monospace; }
.cq-row { padding:5px 6px; border-bottom:1px solid #f0e9dd;
         cursor:pointer; overflow:hidden; }
.cq-row:hover { background:#f7f2e9; }
.cq-row-sel { background:#f4efe6; border-left:3px solid #8c6f4e;
            padding-left:3px; }
.cq-dot { display:inline-block; width:9px; height:9px; margin-right:6px;
        -moz-border-radius:5px; -webkit-border-radius:5px;
        border-radius:5px; }
.cq-nm { color:#3b3630; font-size:12px; }
.cq-flag { float:right; font-size:9px; color:#8c6f4e;
        background:#f4efe6; border:1px solid #cbb89c;
        padding:0 4px; letter-spacing:.5px; }
.cq-rl { color:#a2947f; font-size:10px; padding:2px 0 0 15px; }

/* --- the order pad ---------------------------------------- */
.cq-sub { font-size:13px; color:#3b3630; padding-bottom:6px; }
.cq-lab { font-size:9px; letter-spacing:1px; text-transform:uppercase;
         color:#8c6f4e; padding:8px 0 4px 0; }
.cq-sel { width:100%; font-size:12px; font-family:inherit;
         color:#3b3630; border:1px solid #cbb89c; background:#ffffff; }
.cq-cost { font-size:10px; color:#a2947f; padding-top:3px; }
.cq-ord { padding:4px 6px; margin-top:3px; cursor:pointer;
         border:1px solid #e4dbcb; background:#ffffff;
         overflow:hidden; font-size:11px; color:#6b6157; }
.cq-ord:hover { background:#f7f2e9; border-color:#cbb89c; }
.cq-ord-on { background:#f4efe6; border-color:#8c6f4e; color:#3b3630; }
.cq-box { display:inline-block; width:12px; height:12px; line-height:11px;
         text-align:center; font-size:10px; color:#8c6f4e;
         border:1px solid #cbb89c; background:#ffffff; margin-right:7px; }
.cq-ordl { display:inline-block; }
.cq-ordc { float:right; color:#a2947f; font-size:10px; }
.cq-num { display:inline-block; width:34px;
         font-family:Consolas, "Courier New", monospace; color:#3b3630; }

.cq-row-busy { background:#faf7f2; }
.cq-row-busy .cq-nm { color:#a2947f; }
.cq-row-busy .cq-rl { color:#bfb3a1; font-style:italic; }
.cq-flag-busy { color:#6b6157; background:#efe8dc; border-color:#ddd2bf;
            font-family:Consolas, "Courier New", monospace; }
.cq-closed     { padding:10px 2px; color:#8a7f72; font-size:12px;
            line-height:18px; }
.cq-ord-off { opacity:.5; filter:alpha(opacity=50); cursor:default;
         background:#faf7f2; }
.cq-ord-off:hover { background:#faf7f2; border-color:#e4dbcb; }
.cq-ordn { color:#a2947f; font-size:9px; padding:2px 0 0 19px; }
.cq-sub2 { float:right; color:#8c6f4e;
        font-family:Consolas, "Courier New", monospace; }
.cq-talkrow { overflow:hidden; }
.cq-talkbtn { float:left; width:210px; padding:7px 0; text-align:center;
         border:1px solid #8c6f4e; background:#ffffff;
         color:#3b3630; font-size:12px; cursor:pointer; }
.cq-talkbtn:hover { background:#f6efe3; }
.cq-talkbtn-off { border-color:#e4dbcb; color:#b3a794; cursor:default;
              background:#faf7f2; }
.cq-talkbtn-off:hover { background:#faf7f2; }
.cq-says { margin-left:224px; padding:8px 0 0 0; color:#5c5145;
       font-size:12px; font-style:italic; }

/* --- the target action band --------------------------------
  One centred row of task buttons at the very bottom of the
  screen, one per thing that can be done TO the selected body.
  Inline-block rather than float, so the row stays centred
  whatever number of buttons it ends up holding - travel and
  scan today, repair or hail later, no layout change needed.
  font-size:0 on the row kills the whitespace gap Trident leaves
  between inline-blocks; the cell puts the size back. */
.actionbar { text-align:center; padding:2px 0 6px 0; }
.actionrow { text-align:center; font-size:0; }
.actioncell { display:inline-block; vertical-align:top;
          width:200px; margin:0 5px; font-size:12px; }
.actionnote { text-align:center; padding-top:8px; }

/* --- idle screen navigation strip --------------------------- */
#navstrip {
   width:100%; margin:12px 0 0 0;
   background:#faf7f2; border:1px solid #e4dbcb;
   padding:8px 10px; overflow:hidden;
}
#navstrip:hover { border-color:#cbb89c; background:#f7f2e9; }
.ns-label { font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.7px; text-transform:uppercase; color:#8a7f72; }
.ns-main { font-size:13px; color:#3b3630; padding-top:3px; }
.ns-right { float:right; text-align:right; color:#a2947f; font-size:11px; padding-top:9px; }

/* Free reference screens and reading preferences. */
.sp-quick { padding-top:5px; text-align:center; }
.sp-quick button { margin:0 2px; padding:3px 8px; border:1px solid #cbb89c; background:#fff; color:#5c5145; cursor:pointer; font-size:11px; }
.sp-quick button:hover, .wiki-link:hover { background:#f6efe3; }
.wiki-layout { display:table; width:100%; table-layout:fixed; }
.wiki-index, .wiki-article { display:table-cell; vertical-align:top; }
.wiki-index { width:230px; padding-right:14px; }
.wiki-search { width:100%; padding:7px; border:1px solid #cbb89c; font-size:13px; }
.wiki-list { margin-top:8px; }
.wiki-group { color:#8c6f4e; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:1px; text-transform:uppercase; font-weight:bold; padding:10px 5px 4px; }
.wiki-link { display:block; width:100%; padding:7px; border:0; background:#faf7f2; color:#5c5145; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; }
.wiki-current { background:#e9dcc6; color:#3b3630; font-weight:bold; }
.wiki-article { background:#faf7f2; border:1px solid #e4dbcb; padding:0 16px 16px; }
.wiki-article .panel-head { margin:0 -16px; }
.wiki-title { font-size:20px; font-weight:normal; padding:18px 0 10px; }
.wiki-copy { font-size:14px; line-height:1.65; padding-bottom:20px; max-width:750px; }
.award-grid { font-size:0; }
.award-card { display:inline-block; vertical-align:top; width:49%; margin:0 1% 10px 0; padding:12px; border:1px solid #e4dbcb; background:#faf7f2; font-size:12px; }
.award-title { font-size:14px; font-weight:bold; color:#5c5145; overflow:hidden; }
.award-status { float:right; color:#8c6f4e; font-size:11px; font-weight:normal; }
.award-detail { min-height:34px; padding-top:7px; line-height:17px; }
.award-track { height:6px; background:#e4dbcb; margin:8px 0; }
.award-fill { height:6px; background:#7f9161; }
.award-claim { border:1px solid #8c6f4e; background:#fff; color:#3b3630; padding:6px 9px; cursor:pointer; }
.award-claim:disabled { border-color:#e4dbcb; color:#a2947f; background:#f4efe6; cursor:default; }
#pop-settings .pop-body { max-height:65vh; }
.awards-summary .navfield-k { width:180px; }
.setting-row { padding:9px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #eee5d8; line-height:17px; }
.setting-row button { margin-top:5px; padding:5px 8px; }
.setting-row select { width:100%; margin-top:5px; padding:5px 7px; border:1px solid #cbb89c;
   background:#fff; color:#3b3630; font:12px "Segoe UI",Tahoma,sans-serif; }
body.large-text .navfield, body.large-text .kv, body.large-text .notice, body.large-text .act,
body.large-text .navnote, body.large-text .feed-line, body.large-text .pop-body,
body.large-text .sp-row, body.large-text .task-sub, body.large-text .award-card { font-size:14px; line-height:1.45; }
body.large-text .wiki-copy { font-size:16px; }
body.large-text .wiki-link, body.large-text .wiki-search, body.large-text .award-claim { font-size:14px; }
body.hide-crew-labels .dot-label { display:none; }
@media screen and (max-width:1100px) { .wiki-index { width:190px; } }


/* Main menu: the supplied title art is embedded, so the HTA stays offline. */
#game-shell { display:none; }
#title-screen { position:fixed; z-index:10000; left:0; right:0; top:0; bottom:0;
  overflow:hidden; background:#d8c4a6; color:#443528; }
#title-card { position:absolute; background:#eee1cc url("data:image/jpeg;base64,") center center no-repeat;
  background-size:100% 100%; }
#title-actions { position:absolute; left:2%; width:81.8%; bottom:4.05%; height:5.65%;
  background:#3f342b; border-top:1px solid #a89170; border-bottom:1px solid #a89170; white-space:nowrap; }
#title-actions button { float:left; width:20%; height:100%; padding:0 4px; border:0; border-right:1px solid #a48e72;
  background:#3f342b; color:#f2e5cc; cursor:pointer; font:12px Consolas,"Courier New",monospace; letter-spacing:1.3px; }
#title-actions button:last-child { border-right:0; }
#title-actions button:hover, #title-actions button:focus { background:#6b543f; outline:1px solid #f2e5cc; outline-offset:-3px; }
#title-dialog { position:absolute; z-index:2; display:none; width:440px; max-width:90%; max-height:86%; overflow:auto;
  left:50%; top:50%; -ms-transform:translate(-50%,-50%); transform:translate(-50%,-50%); padding:24px 26px; background:#f5ead8;
  border:2px solid #8e7757; box-shadow:0 8px 26px #63503b; font-size:13px; line-height:1.55; }
#title-dialog .setting-row { padding:5px 0; line-height:15px; }
#title-dialog .setting-row button { margin-top:3px; padding:3px 7px; }
#title-dialog h2 { margin:0 0 12px; color:#443528; font:22px Georgia,serif; }
#title-dialog p { margin:0 0 12px; }
#title-dialog select { width:100%; padding:7px; margin:4px 0 12px; border:1px solid #aa9373; background:#fffaf1; }
.title-button { padding:8px 14px; margin:8px 6px 0 0; border:1px solid #775e42; background:#4c3d30;
  color:#fff5e6; font:12px Consolas,"Courier New",monospace; cursor:pointer; }
.title-button:hover, .title-button:focus { background:#7b6047; }
.title-secondary { background:#f5ead8; color:#4c3d30; }
.title-error { color:#a2402f; padding-top:8px; }
.title-sr { position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; overflow:hidden; left:-9999px; }
@media screen and (max-width:800px) { #title-actions button { font-size:10px; letter-spacing:0; } }

/* The smaller courier has less wall space: keep room names readable
   and move detailed system descriptions into each room's tooltip. */
#stage.stage-compact .room-sys, #stage.stage-compact .room .room-tag { display:none; }
#stage.stage-compact .room:not(.room-small) .room-name { font-size:10px; line-height:12px; right:5px; }

/* Compact functional room names in the spine and the core. */
.room-small .room-name { font-size:9px; letter-spacing:0; }
#room-simulacron .room-name { font-size:9px; letter-spacing:0; }

/* Palette overrides. The classic parchment look remains the default;
   the other four bridge palettes deliberately include dark, high-contrast
   panels, room plates and charts rather than only recolouring buttons. */
body.theme-void { background:#0b1320; color:#dce8f2; }
body.theme-void #taskbar, body.theme-void #taskbar-controls, body.theme-void #sidepanel, body.theme-void #sidefoot, body.theme-void #statusbar { background:#101d2c; border-color:#2e465d; color:#9bb1c1; }
body.theme-void #content, body.theme-void #stage { background:#0b1320; border-color:#2e465d; color:#dce8f2; }
body.theme-void .tab { background:#172638; border-color:#2e465d; color:#a9bdca; }
body.theme-void .tab-active { background:#0b1320; color:#e5f2fb; border-color:#65d7ed; }
body.theme-void .sp-block, body.theme-void .panel, body.theme-void .navpanel, body.theme-void .stat, body.theme-void .info, body.theme-void #feed, body.theme-void .pop, body.theme-void .award-card, body.theme-void .wiki-article { background:#152437; border-color:#2e465d; color:#dce8f2; }
