/* ================================================================
  SECTION C : UTILITIES
  Small IE-safe helpers. No modern DOM API used anywhere.
  ================================================================ */

function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }

function make(tag, cls, html) {
  var el = document.createElement(tag);
  if (cls) { el.className = cls; }
  if (html !== undefined && html !== null) { el.innerHTML = html; }
  return el;
}

function on(el, type, fn) {
  if (el.addEventListener) { el.addEventListener(type, fn, false); }
  else if (el.attachEvent) { el.attachEvent("on" + type, fn); }
}

function rightClick(el, fn) {
  el.oncontextmenu = function () { fn(); return false; };
}

function clear(el) { while (el.firstChild) { el.removeChild(el.firstChild); } }

function pad2(n) { return (n < 10 ? "0" : "") + n; }

function stamp() {
  var d = new Date();
  return pad2(d.getHours()) + ":" + pad2(d.getMinutes()) + ":" + pad2(d.getSeconds());
}

function findById(list, id) {
    var i;
    for (i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
       if (list[i].id === id) { return list[i]; }
    }
    return null;
}

function bar(pct, colour) {
  var w = pct; if (w < 0) { w = 0; } if (w > 100) { w = 100; }
  return '<div class="bar"><div class="bar-in" style="width:' + w +
       '%;background:' + colour + ';"></div></div>';
}


/* ================================================================
  SECTION C-2 : FLUID LAYOUT
  The window frame is fluid through CSS alone. Two things cannot
  be: the activity feed and the star map, because both are empty
  boxes that have no content to push them open. They are measured
  and sized here instead, on build and on every resize.

    The method is the same for both: park the element at its
    minimum, measure how tall everything ELSE on the screen is,
    and hand the leftover to the element. No magic numbers, so
    panels can be added or removed later without touching this.
    ================================================================ */

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
  HOUSE RULE : CENTRE STAGE GRAPHICS
  A graphic in the middle of a screen does NOT stretch to fill the
  window. It has a ceiling and is centred in whatever space it is
  given; only the panels and the text around it are fluid. A hull
  drawing or a star chart blown up to 1800px reads as a poster,
  not as an instrument.

  The ship slice set the precedent - fixed at 836 x 344 - and the
  chart follows it with a ceiling instead of a fixed size, so it
  can still shrink on a small window. Every future diagram,
  viewport or animation belongs in this table.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
var STAGE = {
   ship : { w:1160, h:460 }, /* fixed - see #stage in the CSS */
   map : { w:1100, h:500 }, /* ceiling - mirrors #map max-width */
   engine : { w:650, h:390 }, /* fixed - the machine never scales */
   o2 : { w:600, h:360 }, /* fixed - the filter bank                 */
   crew : { w:560, h:300 }, /* fixed - the quarters hallway */
   mess : { w:600, h:360 } /* fixed - the galley counter */
};

var RESIZE = { timer:null };

/* Trident fires onresize continuously while a window is dragged.
  Coalesce into one relayout, or the map redraws hundreds of
  times for a single drag. */
function onWindowResize() {
   if ($("title-screen")) { layoutTitle(); }
   if (RESIZE.timer) { window.clearTimeout(RESIZE.timer); }
   RESIZE.timer = window.setTimeout(applyLayout, 90);
}

function applyLayout() {
  RESIZE.timer = null;
  if ($("map")) { layoutNav(); return; }
  if ($("feed")) { layoutIdle(); }
}

/* how much room the content area has, minus the screen's padding */
function contentSpace() {
   var host = $("content");
   return host ? host.clientHeight : 0;
}

/* The feed gave up its height to the ship. It is a glance at the
  last few lines now, not a reading panel - the bigger hull needs
  the room more than the log does. Leftover space is left where
  it falls, exactly as on the nav screen: nothing stretches. */
var FEED = { min:62, max:132 };

function layoutIdle() {
  var host = $("content"), f = $("feed"), scr = $("screen-idle"), other, h;
  if (!host || !f || !scr) { return; }
  f.style.height = FEED.min + "px";
  other = scr.offsetHeight - f.offsetHeight; /* everything but the feed */
  h = contentSpace() - other - 4;
  if (h > FEED.max) { h = FEED.max; }
  if (h < FEED.min) { h = FEED.min; }
  f.style.height = h + "px";
}

function layoutNav() {
  var host = $("content"), m = $("map"), scr, other, h, cap;
  if (!m) { return; }

  scr = m.parentNode;
  while (scr && scr.className !== "task-screen") { scr = scr.parentNode; }

  /* the sizing step is optional - if the screen shape ever
     changes the chart must still be measured and drawn */
  if (host && scr) {
      m.style.height = "240px";
      other = scr.offsetHeight - m.offsetHeight; /* all but the map */
      h = contentSpace() - other - 4;

     /* CENTRE STAGE: take the spare height, but never more than
       the ceiling, and never so much that a narrow chart turns
       into a square - the world is roughly 2:1 and the stars
           would visibly squash. Width is capped by max-width in
           the CSS and the box centres itself. */
        measureMap();
        cap = STAGE.map.h;
        if (Math.round(MAP.vw / 2) < cap) { cap = Math.round(MAP.vw / 2); }
        if (h > cap) { h = cap; }
        if (h < 240) { h = 240; }
        m.style.height = h + "px";
    }

    measureMap();
    applyRaster();
    drawMapRoutes();
    drawMapBodies();
}

/* NOTHING IS STRETCHED TO FILL.
  An earlier pass tried two ways of using the leftover height
  below the chart: padding the frame down to centre it (which
  made the whole screen visibly drop when Navigation was opened
  on a big window), then stretching the frame row to fill the
  content area (which forced Scan Data to full height and left
  the screen exactly as tall as its container - one pixel of
  rounding and a scrollbar appeared).

    Both are gone. The chart is sized, capped and centred
    horizontally; everything simply flows from the top; Scan Data
    is as tall as the text in it and no taller. The leftover sits
    at the bottom of the window where it costs nothing. This is
    also what the idle screen does with the ship slice, so the two
    task windows now agree with each other.
    ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* The one place the rendered size of the chart is read. */
function measureMap() {
   var m = $("map");
   if (!m) { return; }
   MAP.vw = m.clientWidth || MAP.w; /* clientWidth excludes the border */
   MAP.vh = m.clientHeight || MAP.h;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
  THE PERSPECTIVE RASTER
  A square grid reads as a sheet of graph paper laid flat. This
  one is drawn as a plane running away from the viewer instead:
  depth rungs that bunch toward the top, and a fan of lines
  converging on a vanishing point held ABOVE the top edge, so the
  chart shows the run-away and never the knot where they meet.
  The rungs also fade with depth, which is most of the illusion.

    It is still pure CSS background - no DOM elements, no canvas,
    no transforms, all of which are unreliable across document
    modes. Each line is one gradient layer sized to the whole box.

    The maths for one line: take the line through the vanishing
    point, take its PERPENDICULAR as the gradient axis, turn that
    axis into a CSS angle, then place a 1px stop where the axis
    crosses the line. Layer count is bounded (16 worst case) by
    widening the fan pitch on wide charts.
    ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

function rasterInk(a) {
  var palette = STATE.options && THEMES[STATE.options.theme] ? THEMES[STATE.options.theme] : THEMES.classic;
  return "rgba(" + palette.ink + "," + a + ")";
}

/* one hairline, as a gradient layer. t is measured along the
  gradient axis from where that axis enters the box. */
function rasterLayer(ang, t, ink) {
   var p = Math.round(t);
   return "linear-gradient(" + ang + "deg," +
        "transparent " + p + "px," + ink + " " + p + "px," +
        ink + " " + (p + 1) + "px,transparent " + (p + 1) + "px)";
}

/* the hairline that passes through (vx,vy) and (bx,by) */
function rasterThrough(W, H, vx, vy, bx, by, ink) {
   var ux = bx - vx, uy = by - vy;
   var len = Math.sqrt(ux * ux + uy * uy), dx, dy, ang, rad, L, t;
   if (len <
 0.01) { return ""; }

    dx = uy / len;                /* perpendicular of the line */
    dy = -ux / len;

    /* two decimals, not whole degrees: on a 900px chart a rounding
      of half a degree walks the far end of the line about 6px off
      its anchor and the fan stops converging cleanly. */
    ang = Math.round(Math.atan2(dx, -dy) * 18000 / Math.PI) / 100;

    rad = ang * Math.PI / 180;          /* re-derive from the rounded */
    dx = Math.sin(rad);              /* angle so t cannot drift */
    dy = -Math.cos(rad);

    L = Math.abs(W * dx) + Math.abs(H * dy);
    t = (vx - W / 2) * dx + (vy - H / 2) * dy + L / 2;
    return rasterLayer(ang, t, ink);
}

function applyRaster() {
  var m = $("map");
  if (!m) { return; }

    var W = MAP.vw, H = MAP.vh;
    var vx = W / 2, vy = -H * MAP.vpy; /* vanishing point, off the top */
    var pitch = MAP.grid * MAP.zoom;
    var layers = [], g = "linear-gradient(to bottom", n, k, j, f, y, a;
    /* depth rungs - one layer, one stop pair per line. Zooming in
       means fewer, wider rungs, same as a bigger grid cell. */
    n = Math.round(MAP.rungs / MAP.zoom);
    if (n < 4) { n = 4; }
    if (n > 14) { n = 14; }
    for (j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
       f = Math.pow(j / (n + 1), MAP.rungPow);
       y = Math.round(f * H);
       a = (0.06 + 0.12 * f).toFixed(3);       /* far faint, near solid */
       g += ",transparent " + y + "px," + rasterInk(a) + " " + y + "px," +
           rasterInk(a) + " " + (y + 1) + "px,transparent " + (y + 1) + "px";
    }
    layers[layers.length] = g + ")";

    /* the fan. Widening the pitch on a wide chart keeps the number
       of gradient layers bounded whatever the window does. */
    if (pitch < W / 13) { pitch = W / 13; }
    n = Math.ceil((W * 0.62) / pitch) + 1;
    if (n > 7) { n = 7; }
    for (k = -n; k <= n; k++) {
        layers[layers.length] =
           rasterThrough(W, H, vx, vy, vx + k * pitch, H, rasterInk(0.13));
    }

    m.style.backgroundImage = layers.join(",");
}


/* ================================================================
  SECTION D : ACTIVITY FEED
  Informational only. Writing a line does not advance anything.
  ================================================================ */

function logLine(text) {
  STATE.feed[STATE.feed.length] = { t: stamp(), s: text };
  if (STATE.feed.length > 200) { STATE.feed.shift(); }
  renderFeed();
  refreshLogPopup();
  setStatus(); /* so an event logged mid-tick reaches the bar */
}

function renderFeed() {
  var box = $("feed");
  if (!box) { return; }
  /* NEWEST FIRST. The box is four lines tall on a good day, and
     with the oldest at the top the thing that just happened sat
     at the bottom of a two-hundred line scroll. The latest line
     is now the first line and no scrolling is needed to see it. */
  var html = "", i, f;
  for (i = STATE.feed.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      f = STATE.feed[i];
      html += '<div class="feed-line"><span class="feed-time num">' + f.t +
           '</span>' + f.s + '</div>';
    }
    box.innerHTML = html;
    box.scrollTop = 0;
}


/* ================================================================
  SECTION D-2 : THE ACTION ECONOMY
  The heartbeat of the entire game. One action = one tick of
  everything that is counting.

    HARD RULE: performAction() may only ever be called from inside
    a task window. Nothing on the idle screen may call it, directly
    or indirectly. Looking is free, and that is enforced by simply
    never wiring this to anything on the idle screen.
    ================================================================ */

function performAction(detail) {
  if (STATE.gameOver) { return; }
  actionCounter++;

    /* Cooldowns share the same discrete heartbeat as every other
       countdown. A committed action ticks existing cooldowns once. */
    tickActionCooldowns();

    /* every countdown, chain and pending outcome advances here,
      exactly once, before anything is reported to the player */
    tickWorld();

    /* THE FEED IS NOT A CLICK COUNTER. Writing "Action taken -
       Total actions: N" on every single action buried the things
       that actually happened: in a feed four lines deep, the
       engineer starting work or the filter hand throwing the
       switch scrolled away before the player could look at it.
       The tally lives in the status bar, where it belongs. Only
       the DETAIL - which is only ever set for a real commitment
       - reaches the log. */
    if (detail) { logLine(detail + "."); }
    if (!STATE.gameOver) { checkCommendations(); }
    setStatus();
}

/* The event engine hangs off this single call so that nothing
  else ever needs to know how time passes. */
function tickWorld() {
   /* wear BEFORE the task sweep, so a maintenance job finishing
     on this very action still leaves the engine at 100 */
   wearEngine();
   if (actionCounter % 20 === 0) { clampStat("energy", -1); }
   tickFilters();
   tickCrew();
   tickCleaner();
   checkLoss();
   if (STATE.gameOver) { return; }
   tickPayroll();
   tickOngoing();
   autoDesires();
   /* and only THEN may the engineer take the job on himself -
     added before tickOngoing, his own task would lose a step to
     the very action that spawned it */
   autoMaint();
    autoFilters();
    autoMess();
    tickIncidents();
    tickSim();
    checkLoss();
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
  ENGINE WEAR
  Counted in actions, never in seconds. The accumulator lives in
  STATE rather than being derived from actionCounter so that a
  future save file restores mid-step wear exactly as it was.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function wearEngine() {
   STATE.wearTick++;
   if (STATE.wearTick < ENGINE.wearEvery) { return; }

    STATE.wearTick = 0;
    STATE.engineCondition -= ENGINE.wearStep;
    if (STATE.engineCondition < 0) { STATE.engineCondition = 0; }

    paintIndicators();
    paintEngine();
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
  THE FILTER BANK
  Three slots, one charge, two hundred actions of clean air. The
  bank only burns while it is RUNNING - a seated canister sitting
  idle costs nothing. When the charge is gone the slots come out
  bare and the room has to be worked again.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function tickFilters() {
   var i, was;

    /* --- the bank is running: burn the charge --------------- */
    if (bankRunning()) {
       STATE.filterLife -= LIFE.decay;
       if (STATE.filterLife > 0) { refreshLifeInfo(); paintO2(); return; }

        STATE.filterLife = 0;
        for (i = 0; i < LIFE.slots.length; i++) { LIFE.slots[i].state = "empty"; }
        /* the room is still full of good air - it holds, and then
          it goes. This action does not also spend a step of it. */
        STATE.airHold = AIR.holdMax;
        logLine("Filter bank spent. The cabin air will hold for " +
              AIR.holdMax + " actions.");
        refreshLifeInfo();
        paintIndicators();
        paintO2();
        return;
    }

    /* --- no bank: the air in the room is what is left ------- */
    if (STATE.airHold <= 0) { return; }

    was = airStage();
    STATE.airHold--;
    if (airStage() !== was) {
       /* only the bottom is announced. The steps above it are a
          colour on a bar and a line in the sidebar - the player
          is expected to look, not to be told. */
       if (airStage() === 0) {
           logLine("The cabin air has gone foul. The crew are labouring.");
       }
       paintIndicators();
    }
    refreshLifeInfo();
    paintO2();
}

function slotsIn(state) {
   var i, n = 0;
   for (i = 0; i < LIFE.slots.length; i++) {
      if (LIFE.slots[i].state === state) { n++; }
   }
   return n;
}
function bankReady() { /* every slot seated, nothing running yet */
   return slotsIn("installed") === LIFE.slots.length;
}
function bankRunning() {
   return STATE.filterLife > 0 && statValue("energy").value > 0;
}
/* 4 down to 0. A running bank holds the top step; with no bank
  the stage follows the air left in the room. */
function airStage() {
   if (bankRunning()) { return 4; }
   var st = Math.ceil(STATE.airHold / AIR.step);
   if (st > 4) { st = 4; }
   if (st < 0) { st = 0; }
   return st;
}
function airSpec() { return AIR_STAGES[airStage()]; }
function airWord() { return airSpec().word; }
function airTone() { return airSpec().tone; }
/* how full the green indicator above the slots stands, 0-100 */
function airPercent() {
   if (bankRunning()) { return 100; }
   var p = Math.round((STATE.airHold / AIR.holdMax) * 100);
   if (p < 0) { p = 0; }
   return p;
}

/* ---- what the air does to the people breathing it ---------- */
function crewSlow() { return airSpec().slow; }
function crewCost(n) {
   var c = Math.ceil(n * crewSlow());
   return c < 1 ? 1 : c;
}
/* a crew member's own trigger point, after the air has had its
  say. Never pushed below 5 - nobody ignores a dead engine. */
function effectiveJobAt(w) {
   var v = w.jobAt - airSpec().jobDrop;
   return v < 5 ? 5 : v;
}
/* ONE PLACE THAT KNOWS WHAT "ACTS AT" MEANS, read by the roster
   panel and by the crew member's own window alike - so the two
   can never tell a different story about the same threshold. */
function jobThreshold(c) {
   if (c.job === "maintenance") { return effectiveJobAt(c) + "% condition"; }
   if (c.job === "filters") { return AIR_STAGES[c.jobAt].word + " air"; }
   if (c.job === "navigation") { return "Fuel use -" + navigatorDiscount(c) + "% when plotting"; }
   if (c.job === "cleaner") { return "Crew morale +1 every " + cleanerInterval(c) + " actions"; }
   if (c.job === "kitchen") {
      return c.jobAt + " ration" + (c.jobAt === 1 ? "" : "s") + " per action, cooking";
   }
   return "-";
}
function airPenalty() {
   var sp = airSpec();
   if (sp.slow === 1 && sp.jobDrop === 0) { return "None - the crew work normally"; }
   return "Crew work x" + sp.slow.toFixed(2) + ", thresholds -" + sp.jobDrop;
}

/* one canister leaves the rack per commitment, and the two
  actions that seat it are spent anywhere aboard */
var O2_CLAIM = false;
function startInstall(e, i) {
   var sl = LIFE.slots[i];
   if (!sl || sl.state !== "empty") { return; }
   if (findOngoing("o2s" + i))         { return; }
   if (LIFE.canisters <= 0) {
       logLine("No canisters left in the rack.");
       return;
   }
   LIFE.canisters--;
   O2_CLAIM = true;
   try { fireAction(e, "Canister carried to " + sl.name); }
   finally { O2_CLAIM = false; }
   paintResources();
   /* NOT passed as the task target: addOngoing stores
      (target || null) and slot 0 is a perfectly good zero that
      would be thrown away. The index rides in its own field. */
   var task = addOngoing("o2s" + i, "Seating - " + sl.name, 2,
                     "o2slot", sl.id);
   if (task)
 { task.slot = i; }
   refreshLifeInfo();
   paintO2();
}
function installFn(i) {
   return function (e) { startInstall(e, i); };
}

/* THE REWARD. One ordinary action to throw the switch, and then
  ten actions of progress that cost nothing and wear nothing. */
function turnOnFilter(e) {
   if (!bankReady() || bankRunning() || statValue("energy").value <= 0) { return; }
   O2_CLAIM = true;
   try { fireAction(e, "Filter bank started"); }
   finally { O2_CLAIM = false; }
   if (statValue("energy").value <= 0) { logLine("The filter switch needs power."); paintO2(); return; }
   runBank("Filters activated. Air purified. +10 Pro-Action.");
}

/* The machine does not care whose hand is on the switch: the
  burst is the machine's, not the person's. Only the feed line
  differs, and the commander pays an action for his. */
function runBank(line) {
   var i;
   for (i = 0; i < LIFE.slots.length; i++) { LIFE.slots[i].state = "active"; }
   STATE.filterLife = LIFE.lifeMax;
   STATE.chronicle.banks++;

    proAction(10);
    checkCommendations();
    logLine(line);
    refreshLifeInfo();
    paintIndicators();
    paintO2();
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
  THE CREW, ONE ACTION AT A TIME
  Nobody is harmed quickly. Bad air takes a point of health off
  everyone every few actions; a hand doing work he was never
  taught loses heart slowly; a body in the medical bay is simply
  not aboard for a while. Hunger and fatigue advance here too.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* ---- WAGES ------------------------------------------------ */
function wageOf(c) {
   var j = findById(JOBS, c.job || "");
   return (j && j.wage) ? j.wage : 0;
}
function payrollBill() {
   var i, n = 0;
   for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) { n += wageOf(CREW[i]); }
   return n;
}
function payrollDue() {
   var left = PAY.every - STATE.payTick;
   return left < 0 ? 0 : left;
}

/* Payday. Dearest first, because the jobs that cost most are the
  ones keeping everybody breathing. A hand the purse cannot
  reach loses the job there and then - and walks to the
  corridor, where the player can see exactly what he could not
  afford. */
function tickPayroll() {
   STATE.payTick++;
   if (STATE.payTick < PAY.every) { return; }
   STATE.payTick = 0;

    var list = [], i, j, c, paid = 0, spent = 0, cut = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) {
       if (wageOf(CREW[i]) > 0) { list[list.length] = CREW[i]; }
    }
    if (list.length === 0) {
      logLine("Payday. Nobody on the payroll - nothing owed.");
      return;
    }
    /* plain insertion sort, dearest first - no Array.sort callback
      worth trusting across Trident document modes */
    for (i = 1; i < list.length; i++) {
       c = list[i];
       for (j = i - 1; j >= 0 && wageOf(list[j]) < wageOf(c); j--) {
          list[j + 1] = list[j];
       }
       list[j + 1] = c;
    }

    for (i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
       c = list[i];
       if (STATE.shiplets >= wageOf(c)) {
          STATE.shiplets -= wageOf(c);
          /* the only line in the whole file allowed to write a
             wallet - see the OWNERSHIP comment above var CREW */
          c.wallet = (c.wallet || 0) + wageOf(c);
          spent += wageOf(c);
          paid++;
       } else {
          layOff(c, "could not be paid");
          cut++;
       }
    }
    logLine("Payday. " + spent + " sh to " + paid + " hand" +
          (paid === 1 ? "" : "s") + ". " + STATE.shiplets + " sh left.");
    if (cut > 0) {
       logLine("The purse came up short. " + cut + " hand" +
             (cut === 1 ? " is" : "s are") + " off the payroll.");
    }
    paintIndicators();
    paintCrewScreen();
}

/* OFF THE PAYROLL IS NOT OFF THE SHIP. There is nowhere to put a
  man in deep space: he keeps his bunk, keeps his name on the
  roster, and loses only the work and the wage. */
function layOff(c, why) {
   if (!c.job) { return; }
   var j = findById(JOBS, c.job);
   c.job      = "";
   c.morale = Math.max(0, c.morale - PAY.hit);
   c.activity = "Idle in the corridor";
   logLine(c.name + " - " + why + " - is off the " +
         (j ? j.label.toLowerCase() : "") + " job.");
   simRemember("Work", c.name + " left the " + (j ? j.label.toLowerCase() : "") + " job: " + why + ".", c.id);
}

function tickCrew() {
  var i, c, sp = airSpec();
  STATE.crewTick++;

    /* the air gets into people */
    if (sp.harm > 0 && STATE.crewTick % sp.harm === 0) {
       for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) {
          CREW[i].health = Math.max(0, CREW[i].health - 1);
       }
       logLine("The air is telling on the crew.");
    }

    /* an untrained hand holding a job loses heart */
    if (STATE.crewTick % 10 === 0) {
       for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) {
          c = CREW[i];
          if (c.job && (c.skill === "Untrained" || !c.skill)) {
             c.morale = Math.max(0, c.morale - 1);
          }
          c.fatigue = c.job ? Math.min(100, c.fatigue + 1) : Math.max(0, c.fatigue - 2);
       }
    }

    /* HUNGER. Each crew member keeps their own clock, staggered
       on purpose (see hungerTick's comment on Rell) so the ship
       never has all four wanting the rack on the same action.
       Eating is quiet and resets hunger hard; an empty rack is
       NOT a crisis on its own - hunger simply keeps climbing,
       same as an unpaid wage costs morale instead of ending the
       game. One warning only, same trick as the canister rack. */
    for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) {
       c = CREW[i];
       c.hungerTick = (c.hungerTick || 0) + 1;
       if (c.hungerTick < MESS_EVERY) { continue; }
       c.hungerTick = 0;
       if (MESS.rack > 0) {
          MESS.rack--;
          c.hunger = Math.max(0, c.hunger - 40);
          STATE.rackWarnedMess = false;
          paintResources();
          paintMess();
       } else {
          c.hunger = Math.min(100, c.hunger + 15);
          if (!STATE.rackWarnedMess) {
             logLine("The ration rack is empty. The crew are going hungry.");
             STATE.rackWarnedMess = true;
          }
       }
    }

    /* STARVATION. Slow, same law as bad air: a point of health,
       not a crisis, and only for the ones actually starving. */
    if (STATE.crewTick % MESS_STARVE_EVERY === 0) {
       for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) {
          c = CREW[i];
          if (c.hunger >= MESS_STARVE) {
             c.health = Math.max(0, c.health - 1);
          }
       }
    }
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
  THE COOK
  Same shape as the engineer and the filter hand: a job held on a
  crew record, acted on without being asked, acted on TOO LATE if
  nobody has trained him. He tops the rack up to capacity and
  stops - there is nowhere else for a ration to go. */
function autoMess() {
   var w = assignedCook(), cost;
   if (COOK_CLAIM || PROJECT_CLAIM === "food" || findOngoing("project-food")) { return; }
   if (!w || findOngoing("cook"))     { return; }
   if (crewBusy(w))                { return; } /* carrying out orders */
   /* waits for the rack to actually run low, same as the engineer
      waits for real wear and the filter hand waits for real bad
      air - nobody tops up a half-full larder for no reason. */
   if (MESS.rack > Math.floor(MESS.capacity / 2)) { return; }
   if (MESS.rack >= MESS.capacity)     { return; } /* nothing to cook for */

    cost = crewCost(Math.ceil((MESS.capacity - MESS.rack) / w.jobAt));
    var t = addOngoing("cook", "Cooking - " + w.name, cost, "cook", "mess");
    if (t) { t.by = w.name; t.rate = w.jobAt; }
    logLine(w.name + " started cooking without being asked.");
    paintIndicators();
    paintMess();
}

/* Navigation reduces fuel, never travel time; a busy navigator
   cannot plot a more efficient course. Training raises the saving. */
function assignedNavigator() {
   var i, c;
   for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) {
      c = CREW[i]; if (c.job === "navigation" && !crewBusy(c)) { return c; }
   }
   return null;
}
function navigatorDiscount(c) { return 4 * Math.max(1, Math.min(5, c.jobAt || 1)); }
function cleanerInterval(c) { return Math.max(20, 40 - 4 * Math.min(5, c.jobAt || 0)); }
/* Only the best available cleaner determines the interval, so
   hiring several never multiplies morale without bound. */
function tickCleaner() {
   var i, c, best = null;
   for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) {
      c = CREW[i];
      if (c.job === "cleaner" && !crewBusy(c) && (!best || cleanerInterval(c) < cleanerInterval(best))) { best = c; }
   }
   if (!best || actionCounter % cleanerInterval(best)) { return; }
   for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) { CREW[i].morale = Math.min(100, CREW[i].morale + 1); }
}
function assignedFilterHand() {
  var i;
  for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) {
     if (CREW[i].job === "filters") { return CREW[i]; }
  }
  return null;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
  THE FILTER HAND
  Same shape as the engineer: a job held on a crew record, acted
  on without being asked, and acted on TOO LATE because nobody
  has trained him. He seats one canister at a time - he has two
  hands - and throws the switch himself once all three are in.
  Everything he does is slowed by the very air he is fixing.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function autoFilters() {
   var w = assignedFilterHand(), i, sl;
   if (O2_CLAIM || STATE.filterLife > 0 || statValue("energy").value <= 0) { return; }
   if (!w || bankRunning())           { return; }
   if (crewBusy(w))                 { return; } /* carrying out orders */
   if (airStage() > w.jobAt)          { return; } /* not bad enough yet */

    if (bankReady()) {           /* all three in - throw the switch */
       runBank(w.name + " started the filter bank. Air purified. " +
             "+10 Pro-Action.");
       return;
    }
    if (LIFE.canisters <= 0) {
       if (!STATE.rackWarned) {
          logLine(w.name + " went for a canister. The rack is empty.");
          STATE.rackWarned = true;
       }
       return;
    }
    STATE.rackWarned = false;

    /* one slot at a time, and only if he is not already on one */
    for (i = 0; i < LIFE.slots.length; i++) {
       if (findOngoing("o2s" + i)) { return; }
    }
    for (i = 0; i < LIFE.slots.length; i++) {
       sl = LIFE.slots[i];
       if (sl.state !== "empty") { continue; }
       LIFE.canisters--;
       paintResources();
       var t = addOngoing("o2s" + i, "Seating - " + sl.name,
                      crewCost(2), "o2slot", sl.id);
       if (t) { t.slot = i; t.by = w.name; }
       logLine(w.name + " is seating a canister in " + sl.name + ".");
       refreshLifeInfo();
       paintIndicators();
       paintO2();
       return;
    }
}

function refreshLifeInfo() {
  var n = findById(INFOS, "life");
  if (n) { n.value = lifeSummary(); }
}

/* The assigned engineer starts maintenance HIMSELF once the drive
  has fallen to his threshold. It costs the player no click - only
  the ordinary drain of actions spent elsewhere, like any other
  running work. An untrained hand waits until 30%, which is well
  past the warning line: the ship is already limping by then. */
/* Set while the commander's own click is in flight. startMaint
  spends the action BEFORE it registers the task, and spending an
  action runs tickWorld - which used to let the engineer grab the
  job in that gap and leave TWO maintenance tasks on one engine. */
var MAINT_CLAIM = false;
var COOK_CLAIM = false; /* same race, same fix - see MAINT_CLAIM above */

function autoMaint() {
  var w = assignedEngineer();
  if (MAINT_CLAIM || PROJECT_CLAIM === "cooling" || findOngoing("project-cooling")) { return; }
  if (!w || maintRunning()) { return; }
  if (crewBusy(w))        { return; } /* carrying out orders */
  if (STATE.engineCondition > effectiveJobAt(w)) { return; }
  if (STATE.engineCondition >= 100)              { return; }

    /* bad air makes him both later and slower */
    var t = addOngoing("maint-eng", "Maintenance - " + w.name,
                  crewCost(maintCost()), "maint", "engine");
    if (t) { t.by = w.name; }
    logLine(w.name + " has started maintenance without being asked.");
    paintIndicators();
    paintEngine();
}

/* 1 action of work per 10% missing, rounded up. A perfect engine
  costs 0, which is the same as saying it cannot be maintained. */
function maintCost() {
   return Math.ceil((100 - STATE.engineCondition) / ENGINE.perAction);
}

/* only one maintenance job at a time, whoever is holding the
  spanner */
function maintRunning() {
   return findOngoing("maint") || findOngoing("maint-eng") || findOngoing("project-cooling");
}

/* the Engineer counts as present only if he is actually IN the
  engine room - a crew member elsewhere cannot be ordered here */
function assignedEngineer() {
   var i;
   for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) {
      if (CREW[i].job === "maintenance") { return CREW[i]; }
   }
   return null;
}

function assignedCook() {
   var i;
   for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) {
      if (CREW[i].job === "kitchen") { return CREW[i]; }
   }
   return null;
}


/* ================================================================
  SECTION D-4 : ONGOING TASK ENGINE
  A committed process does not run on a clock. It runs on the
  player's attention: it advances only when an action is spent
  somewhere else in the game.
  ================================================================ */

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
  TASK TYPES - the dispatch table.
  The engine does not know what a task MEANS. It counts down, and
  then asks this table what that meant. Two hooks:
    onDone         - the counter just hit zero, nobody has looked
    onAcknowledge - the player clicked the finished button
  A repair, a hail, a refit or a random encounter is a row here
  plus a button that starts it. The engine itself never changes.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
var TASK_TYPES = {
   travel : {
      onDone          : null,
      onAcknowledge : function (t) { if (t.target) { arriveAt(t.target); } }
   },
   scan : {
      onDone          : null,
      onAcknowledge : function (t) { revealScan(t.target); }
   },
   /* Maintenance has nothing to hand
over: the engine is simply
     whole again. autoClear tells the engine to retire the task
     the moment it finishes, so the button returns to its idle
     label instead of waiting to be acknowledged. */
  /* a crew member carrying out the orders written for them.
     The payload rides on the task; the effects land when the
     work is finished, not when it was ordered. */
  /* THE SHEET. Only a gate and a bar: it holds the order pad
     shut until all the work on it has been paid for. It does
     not carry anybody's orders any more. */
  crewOrder : {
      autoClear : true,
      quiet : true, /* it names itself when it lands */
      onDone : function (t) {
         logLine("The order sheet is discharged.");
         paintCrewScreen();
      },
      onAcknowledge : null
  },
  /* ONE PAIR OF HANDS. Their own share of the sheet, their own
     countdown, their own release - a one-action errand is over
     in one action even if the sheet around it runs to fifteen. */
  crewJob : {
      autoClear : true,
      quiet : true, /* it names itself when it lands */
      onDone : function (t) {
         var c = findById(CREW, t.who);
         if (c) { applyOrderPayload(c, t.orders); }
         paintCrewScreen();
      },
      onAcknowledge : null
  },
  /* a body in the medical bay. Its own countdown, because the
     doc keeps them long after the order sheet is finished. */
  crewDoc : {
      autoClear : true,
      quiet : true, /* it names itself when it lands */
      onDone : function (t) {
         var c = findById(CREW, t.who);
         if (c) {
            c.health = Math.min(100, c.health + 12);
            c.activity = "Back on station";
            logLine(c.name + " is back from the medical bay.");
            simRemember("Care", c.name + " recovered in the medical bay.", c.id);
         }
         paintCrewScreen();
      },
      onAcknowledge : null
  },

 /* seating a canister: no readout to collect, so it clears
   itself the moment the second action lands */
 o2slot : {
          autoClear : true,
          quiet : true, /* it names itself when it lands */
          onDone : function (t) {
             var sl = LIFE.slots[t.slot];
             if (sl) { sl.state = "installed"; }
             logLine("Canister seated in " + (sl ? sl.name : "a slot") + ".");
             refreshLifeInfo();
             paintO2();
          },
          onAcknowledge : null
     },

     maint : {
       autoClear : true,
       quiet : true, /* it names itself when it lands */
       onDone : function (t) {
          STATE.engineCondition = 100;
          STATE.wearTick         = 0;
          logLine("Engine maintenance completed by " +
               (t.by || "the commander") + ".");
          paintIndicators();
          paintEngine();
       },
       onAcknowledge : null
     },

     /* THE GALLEY. t.rate rations land on the rack for every
        action this task is credited with, capped at MESS.capacity
        so a burst of pro-action cannot overflow the counter. The
        rack moves live, mid-bake - onDone only announces that the
        pot is finally empty again. */
     cook : {
        autoClear : true,
        quiet : true, /* the rack moving is its own announcement */
        onTick : function (t, n) {
           MESS.rack = Math.min(MESS.capacity, MESS.rack + n * (t.rate || 1));
           paintResources();
           paintMess();
        },
        onDone : function (t) {
           logLine((t.by || "Someone") + " finished cooking a fresh batch.");
           paintMess();
        },
        onAcknowledge : null
     }
};

function taskHook(t, name) {
  var h = TASK_TYPES[t.type];
  return (h && h[name]) ? h[name] : null;
}

/* type defaults to the id, so a one-off task needs no extra
  argument; target is whatever the task is being done TO. */
function addOngoing(id, label, total, type, target) {
   if (findOngoing(id)) { return null; }
   var t = { id:id, label:label, total:total, left:total, state:"running",
          type:(type || id), target:(target || null) };
   STATE.ongoing[STATE.ongoing.length] = t;
   paintIndicators();         /* a new line appears in the strip */
   return t;
}

function findOngoing(id) {
  var i;
  for (i = 0; i < STATE.ongoing.length; i++) {
     if (STATE.ongoing[i].id === id) { return STATE.ongoing[i]; }
  }
  return null;
}

function clearOngoing(id) {
    var i, keep = [];
    for (i = 0; i < STATE.ongoing.length; i++) {
       if (STATE.ongoing[i].id !== id) { keep[keep.length] = STATE.ongoing[i]; }
    }
    STATE.ongoing = keep;
    paintIndicators();     /* its line leaves the strip */
}

/* Some finished tasks have no readout to hand over. Rather than
  leave a "Complete" button the player must clear for no reason,
  the type can declare autoClear and the engine retires it here -
  after the countdown loop, never during it. */
function sweepAutoTasks() {
   var i, t, keep = [], spec;
   for (i = 0; i < STATE.ongoing.length; i++) {
      t = STATE.ongoing[i];
      spec = TASK_TYPES[t.type];
      if (t.state === "done" && spec && spec.autoClear) { continue; }
      keep[keep.length] = t;
   }
   STATE.ongoing = keep;
}

/* Called once per action, from tickWorld only. */
/* Move every running task forward by n and fire the hooks of
  anything that lands on zero. Split out of tickOngoing because
  an action is no longer the only thing that can advance work:
  the filter bank grants a burst of ten. */
function advanceTasks(n) {
   var i, t, hook, tick, used, k, spec, done = 0, quiet = 0, list = [];

    /* Walk a SNAPSHOT. An onDone hook is allowed to queue work -
      the medical bay does exactly that - and a task created
      half way through this loop must not be docked a step by
      the very tick that gave birth to it. It also means a hook
      may clear a task without the loop losing its place. */
    for (i = 0; i < STATE.ongoing.length; i++) {
       list[list.length] = STATE.ongoing[i];
    }
    for (i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
       t = list[i];
       if (t.state !== "running") { continue; }
       if ((t.type === "travel" && (STATE.engineCondition <= 0 || statValue("energy").value <= 0)) ||
           ((t.type === "scan" || t.type === "salvage" || (t.type === "shipProject" && t.target !== "social")) &&
            statValue("energy").value <= 0)) { continue; }

        /* ONTICK - new with the Mess Hall. Everything else only
           ever hands over its readout at the END (onDone) - the
           galley is the first job that produces something WHILE
           it runs, so the rack can be drawn down by a hungry
           crew member mid-bake, same as the real counter would
           be. used is clamped to what is actually left, so a
           ten-action pro-action burst landing on the last two
           actions of a bake cannot credit it for ten. */
        tick = taskHook(t, "onTick");
        if (tick) { used = (n < t.left) ? n : t.left; tick(t, used); }

        t.left -= n;
       if (t.left <= 0) {
          t.left = 0;
          t.state = "done";
          hook = taskHook(t, "onDone"); /* the engine asks, it does not decide */
          if (hook) { hook(t); }
          done++;
          spec = TASK_TYPES[t.type];
          if (!spec || !spec.quiet) { quiet++; }
       }
    }
    sweepAutoTasks();           /* retire anything with nothing to collect */
    if (done > 0) { playActionSound("complete"); }

    /* Deliberately vague. The main screen never says what
      finished - the player goes and looks. */
    /* The vague ping exists so the player must go and LOOK - it
      is right for a scan or a crossing. A task that already
      announces itself by name ("Canister seated in Slot 2")
      does not need it as well: two lines for one event is how
      the feed drowned in the first place. */
    for (k = 0; k < quiet; k++) {
       logLine("A ship process has completed.");
    }
    return done;
}

function tickOngoing() {
  var any = (advanceTasks(1) > 0);
  repaintQueue(any);
}

/* every screen that draws the queue, refreshed in one place */
function repaintQueue(any) {
   paintIndicators();       /* every line moved */
   /* a finished task can change what the nav buttons should say,
      so rebuild them rather than leave a stale label on screen */
   if (any && $("nav-actions")) { paintNavPanels(); }
   if (any && (STATE.activeTab.indexOf("room:") === 0 || STATE.activeTab.indexOf("crew:") === 0)) { switchTab(STATE.activeTab); }
   if ($("eng-actions")) { paintEngine(); }
   if ($("o2-actions")) { paintO2(); }
   if ($("mess-actions")) { paintMess(); }
   if ($("cq-band")) { paintCrewScreen(); }
   paintResources();
   updateProgressUI();
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
  PRO-ACTION
  A burst of progress that is NOT an action. The counter does not
  move, the engine does not wear, no red bar advances - only the
  player's own committed work jumps forward. This is the whole
  reward of the filter bank, and the first thing in the game that
  gives time back instead of taking it.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function proAction(n) {
   var any = (advanceTasks(n) > 0);
   repaintQueue(any);
}

function ongoingPercent(t) {
  if (!t || !t.total) { return 0; }
  return Math.floor(((t.total - t.left) / t.total) * 100);
}
/* ================================================================
  SECTION D-5 : PROGRESS BUTTON COMPONENT
  Three states: idle (click to commit), running (inert, bar
  fills), done (click to acknowledge and reset). No numbers,
  ever - the bar is the only readout.
  ================================================================ */

var PROGRESS_UI = {}; /* taskId -> live DOM refs for the current screen */
var ACTION_COOLDOWN_RULES = {
  routine:{actions:5, label:"Routine"},
  systems:{actions:10, label:"Ship systems"},
  space:{actions:15, label:"Space operations"},
  critical:{actions:20, label:"Critical"}
};
var ACTION_COOLDOWN_CONTROLS = {}; /* currently rendered UI refs; counts live in STATE */
var COMMAND_ROW_COUNTS = {}; /* disambiguates repeated labels within one rendered task */

/* Action cooldowns use the game's action clock, never wall-clock time.
   A key identifies one control across redraws; the selected task tab is
   part of the key so separate windows do not accidentally share a lock. */
function actionCooldownKey(id) {
  return "cd|" + (STATE && STATE.activeTab ? STATE.activeTab : "home") + "|" + String(id || "action");
}
function actionCooldownCategory(subject, preferred) {
  var s, category = preferred || "";
  if (ACTION_COOLDOWN_RULES.hasOwnProperty(category)) { return category; }
  s = String(subject || "").toLowerCase();
  if (/signal|archive|buy larger ship|commissioned sc|permanent|irreversible|jettison|abandon/.test(s)) { return "critical"; }
  if (/navigation|travel|jump|course|dock|undock|watch|crossing|salvage|scan|route|space|traffic report/.test(s)) { return "space"; }
  if (/^(buy|sell|accept|collect|hire)\b/.test(s)) { return "routine"; }
  if (/o2|oxygen|filter|engine|maintenance|cook|project|medical|treat|incident|resolve|assign|sensor|shield|power|recycl|workshop|hydropon|fuel reserve|damage control|thermal|package|hull|repair|service|recharge|transfer|split|upgrade|expand|cargo hold|efficient drive|rack/.test(s)) { return "systems"; }
  return "routine";
}
function actionCooldownFor(key) {
  return STATE && STATE.actionCooldowns && STATE.actionCooldowns[key] ? STATE.actionCooldowns[key] : null;
}
function suppressActionClick(e) {
  if (e && e.preventDefault) { e.preventDefault(); }
  if (e && e.stopPropagation) { e.stopPropagation(); }
  if (e) { e.cancelBubble = true; }
}
function paintActionCooldownControl(control) {
  var cooldown, remaining, el, spans, tier;
  if (!control) { return; }
  cooldown = actionCooldownFor(control.key);
  remaining = cooldown ? cooldown.remaining : 0;
  tier = cooldown && ACTION_COOLDOWN_RULES[cooldown.category] ? ACTION_COOLDOWN_RULES[cooldown.category].label : "Action";
  if (control.kind === "command") {
    el = control.element; if (!el) { return; }
    el.className = control.baseClass + (remaining > 0 ? " act-cooldown" : "");
    if (remaining > 0) {
      if (el.setAttribute) { el.setAttribute("aria-disabled", "true"); }
      el.title = tier + " cooldown: " + remaining + " more actions. Other committed actions advance it; waiting does not.";
    } else {
      if (el.removeAttribute) { el.removeAttribute("aria-disabled"); }
      el.title = control.idleTitle || "";
    }
    spans = el.getElementsByTagName ? el.getElementsByTagName("span") : null;
    if (spans && spans.length) { spans[0].innerHTML = remaining > 0 ? "COOLDOWN " + remaining : control.idleCost; }
  } else if (control.kind === "progress" && PROGRESS_UI[control.taskId]) {
    paintProgress(control.taskId);
  }
}
function registerActionCooldownControl(control) {
  ACTION_COOLDOWN_CONTROLS[control.key] = control;
  paintActionCooldownControl(control);
}
function paintActionCooldowns() {
  var key;
  for (key in ACTION_COOLDOWN_CONTROLS) {
    if (ACTION_COOLDOWN_CONTROLS.hasOwnProperty(key)) { paintActionCooldownControl(ACTION_COOLDOWN_CONTROLS[key]); }
  }
}
function tickActionCooldowns() {
  var key, cooldown;
  if (!STATE.actionCooldowns) { STATE.actionCooldowns = {}; }
  for (key in STATE.actionCooldowns) {
    if (!STATE.actionCooldowns.hasOwnProperty(key)) { continue; }
    cooldown = STATE.actionCooldowns[key];
    cooldown.remaining--;
    if (cooldown.remaining <= 0) { delete STATE.actionCooldowns[key]; }
  }
  paintActionCooldowns();
}
function commitActionButton(e, key, category, callback) {
  var cooldown = actionCooldownFor(key), before = actionCounter, result;
  if (cooldown && cooldown.remaining > 0) {
    suppressActionClick(e); paintActionCooldowns(); return false;
  }
  try { result = callback(e); }
  finally {
    /* Some visible controls can become invalid between paint and click.
       Only start their lock if the callback really committed an action. */
    if (actionCounter > before) {
      if (!STATE.actionCooldowns) { STATE.actionCooldowns = {}; }
      category = actionCooldownCategory(key, category);
      STATE.actionCooldowns[key] = {category:category, remaining:ACTION_COOLDOWN_RULES[category].actions};
    }
    paintActionCooldowns();
  }
  return result;
}

function isActionCost(cost) {
  return cost === undefined || cost === null || /\baction(?:s)?\b/i.test(String(cost));
}

function buildProgressButton(taskId, idleLabel, startFn, enabled, doneLabel, cooldownCategory) {
  var wrap = make("div", "pbtn");
  var fill = make("div", "pbtn-fill");
  var text = make("div", "pbtn-text", idleLabel);
  var cooldownKey = actionCooldownKey("progress:" + taskId);
  var category = actionCooldownCategory(taskId + " " + idleLabel, cooldownCategory);
  wrap.appendChild(fill);
  wrap.appendChild(text);

    PROGRESS_UI[taskId] = {
       wrap:wrap, fill:fill, text:text,
       idleLabel:idleLabel, doneLabel:(doneLabel || "Complete"),
       enabled:(enabled !== false), cooldownKey:cooldownKey, cooldownCategory:category
    };

    registerActionCooldownControl({key:cooldownKey, kind:"progress", taskId:taskId});
    on(wrap, "click", function (e) { onProgressClick(e, taskId, startFn); });
    paintProgress(taskId);
    return wrap;
}

function onProgressClick(e, taskId, startFn) {
  var ui = PROGRESS_UI[taskId];
  var t = findOngoing(taskId);
  var hook;

    if (t && t.state === "running") { return; }         /* inert */
    if (t && t.state === "done") {                  /* acknowledge */
       /* WHAT a finished task means is not decided here. The type
          table is asked: travel moves the ship, a scan hands over
          its readout, the next one will do something else. */
       hook = taskHook(t, "onAcknowledge");
       if (hook) { hook(t); }
       clearOngoing(taskId);
       paintProgress(taskId);
       logLine("Process acknowledged and cleared.");
       /* the surrounding screen may describe the process too */
       if ($("nav-actions")) {
           drawMapRoutes();
           drawMapBodies();
           paintNavPanels();
       }
       return;
    }
    if (ui && !ui.enabled) { return; }               /* nothing selected */
    return commitActionButton(e, ui ? ui.cooldownKey : actionCooldownKey("progress:" + taskId),
      ui ? ui.cooldownCategory : actionCooldownCategory(taskId), function () { return startFn(e); });
}

function paintProgress(taskId) {
  var ui = PROGRESS_UI[taskId];
  if (!ui) { return; }
  var t = findOngoing(taskId), cooldown = actionCooldownFor(ui.cooldownKey);

    if (!t) {
       ui.fill.style.width = "0";
       if (cooldown && cooldown.remaining > 0) {
         var tier = ACTION_COOLDOWN_RULES[cooldown.category];
         ui.wrap.className = "pbtn pbtn-cooldown";
         ui.text.innerHTML = "Cooldown: " + cooldown.remaining + " actions";
         ui.wrap.title = (tier ? tier.label : "Action") + " cooldown. Other committed actions advance it; waiting does not.";
       } else {
         ui.wrap.className = "pbtn" + (ui.enabled ? "" : " pbtn-off");
         ui.text.innerHTML = ui.idleLabel;
         ui.wrap.title = "";
       }
       return;
    }
    if (t.state === "done") {
       ui.wrap.className = "pbtn pbtn-done";
       ui.fill.style.width = "100%";
       ui.text.innerHTML = ui.doneLabel;
       return;
    }
    ui.wrap.className = "pbtn pbtn-run";
    ui.fill.style.width = ongoingPercent(t) + "%";
    ui.text.innerHTML = t.label;
}

function updateProgressUI() {
  var k;
  for (k in PROGRESS_UI) {
     if (PROGRESS_UI.hasOwnProperty(k)) { paintProgress(k); }
  }
  /* the ring on the chart advances with the bar */
  if ($("map-bodies")) { drawMapBodies(); }
}

function setProgressEnabled(taskId, on) {
  var ui = PROGRESS_UI[taskId];
  if (!ui) { return; }
  ui.enabled = on;
  paintProgress(taskId);
}

/* Convenience wrapper for wiring a live action button. Keeps the
  three concerns - feedback, sound, time - in one place so no
  future action can accidentally skip one. */
/* the cosmetics of an action, split out so a BATCH can leave one
  mark without pretending to be one action */
function actionMark(e, detail) {
   try {
      var m = mousePoint(e);
      spawnActionMark(m.x, m.y);
      playActionSound(detail);
    } catch (err) { /* a lost sparkle is not a lost action */ }
}

function fireAction(e, detail) {
  /* The cosmetics run first because the mark must appear where
    the hand was, but they are fenced off: a throw in any of
    them used to abort the whole handler and the player lost
    the click they paid for. The action is the only part that
    matters and it is now unconditional. */
  actionMark(e, detail);
  performAction(detail);
}


/* ================================================================
  SECTION D-3 : PROTAGONIST MOUSE
  The cursor is the player's physical presence. A spent action
  must be felt, not just counted.
  ================================================================ */

var FX = {
   size : 11, /* mark box in px - keep in sync with .amark */
   hold : 220, /* ms it sits still at full strength first */
   rise : 26,
   maxMarks : 5, /* live marks; each owns a timer, see below */ /* pixels travelled upward */
   duration : 950, /* ms of the slow rise and fade */
   frame : 16 /* ms between frames */
};

function mousePoint(e) {
  var ev = e || window.event;
  var sx = 0, sy = 0;
  if (document.documentElement) {
     sx = document.documentElement.scrollLeft || 0;
     sy = document.documentElement.scrollTop || 0;
  }
  if (!sx && document.body) { sx = document.body.scrollLeft || 0; }
  if (!sy && document.body) { sy = document.body.scrollTop || 0; }
  return { x: ev.clientX + sx, y: ev.clientY + sy };
}

/* opacity written twice: the modern property and the Trident
  filter, because which one works depends on the document mode
  the HTA ends up in */
function setOpacity(el, v) {
   if (v < 0) { v = 0; }
   if (v > 1) { v = 1; }
   el.style.opacity = v;
   el.style.filter = "alpha(opacity=" + Math.round(v * 100) + ")";
}

/* Every mark owns a 16ms timer for over a second. Hammering the
  mouse used to stack a dozen of them on Trident's single thread,
  which is its own way of losing input. The list is capped: the
  oldest mark is retired early rather than letting them pile up. */
var MARKS = [];

function retireMark(rec) {
  var i;
  if (rec.timer) { window.clearInterval(rec.timer); rec.timer = null; }
  if (rec.el && rec.el.parentNode) { rec.el.parentNode.removeChild(rec.el); }
  for (i = 0; i < MARKS.length; i++) {
     if (MARKS[i] === rec) { MARKS.splice(i, 1); return; }
  }
}

function spawnActionMark(x, y) {
  if (STATE.reducedMotion) { return; }
  var half = Math.floor(FX.size / 2);
  var top0 = y - half;

    var el = make("div", "amark",
       '<div class="amark-h"></div><div class="amark-v"></div>');
    el.style.left = (x - half) + "px";
    el.style.top = top0 + "px";
    document.body.appendChild(el);

    var rec = { el:el, timer:null };
    MARKS[MARKS.length] = rec;
    while (MARKS.length > FX.maxMarks) { retireMark(MARKS[0]); }

    var start = new Date().getTime();
    rec.timer = window.setInterval(function () {
       var elapsed = new Date().getTime() - start;

      /* phase 1 - land and stay put, so the player registers
         where their hand actually was */
      if (elapsed < FX.hold) { return; }

       /* phase 2 - slow drift upward while fading */
       var t = (elapsed - FX.hold) / FX.duration;
       if (t >= 1) {
          retireMark(rec);
          return;
       }
       /* ease-in-out: creeps off, drifts, settles as it vanishes */
       var ease = t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
       el.style.top = (top0 - FX.rise * ease) + "px";
       setOpacity(el, 1 - t);
    }, FX.frame);
}

/* --- self-contained sound and music ---------------------------
  The game stays offline and single-file: modern browser previews
  use a tiny synthesized Web Audio soundscape; HTA builds fall back
  to short, generated PCM WAV data URIs. Nothing external is fetched. */
var SOUND = {
  context:null, master:null, effects:null, music:null,
  musicNodes:[], musicTimer:null, musicIndex:0, musicStarted:false,
  fallbackMusic:null, fallbackEffects:{}, wavCache:{}
};
function audioLevel() {
  var n = STATE && STATE.options ? parseFloat(STATE.options.audioLevel) : 0.4;
  if (!isFinite(n)) { n = 0.4; }
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n));
}
function makeGain(ctx, value, destination) {
  var g = ctx.createGain ? ctx.createGain() : ctx.createGainNode();
  g.gain.value = value; g.connect(destination); return g;
}
function ensureAudioContext() {
  if (SOUND.context) { return SOUND.context; }
  var C = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
  if (!C) { return null; }
  try {
    SOUND.context = new C();
    SOUND.master = makeGain(SOUND.context, audioLevel() * 0.62, SOUND.context.destination);
    SOUND.effects = makeGain(SOUND.context, 0.8, SOUND.master);
    SOUND.music = makeGain(SOUND.context, 0.18, SOUND.master);
  } catch (err) { SOUND.context = null; SOUND.master = null; SOUND.effects = null; SOUND.music = null; }
  return SOUND.context;
}
function audioPlay(node, rewind) {
  if (!node) { return; }
  try {
    if (rewind) { node.currentTime = 0; }
    var result = node.play();
    if (result && result.catch) { result.catch(function () {}); }
  } catch (err) { /* audio is optional; never interrupt a ship action */ }
}
function fallbackAudio(kind) {
  var node, key = kind;
  if (kind === "music") {
    if (SOUND.fallbackMusic) { return SOUND.fallbackMusic; }
    node = document.createElement("audio"); node.loop = true; node.preload = "auto";
    node.src = waveDataUri("music"); SOUND.fallbackMusic = node;
  } else {
    if (SOUND.fallbackEffects[key]) { return SOUND.fallbackEffects[key]; }
    node = document.createElement("audio"); node.preload = "auto";
    node.src = waveDataUri(kind); SOUND.fallbackEffects[key] = node;
  }
  if (document.body) { document.body.appendChild(node); }
  return node;
}
function startDrone() {
  if (!SOUND.context || SOUND.musicStarted) { return; }
  var ctx = SOUND.context, freqs = [55, 82.41, 110], levels = [0.10, 0.055, 0.022], i, osc, amp;
  SOUND.musicStarted = true;
  for (i = 0; i < freqs.length; i++) {
    osc = ctx.createOscillator(); amp = ctx.createGain();
    osc.type = "sine"; osc.frequency.value = freqs[i]; amp.gain.value = levels[i];
    osc.connect(amp); amp.connect(SOUND.music); osc.start(); SOUND.musicNodes.push(osc);
  }
  playMusicNote();
  SOUND.musicTimer = window.setInterval(playMusicNote, 2450);
}
function playMusicNote() {
  if (!SOUND.context || !STATE.options || !STATE.options.music) { return; }
  try {
    var ctx = SOUND.context, notes = [220, 261.63, 196, 164.81, 246.94, 196],
        now = ctx.currentTime, osc = ctx.createOscillator(), env = ctx.createGain();
    osc.type = "sine"; osc.frequency.value = notes[SOUND.musicIndex % notes.length]; SOUND.musicIndex++;
    env.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);

function waveDataUri(kind) {

  var head = "RIFF" + le32(36 + dataSize) + "WAVEfmt " + le32(16) + String.fromCharCode(1,0,1,0) +
    le32(rate) + le32(rate * 2) + String.fromCharCode(2,0,16,0) + "data" + le32(dataSize);
  for (i = 0; i < count; i++) {

/* ================================================================
  SECTION E : IDLE SCREEN - CONSTRUCTION
  Built once, then left alone. Costs nothing to look at.
  ================================================================ */

function buildIdleScreen() {
  var host = $("content");
  clear(host);
  stopNavFX();       /* the map timer must not outlive the map */
  PROGRESS_UI = {}; /* drop stale DOM refs from the last screen */

    var screen = make("div", null, "");
    screen.id = "screen-idle";

    screen.appendChild(buildStatRail());
    screen.appendChild(buildStage());
    screen.appendChild(buildStageNote());
    screen.appendChild(buildNavStrip());
    if (STATE.docked) { screen.appendChild(dockStrip()); }
    screen.appendChild(buildInfoRail());
    screen.appendChild(buildFeed());

    host.appendChild(screen);

    bindIdleInteractions();
    renderFeed();
    placeDots();
    layoutIdle();   /* give the feed the leftover vertical space */
}

/* --- upper rail : the four gauge cards --------------------- */
function buildStatRail() {
   var rail = make("div", "rail"), i, s, cell;
    for (i = 0; i < STATS.length; i++) {
       s = STATS[i];
       cell = make("div", "rail-cell" +
          (i === STATS.length - 1 ? " rail-last" : ""));
       /* equal share of the rail, floored to 1/100 of a percent so
         Trident's rounding can never push the last cell down */
       cell.style.width = (Math.floor(10000 / STATS.length) / 100) + "%";
       cell.innerHTML =
          '<div class="stat" id="stat-' + s.id + '">' +
            '<div class="stat-label">' + s.label + '</div>' +
            '<div class="stat-value num">' + s.value +
              '<span class="stat-unit">' + s.unit + '</span></div>' +
            bar(s.value, s.colour) +
          '</div>';
       rail.appendChild(cell);
    }
    rail.appendChild(make("div", "clear"));
    return rail;
}

/* --- lower rail : location / contacts / life support ------- */
function buildInfoRail() {
   var rail = make("div", "rail"), i, n, cell;
   rail.style.marginTop = "12px";
   for (i = 0; i < INFOS.length; i++) {
      n = INFOS[i];
      cell = make("div", "rail-cell" +
         (i === INFOS.length - 1 ? " rail-last" : ""));
      cell.style.width = (Math.floor(10000 / INFOS.length) / 100) + "%";
      cell.innerHTML =
         '<div class="info" id="info-' + n.id + '">' +
           '<div class="info-label">' + n.label + '</div>' +
           '<div class="info-value">' + n.value + '</div>' +
         '</div>';
      rail.appendChild(cell);
   }
   rail.appendChild(make("div", "clear"));
   return rail;
}

/* --- the ship cross-section -------------------------------- */
function buildStage() {
   var stage = make("div", null, ""), compact = STATE.shipClass === "wren";
   stage.id = "stage";
   if (compact) { stage.className = "stage-compact"; }
   stage.style.width = (compact ? 600 : 1160) + "px";
   stage.style.height = (compact ? 365 : 460) + "px";

    /* --- the silhouette, straight from the HULL table ----- */
    var i, h, el;
    for (i = 0; i < HULL.length; i++) {
       h = HULL[i];
       el = make("div", "hpart " + h.cls);
       el.id = "hp-" + h.id;
       el.style.left = h.x + "px";
    el.style.top = h.y + "px";
    el.style.width = h.w + "px";
    el.style.height = h.h + "px";
    stage.appendChild(el);
    /* intake bars at the forward end of each nacelle */
    if (h.cls === "hp-nacelle") {
       var k, bar;
       for (k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
          bar = make("div", "nac-bar");
          bar.style.left = (h.x + h.w - 30 - k * 12) + "px";
          bar.style.top = (h.y + 8) + "px";
          bar.style.width = "3px";
          bar.style.height = (h.h - 16) + "px";
          stage.appendChild(bar);
       }
    }
}

/* --- three engine nozzles, aft of the main body ------- */
var nz = findById(HULL, "body"), n;
for (i = 0; i < (compact ? 2 : 3); i++) {
   n = make("div", "nozzle");
   n.style.left = (nz.x - 15) + "px";
   n.style.top = (nz.y + (compact ? 35 + i * 85 : 40 + i * 73)) + "px";
   stage.appendChild(n);
}

/* --- the spine corridor ------------------------------- */
var cor = make("div", "corridor");
cor.style.left = CORRIDOR.x + "px";
cor.style.top = CORRIDOR.y + "px";
/* border-box: the 1px border is inside the number now, so the
  old -2 compensation would shrink the box by 2px */
cor.style.width = CORRIDOR.w + "px";
cor.style.height = CORRIDOR.h + "px";
stage.appendChild(cor);


/* .room-tag anchors right/bottom, so those must be released
  before left/top will behave. Setting all four would stretch
  the element across the hull in Trident. */
var corLabel = make("div", "room-tag", "CORRIDOR");
corLabel.style.position = "absolute";
corLabel.style.right = "auto";
corLabel.style.bottom = "auto";
corLabel.style.left = (CORRIDOR.x + 9) + "px";
corLabel.style.top     = (CORRIDOR.y + 7) + "px";
stage.appendChild(corLabel);

/* --- power conduit along the bottom of the main body -- */
var cd = make("div", "conduit");
cd.style.left = CORRIDOR.x + "px";
    cd.style.top = (nz.y + nz.h - 18) + "px";
    cd.style.width = CORRIDOR.w + "px";
    cd.style.height = "12px";
    stage.appendChild(cd);

    /* --- rooms, drawn from data --------------------------- */
    var r, scene;
    for (i = 0; i < ROOMS.length; i++) {
       r = ROOMS[i]; scene = ROOM_SCENES[r.id] || {glyph:"network", code:"SHIP SYSTEM", accent:"#8c6f4e"};
       el = make("div", "room" + (r.small ? " room-small" : ""));
       el.id = "room-" + r.id;
       el.title = r.name + " - " + r.systems;
       el.style.left    = r.x + "px";
       el.style.top     = r.y + "px";
       el.style.width     = r.w + "px";
       el.style.height = r.h + "px";
       el.style.background = r.tone;
       el.style.borderLeft = "3px solid " + scene.accent;
       el.innerHTML =
          '<div class="room-glyph room-glyph-' + scene.glyph + '" style="border-color:' + scene.accent + ';">' +
            '<span class="rg-main" style="background:' + scene.accent + ';" ></span>' +
            '<span class="rg-side"></span><span class="rg-light" style="background:' + scene.accent + ';" ></span>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="room-name">' + r.name + '</div>' +
          (r.systems && !r.small ? '<div class="room-sys">' + r.systems + '</div>' : "") +
          '<div class="room-tag">' + r.tag + '</div>';
       stage.appendChild(el);
    }

    /* cosmetic bay dividers inside the cargo hold */
    var cargo = findById(ROOMS, "cargo"), d, k2;
    for (k2 = 1; k2 <= 2; k2++) {
       d = make("div", "divider");
       d.style.left = (cargo.x + (cargo.w / 3) * k2) + "px";
       d.style.top = (cargo.y + 26) + "px";
       d.style.height = (cargo.h - 40) + "px";
       stage.appendChild(d);
    }

    /* crew dots */
    var j2, c, dot, lab;
    for (j2 = 0; j2 < CREW.length; j2++) {
       c = CREW[j2];
       dot = make("div", "dot");
       dot.id = "dot-" + c.id;
       dot.style.background = c.colour;
       stage.appendChild(dot);

        lab = make("div", "dot-label", c.name.split(" ")[0]);
        lab.id = "lab-" + c.id;
        stage.appendChild(lab);
    }

    return stage;
}

/* Facilities without a large bespoke machine drawing still open as
   real rooms, not empty forms: each gets its own instrument-window
   vignette, accent, callout and room-specific signal motif. */
function buildRoomIllustration(id) {
   var scene = ROOM_SCENES[id] || {glyph:"network", code:"SHIP SYSTEM", label:"Systems console", description:"Local status and controls.", accent:"#8c6f4e"};
   var panel = make("div", "room-hero room-hero-" + scene.glyph, "");
   panel.innerHTML =
      '<div class="rh-scope">' +
        '<span class="rh-orbit rh-orbit-one"></span>' +
        '<span class="rh-orbit rh-orbit-two"></span>' +
        '<span class="rh-core" style="background:' + scene.accent + ';box-shadow:0 0 16px ' + scene.accent + ';" ></span>' +
        '<span class="rh-beacon rh-beacon-one" style="background:' + scene.accent + ';" ></span>' +
        '<span class="rh-beacon rh-beacon-two"></span>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="rh-readout">' +
        '<div class="rh-code">' + scene.code + '</div>' +
        '<div class="rh-title">' + scene.label + '</div>' +
        '<div class="rh-caption">' + scene.description + '</div>' +
        '<div class="rh-meter"><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="rh-status"><span class="rh-live-dot" style="background:' + scene.accent + ';" ></span>' +
        '<span>SHIP SYSTEM</span><b>ONLINE</b><small>' + scene.code + '</small>' +
      '</div>';
   return panel;
}

function buildStageNote() {
  return make("div", "stage-note",
      "Left-click anything here to read what it is. " +
      "Right-click opens its task window.");
}

/* Navigation strip - sits under the ship, opens the map. */
function buildNavStrip() {
   var here = findById(BODIES, MAP.here);
   var t = findOngoing("travel");
   var main;

    if (t && t.state === "running") { main = t.label + " - crossing in progress"; }
    else if (t && t.state === "done") { main = "Crossing complete - awaiting acknowledgement"; }
    else { main = "Holding at " + here.name + " - no course plotted"; }

    var strip = make("div", null,
       '<div class="ns-right">Left-click to read - right-click opens it</div>' +
       '<div class="ns-label">Navigation</div>' +
       '<div class="ns-main">' + main + '</div>');
    strip.id = "navstrip";
    return strip;
}

function buildFeed() {
  var wrap = make("div", null, "");
  wrap.id = "feedwrap";
  wrap.appendChild(make("div", "feed-head", "Activity Feed"));
  var box = make("div", null, "");
  box.id = "feed";
  wrap.appendChild(box);
  return wrap;
}


/* ================================================================
  SECTION F : AMBIENT DOT DRIFT
  PURELY COSMETIC. Manifesto 1.5 is explicit that the dots drift
  so the diagram feels alive, and equally explicit that this does
  not advance game state. This timer therefore touches nothing
  except pixel positions. It must never be given game logic.

    In this build a dot drifts only inside its own room, so the
    diagram never contradicts the crew data shown in a task window.
    Room-to-room walks arrive with the crew logic phase.
    ================================================================ */

var DOTS = [];

function placeDots() {
  DOTS = [];
  var i, c, r, d;
  for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) {
     c = CREW[i];
        r = crewBox(c);
        d={
           id : c.id,
           el : $("dot-" + c.id),
           lb : $("lab-" + c.id),
           x : dotSpot(r, "x"),
           y : dotSpot(r, "y"),
           tx : 0, ty : 0, wait : 0, room : r
        };
        pickTarget(d);
        DOTS[DOTS.length] = d;
        drawDot(d);
    }
}

function pickTarget(d) {
  /* re-read the box every time: a hand laid off mid-game walks
     out of his room on the next drift, with no rebuild */
  var c = findById(CREW, d.id);
  if (c) { d.room = crewBox(c); }
  d.tx = dotSpot(d.room, "x");
  d.ty = dotSpot(d.room, "y");
}

/* A drift target inside a room, safe for any room size. The old
  maths assumed a 112px room and would have thrown a dot clean
  outside the 44px shells on the spine. */
/* THE CORRIDOR IS THE DOLE QUEUE.
  A hand with no job is not at a station, so he is not drawn at
  one. Everybody unemployed drifts up and down the corridor,
  which means the player can read the whole payroll off the
  cross-section without opening anything. */
function crewBox(c) {
   var work = crewBusy(c);
   if (work && work.target === "social") { return findById(ROOMS, "r13"); }
   if (atDoc(c)) { return findById(ROOMS, "r1"); }
   if (!c.job) { return CORRIDOR; }
   var r = findById(ROOMS, c.room);
   return r ? r : CORRIDOR;
}
function crewWhere(c) {
   var work = crewBusy(c);
   if (work && work.target === "social") { return "Recreation"; }
   if (atDoc(c)) { return "Medical Bay"; }
   if (!c.job) { return "Corridor - no job"; }
   var r = findById(ROOMS, c.room);
   return r ? r.name : "Corridor";
}

function dotSpot(r, axis) {
  var lo, span;
  if (axis === "x") {
     lo = r.x + 22;
     span = r.w - 54;
  } else if (STATE.shipClass === "wren" && r.h >= 50) {
     lo = r.y + 34;
     span = r.h - 52;
  } else if (r.h > 70) {
     lo = r.y + 44;
     span = r.h - 66;
  } else if (r.h > 34) {
       lo = r.y + 16;
       span = r.h - 34;
    } else {
       /* the corridor is 26px of headroom - centre the dot in it
         rather than hanging it out of the bottom */
       lo = r.y + Math.round((r.h - 15) / 2);
       span = 1;
    }
    if (span < 1) { span = 1; }
    return lo + Math.random() * span;
}

function drawDot(d) {
  if (!d.el) { return; }
  d.el.style.left = Math.round(d.x) + "px";
  d.el.style.top = Math.round(d.y) + "px";
  d.lb.style.left = Math.round(d.x - 8) + "px";
  d.lb.style.top = Math.round(d.y + 14) + "px";
}

function driftTick() {
  if (STATE.reducedMotion) { return; }
  var i, d, dx, dy, dist, step;
  for (i = 0; i < DOTS.length; i++) {
     d = DOTS[i];
     if (d.wait > 0) { d.wait--; continue; }
     dx = d.tx - d.x;
     dy = d.ty - d.y;
     dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
     if (dist < 1.2) {
        d.wait = 20 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 90);
        pickTarget(d);
        continue;
     }
     step = 0.5;
     d.x += (dx / dist) * step;
     d.y += (dy / dist) * step;
     drawDot(d);
  }
}


/* ================================================================
  SECTION G : IDLE-SCREEN MOUSE BINDING
  Right-click is the game's primary verb: it opens the task
  window for a thing - in the background, without moving the
  player. Left-click is the second verb, added later: it opens a
  briefing popup describing the thing and listing the actions its
  window offers. Both are free. Looking must stay harmless.
  ================================================================ */

function bindIdleInteractions() {
  var i, r, s, n, c, el;
    for (i = 0; i < ROOMS.length; i++) {
       r = ROOMS[i];
       el = $("room-" + r.id);
       if (el) { bindTaskOpen(el, "room", r.id); }
    }
    for (i = 0; i < STATS.length; i++) {
       s = STATS[i];
       el = $("stat-" + s.id);
       if (el) { bindTaskOpen(el, "system", s.id); }
    }
    for (i = 0; i < INFOS.length; i++) {
       n = INFOS[i];
       el = $("info-" + n.id);
       if (el) { bindTaskOpen(el, "info", n.id); }
    }
    for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) {
       c = CREW[i];
       el = $("dot-" + c.id);
       if (el) { bindTaskOpen(el, "crew", c.id); }
       el = $("lab-" + c.id);
       if (el) { bindTaskOpen(el, "crew", c.id); }
    }

    el = $("navstrip");
    if (el) { bindTaskOpen(el, "nav", "main"); }
    el = $("dockstrip");
    if (el) { bindTaskOpen(el, "station", MAP.here); }
}

/* THE TWO BUTTONS, ON THE IDLE SCREEN ONLY.

    LEFT - tells you what the thing is and what could be done to
       it. A briefing. Costs nothing, changes nothing, and
       the idle screen stays in front of you.
    RIGHT - opens the task window for it, and LEAVES YOU HERE.
       The tab appears in the bar and waits. Opening a window
       is not the same as walking into the room, so the game
       no longer drags the player away from what they were
       reading.

  Closure kept in its own function so the loop variable is not
  captured by reference - a classic IE-era trap. */
function bindTaskOpen(el, kind, id) {
   on(el, "click", function (e) {
      var ev = e || window.event;
      openBrief(kind, id);
      /* one click, one briefing - never the parent's as well */
      if (ev) {
         ev.cancelBubble = true;
         if (ev.stopPropagation) { ev.stopPropagation(); }
      }
      return false;
   });
    rightClick(el, function () { openTask(kind, id, false); });
}


/* ================================================================
  SECTION H : TAB SYSTEM
  Browser-style tabs. Home is permanent and always returns the
  player to the idle screen.
  ================================================================ */

/* hold at full colour, then ease back down. Same smoothstep the
  protagonist mouse uses, so the two feel like one hand. */
var TABFX = { warm:[233, 214, 184], hold:160, fade:1500, frame:50 };

function glowTab(el, isActive) {
  if (STATE.reducedMotion) { return; }
  var base = isActive ? [255, 255, 255] : [239, 232, 220];
  var w = TABFX.warm;
  var t0 = (new Date()).getTime();
  var tid;

    el.style.backgroundColor = "rgb(" + w[0] + "," + w[1] + "," + w[2] + ")";


    tid = setInterval(function () {
       /* the tab bar is rebuilt often; when this element is no
          longer on screen the timer has nothing left to do */
       if (!el.parentNode) { clearInterval(tid); return; }
       if (STATE.reducedMotion) { el.style.backgroundColor = ""; clearInterval(tid); return; }

       var t = ((new Date()).getTime() - t0 - TABFX.hold) / TABFX.fade;
       if (t < 0) { return; }
       if (t >= 1) {
          el.style.backgroundColor = ""; /* hand it back to the CSS */
          clearInterval(tid);
          return;
       }
       var k = t * t * (3 - 2 * t), c = [0, 0, 0], q;
       for (q = 0; q < 3; q++) {
          c[q] = Math.round(w[q] + (base[q] - w[q]) * k);
       }
       el.style.backgroundColor = "rgb(" + c[0] + "," + c[1] + "," + c[2] + ")";
    }, TABFX.frame);
}

function renderTabs() {
  var bar = $("taskbar"), scroll = bar.scrollLeft;
  clear(bar);

    bar.appendChild(makeTab("home", SHIP.name + " (Idle)", "SHIP", true));

    var i, t;
    for (i = 0; i < STATE.tabs.length; i++) {
       t = STATE.tabs[i];
        bar.appendChild(makeTab(t.key, t.title, t.kindLabel, false));
    }
    bar.scrollLeft = scroll;
}
function revealTab(key) {
  var bar = $("taskbar"), i, el, left, right;
  for (i = 0; i < bar.childNodes.length; i++) {
    el = bar.childNodes[i];
    if (el.taskKey !== key) { continue; }
    left = el.offsetLeft; right = left + el.offsetWidth;
    if (left < bar.scrollLeft) { bar.scrollLeft = left; }
    else if (right > bar.scrollLeft + bar.clientWidth) { bar.scrollLeft = right - bar.clientWidth; }
    return;
  }
}

function makeTab(key, title, kindLabel, isHome) {
  var cls = "tab" + (isHome ? " tab-home" : "");
  if (STATE.activeTab === key) { cls += " tab-active"; }

    var tab = make("div", cls, "");
    tab.taskKey = key;
    /* A tab that has just been created announces itself: it comes
       up in coffee cream and cools back to its normal colour over
       about a second and a half. Right-clicking something on the
       idle screen no longer opens a window silently somewhere the
       player is not looking. Purely cosmetic - it touches nothing
       but a background colour and cannot advance the game. */
    if (STATE.freshTabs[key]) {
        STATE.freshTabs[key] = false;
        glowTab(tab, (STATE.activeTab === key));
    }
    tab.innerHTML = '<span class="tab-kind">' + kindLabel + '</span>' + title;

    on(tab, "click", function () { switchTab(key); });

    if (!isHome) {
       var x = make("span", "tab-close", "x");
       on(x, "click", function (e) {
           closeTab(key);
           if (e && e.stopPropagation) { e.stopPropagation(); }
           if (window.event) { window.event.cancelBubble = true; }
       });
       tab.appendChild(x);
    }
    return tab;
}

function switchTab(key) {
  STATE.activeTab = key;
  var t = (key === "home") ? null : refreshTab(findTab(key));
  renderTabs();
  revealTab(key);
  if (key === "home") { buildIdleScreen(); }
  else { buildTaskScreen(t); }
  setStatus();
}

/* A tab stored the description it was born with, and switching
  back rebuilt the screen from that FROZEN copy - so a room
  window could report a condition, a stock or a crew state that
  had since moved on. Re-ask describeTarget every time the screen
  is built. Nav describes itself live and is left alone. */
function refreshTab(t) {
   if (!t || t.kind === "nav") { return t; }
   var fresh = describeTarget(t.kind, t.id), i;
    fresh.key = t.key;
    for (i = 0; i < STATE.tabs.length; i++) {
       if (STATE.tabs[i].key === t.key) { STATE.tabs[i] = fresh; }
    }
    return fresh;
}

function findTab(key) {
  var i;
  for (i = 0; i < STATE.tabs.length; i++) {
     if (STATE.tabs[i].key === key) { return STATE.tabs[i]; }
  }
  return null;
}

function closeTab(key) {
  var i, keep = [];
  for (i = 0; i < STATE.tabs.length; i++) {
     if (STATE.tabs[i].key !== key) { keep[keep.length] = STATE.tabs[i]; }
  }
  STATE.tabs = keep;
  if (STATE.activeTab === key) { switchTab("home"); }
  else { renderTabs(); setStatus(); }
}

/* Opening a task is free. Only interactions INSIDE a task window
  cost actions. */
