/* focus is opt-IN. Called without it the window opens in the
  background: the tab is created and drawn, and whatever the
  player is looking at stays on screen. Tab clicks pass true,
  because clicking a tab IS the request to go there. */
function openTask(kind, id, focus) {
   var key = kind + ":" + id;

    if (!findTab(key)) {
       var t = describeTarget(kind, id);
       t.key = key;
       STATE.tabs[STATE.tabs.length] = t;
       STATE.freshTabs[key] = true; /* makeTab will light it up */
    }

    if (focus) { switchTab(key); } else { renderTabs(); revealTab(key); }
}


/* ================================================================
  SECTION I : TASK WINDOW CONTENT
  Specialized rooms, ship systems, stations and incidents build
  their own live screens, including the fitted ship systems.
  ================================================================ */
/* What record, if any, a tab is watching. Nav carries none and
  says so by returning true. */
function targetEntity(kind, id) {
   if (kind === "room") { return findById(ROOMS, id); }
   if (kind === "crew") { return findById(CREW, id); }
   if (kind === "system") { return findById(STATS, id); }
   if (kind === "info") { return findById(INFOS, id); }
   if (kind === "event") { return findById(EVENTS, id); }
   if (kind === "station") { return STATE.docked && MAP.here === id && PORTS[id]; }
   return true;
}

function describeTarget(kind, id) {
  var t = { kind:kind, id:id, kindLabel:"", title:"", sub:"", rows:[], acts:[] };
  var r, c, s, n;

  /* A TAB CAN OUTLIVE WHAT IT WATCHES. refreshTab re-describes
     on every switch, so the moment anything leaves its table -
     an event being consumed or a crew member lost - every branch
     below would read .name off null and take the screen down
     with it. One guard, all five lookups, no drift. */
  if (!targetEntity(kind, id)) {
      t.kindLabel = "GONE";
      t.title = "No longer aboard";
      t.sub     = "Whatever this tab was watching is not on the " +
                "ship any more.";
      t.rows      = [["Was", kind + " " + id],
                 ["Status", "no record"]];
      t.acts    = [];
      return t;
  }

  if (kind === "wiki" || kind === "awards") {
     t.kindLabel = kind === "wiki" ? "WIKI" : "LOGBOOK";
     t.title = kind === "wiki" ? "Ship's Handbook" : "Commendations & Rewards";
     t.sub = "Free reference and voyage records"; return t;
  }
  if (kind === "station") {
     t.kindLabel = "STATION"; t.title = PORTS[id].name;
     t.sub = "Docked - market, mission board, shipyard and crew";
     t.rows = [["Berth", "Docked"], ["Purse", STATE.shiplets + " sh"]];
     t.acts = [act("Trade, hire or accept a contract", "1 action"), act("Undock", "1 action")];
     return t;
  }

  if (kind === "event") {
     var ev = findById(EVENTS, id);
     t.kindLabel = "EVENT";
     t.title = ev ? ev.kind + " report" : "Report";
     t.sub = "Noticed by the ship. Nobody has looked into it yet.";
     t.rows = [
         ["Kind", ev ? ev.kind : "-"],
         ["Reported by", ev ? ev.source : "-"],
         ["Status", "Unexamined"],
         ["Detail", "Not yet established"]
     ];
     t.acts = [
         act("Examine the report", "1 action"),
         act("Send a crew member", "varies"),
         act("Log and ignore", "1 action")
     ];
     return t;
  }
if (kind === "nav") {
   t.kindLabel = "NAV";
   t.title = "Navigation";
   t.sub = "Course plotting and system chart";
   return t; /* nav builds its own screen - see buildNavScreen */
}

if (kind === "room") {
   r = findById(ROOMS, id);
   t.kindLabel = "ROOM";
   t.title = r.name;
   t.sub = r.systems;
   if (ROOM_FITS[id] || id === "bridge") {
      t.rows = [["Systems", r.systems], ["Occupants", occupantsOf(id)], ["Access", "Right-click to open the room"]];
      t.acts = []; return t;
   }
   t.rows = [
       ["Designation", r.tag],
       ["Systems",     r.systems],
       ["Condition", "Operational"],
       ["Occupants", occupantsOf(r.id)],
       ["Deck position", "x " + r.x + " / y " + r.y]
   ];
   t.acts = [];
   /* the three rooms that hold a store show what is in it,
      above the generic room readings */
   if (r.id === "engine") { roomEngine(t); }
   if (r.id === "o2")     { roomO2(t); }
   if (r.id === "mess")     { roomMess(t); }
   if (r.id === "cargo") { roomCargo(t); }
   if (r.id === "science") { roomScience(t); }

   if (r.id === "quarters") { t.acts = [act("Talk to crew", "free"), act("Give orders", "1 action + work")]; }
} else if (kind === "crew") {
   /* PURELY INFORMATIONAL, ON PURPOSE - see Entry 074. t.rows is
      left empty here: buildCrewPopupScreen (Section I-2b) reads
      the CREW record itself, fresh, on every paint, and builds
      the Status/Personality/Profile panels straight off it - so
      a tab left open across a whole shift never shows a stale
      number. This branch only has to set the header and keep
      t.acts empty, as a safety net if that builder is bypassed. */
   c = findById(CREW, id);
   t.kindLabel = "CREW";
   t.title = c.name;
   t.sub = c.role;
   t.rows = [];
   t.acts = [];
} else if (kind === "system") {
   s = findById(STATS, id);
   t.kindLabel = "SYSTEM";
   t.title = s.label;
   t.sub = "Reading " + s.value + s.unit;
   t.rows = [
       ["Current reading", s.value + s.unit],
       ["Status",       s.value > 80 ? "Operational" : (s.value > 40 ? "Degraded" : "Damaged")],
       ["Trend",        "See active reports"],
       ["Maintained by", assignedEngineer() ? assignedEngineer().name : "Nobody assigned"],
       ["Last serviced", "Not recorded"]
   ];
   t.acts = [act(id === "hull" ? "Patch hull" : (id === "shield" ? "Service shields" :
      (id === "energy" ? "Recharge energy" : "Transfer fuel")),
      "1 action - consumes " + (id === "hull" || id === "shield" ? "a repair kit" : "a fuel cell"))];
} else {
   n = findById(INFOS, id);
   t.kindLabel = "READOUT";
   t.title = n.label;
   t.sub = n.value;
   t.rows = [
       ["Reading", n.value],
       ["Source", "Ship sensors"],
       ["Updated", "On arrival"]
   ];
   t.acts = [act("Open Navigation", "free"), act("Open Comms Relay", "free")];
   if (id === "life") { t.acts = [act("Open O2 Filter Room", "free")]; }
    }
    return t;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
  THE THREE STORE ROOMS
  Each one REPLACES the generic room rows and actions with what
  the store actually holds. Everything is read from the tables in
  the data section, so the window, the briefing popup and the
  sidebar line can never tell three different stories.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* ENGINE ROOM - the drive wears with every action spent aboard,
  so the briefing leads with the number that matters. */
function roomEngine(t) {
   var eng = assignedEngineer(), cost = maintCost();
   t.sub = "Propulsion and power - condition " +
          STATE.engineCondition + "%";
   t.rows = [
       ["Condition", STATE.engineCondition + "%"],
       ["Wear rate", "1% per " + ENGINE.wearEvery + " actions spent aboard"],
       ["Maintenance", (STATE.engineCondition >= 100
         ? "Not needed - drive is perfect"
         : cost + " action" + (cost === 1 ? "" : "s") + " - restores to 100%")],
       ["Warning at", ENGINE.warnBelow + "% - a red line joins the sidebar"],
       ["Engineer", eng ? eng.name + " - acts at " +
                      effectiveJobAt(eng) + "%"
                    : "Nobody holds the job"]
   ];
   /* Dead rows on purpose. A briefing says what the window holds;
      the work itself is committed in the window. A live row here
      would only spend an action and start nothing. */
   t.acts = [
       act("Run Maintenance", (STATE.engineCondition >= 100
            ? "refused at 100%" : cost + " actions")),
       act("The engineer acts alone",
         eng ? "at " + effectiveJobAt(eng) + "%" : "nobody assigned")
   ];
}

/* O2 FILTER ROOM - canisters in the rack, filters on the wall.
  Loading one into the other is manual work, by design. */
function roomO2(t) {
   t.sub = "Life support - air quality " + airWord();
   t.rows = [
      ["Air quality", airWord()],
      ["Filter life", bankRunning()
        ? STATE.filterLife + " of " + LIFE.lifeMax + " actions"
        : "bank is not running"],
      ["Slots",      slotsIn("empty") + " bare, " +
                  slotsIn("installed") + " seated, " +
                  slotsIn("active") + " running"],
      ["Canisters", LIFE.canisters + " of " + LIFE.capacity + " racked"],
      ["Filter hand", (function () {
         var h = assignedFilterHand();
         return h ? h.name + " - acts at " + AIR_STAGES[h.jobAt].word
               : "nobody assigned";
      }())],
      ["Reward",        "+10 pro-action when all three run"]
    ];
    t.acts = [
       act("Install a canister", "1 action + 2 to seat"),
       act("Turn on the filters", "1 action - needs all three")
    ];
}

/* MESS HALL - the rack, the cook, and the four clocks nobody can
  see from outside. Not much to DO in here; everything to watch. */
function roomMess(t) {
   var cook = assignedCook();
   var cost = Math.ceil((MESS.capacity - MESS.rack) / (cook ? cook.jobAt : 1));
   t.sub = "Galley and rations - " + MESS.rack + " of " + MESS.capacity +
         " on the rack";
   t.rows = [
      ["Rack",      MESS.rack + " of " + MESS.capacity + " rations"],
      ["Hunger cycle", "every " + MESS_EVERY +
             " actions, per crew member, staggered"],
      ["Cooking",     (MESS.rack >= MESS.capacity
         ? "Not needed - rack is full"
         : cost + " action" + (cost === 1 ? "" : "s") + " - tops up the rack")],
      ["Starvation", "at " + MESS_STARVE + "% hunger health is at risk, slowly"],
      ["Cook", cook ? cook.name + " - acts at " + jobThreshold(cook)
            : "Nobody holds the job"]
   ];
   /* Dead rows on purpose - same law as the engine and the
      filters. The work itself is committed in the window. */
   t.acts = [
      act("Cook a batch", (MESS.rack >= MESS.capacity
           ? "refused - rack full" : cost + " actions")),
      act("The cook acts alone",
        cook ? "at " + jobThreshold(cook) : "nobody assigned")
   ];
}

/* CARGO HOLD - what is aboard, what space it eats, what it is
  worth. Volume is the constraint the player actually feels. */
function roomCargo(t) {
   var i, g, used = cargoUsed(), rows = [
      ["Hold", used + " of " + CARGO.capacity + " m3 used"],
      ["Lots", GOODS.length + " aboard"],
      ["Manifest", cargoWorth() + " shiplets at current prices"]
   ];
   for (i = 0; i < GOODS.length; i++) {
      g = GOODS[i];
      rows[rows.length] = [g.name,
         g.vol + " m3 - " + (STATE.docked ? lotPrice(g) : g.value) + " sh - " + g.kind +
         (g.risk ? " (UNREGISTERED)" : "")];
   }
   t.rows = rows;
   t.sub = "Storage - " + used + " of " + CARGO.capacity + " m3 in use";
   t.acts = [
      act("Jettison a lot", "1 action"), act("Sell a lot", "at a station"),
      act("Recover route salvage", "1 action + 2 work")
   ];
}

/* SCIENCE ROOM - the survey record. Data arrives here from deep
  scans, salvage and finished contracts, and leaves as packages
  sold at a station. */
function roomScience(t) {
   var i, v, rows = [
      ["Logs held", SURVEY.length + " survey records"],
      ["Unsold value", surveyWorth() + " shiplets"],
      ["Sources",       "Deep scans, salvage, completed contracts"]
   ];
   for (i = 0; i < SURVEY.length; i++) {
      v = SURVEY[i];
      rows[rows.length] = [v.name,
        v.src + " - " + v.value + " sh - " + v.state];
    }
    t.rows = rows;
    t.sub = "Survey records - " + SURVEY.length + " logs on file";
    t.acts = [
       act("Prepare a data package", "1 action + 2 work"), act("Sell a survey", "at a station")
    ];
}

/* Action descriptors. An action is data: a label, a cost and
  whether it is wired yet. Adding a real action later means
  flipping one of these from act() to live(). */
function act(label, costLabel) {
   return { label:label, cost:costLabel, live:false, detail:null };
}

function live(label, costLabel, detail) {
  return { label:label, cost:costLabel, live:true, detail:detail };
}

/* Separate function so the loop variable is not captured by
  reference - the same IE-era closure trap guarded against in
  the right-click binding. */
function wireAction(el, detail, controlId, subject, cooldownCategory) {
   var label = String(subject || detail || "action");
   var slug = label.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
   var countKey = "task:" + slug, occurrence = COMMAND_ROW_COUNTS[countKey] || 0;
   var identity = controlId || (slug + ":" + occurrence);
   var key = actionCooldownKey("task-action:" + String(identity));
   var category = actionCooldownCategory(label, cooldownCategory);
   var baseClass;
   COMMAND_ROW_COUNTS[countKey] = occurrence + 1;
   if (!el) { return; }
   if (el.className && !/(^|\s)act-action(\s|$)/.test(el.className)) { el.className += " act-action"; }
   baseClass = el.className || "act act-live act-action";
   registerActionCooldownControl({key:key, kind:"command", element:el, baseClass:baseClass,
     idleCost:(el.getElementsByTagName && el.getElementsByTagName("span").length ? el.getElementsByTagName("span")[0].innerHTML : "1 action"), idleTitle:el.title || ""});
   on(el, "click", function (e) {
      return commitActionButton(e, key, category, function () { return fireAction(e, detail); });
   });
}

function occupantsOf(roomId) {
  var i, names = "";
  for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) {
     if (CREW[i].room === roomId && CREW[i].job) {
        names += (names ? ", " : "") + CREW[i].name;
     }
  }
  return names ? names : "None";
}

function buildTaskScreen(t) {
  var host = $("content");
  clear(host);
  stopNavFX();        /* the map timer must not outlive the map */
  PROGRESS_UI = {}; /* drop stale DOM refs from the last screen */
   ACTION_COOLDOWN_CONTROLS = {}; /* cooldown values persist in STATE, not in DOM refs */
   COMMAND_ROW_COUNTS = {};
  if (!t) { return; }

    if (t.kind === "wiki") { buildWikiScreen(host); return; }
    if (t.kind === "awards") { buildAwardsScreen(host); return; }
    if (t.kind === "nav") { buildNavScreen(host); return; }
    if (t.kind === "station" && targetEntity(t.kind, t.id)) { buildStationScreen(host, t); return; }
    if (t.kind === "event" && findById(EVENTS, t.id)) {
       buildIncidentScreen(host, t, findById(EVENTS, t.id)); return;
    }
    if (t.kind === "system" && findById(STATS, t.id)) { buildSystemScreen(host, t); return; }
    if (t.kind === "info" && findById(INFOS, t.id)) { buildInfoScreen(host, t); return; }
    if (t.kind === "room" && targetEntity(t.kind, t.id) && (ROOM_FITS[t.id] || t.id === "bridge")) {
       buildShipRoom(host, t); return;
    }
    if (t.kind === "room" && (t.id === "cargo" || t.id === "science")) {
       buildStoresScreen(host, t); return;
    }
    if (t.kind === "crew") {
       var crewLive = findById(CREW, t.id);
       /* only hijack the screen while the crew member is still
          aboard - a "GONE" tab (Entry 074's guard, up in
          describeTarget) keeps kind:"crew" forever, and must
          fall through to the plain one-panel path below it. */
       if (crewLive) { buildCrewPopupScreen(host, t, crewLive); return; }
    }
    if (t.kind === "room" && t.id === "engine") {
       buildEngineScreen(host, t); return;
}
if (t.kind === "room" && t.id === "o2") {
   buildO2Screen(host, t); return;
}
if (t.kind === "room" && t.id === "mess") {
   buildMessScreen(host, t); return;
}
if (t.kind === "room" && t.id === "quarters") {
   buildCrewScreen(host, t); return;
}

var scr = make("div", "task-screen");

var head = make("div", "task-head",
   '<div class="task-kind">' + t.kindLabel + '</div>' +
   '<div class="task-title">' + t.title + '</div>' +
   '<div class="task-sub">' + t.sub + '</div>');
scr.appendChild(head);

/* INFO-ONLY TASKS, DECLARED BY THE DATA, NOT GUESSED FROM IT:
   a window with no t.acts at all (an empty array, not just an
   empty-looking one) gets no Available Actions column - not even
   an empty one. Status takes the full row instead of 52%. The
   crew member's own window is the first to use this. */
var infoOnly = !t.acts || t.acts.length === 0;

var left = make("div", infoOnly ? "col-full" : "col-l");
var pnl = make("div", "panel");
pnl.appendChild(make("div", "panel-head", "Status"));
var body = make("div", "panel-body"), html = "", i;
for (i = 0; i < t.rows.length; i++) {
   html += '<div class="kv"><div class="kv-k">' + t.rows[i][0] +
         '</div><div class="kv-v">' + t.rows[i][1] +
         '</div><div class="clear"></div></div>';
}
body.innerHTML = html;
pnl.appendChild(body);
left.appendChild(pnl);

if (!infoOnly) {
var right = make("div", "col-r");
var pnl2 = make("div", "panel");
pnl2.appendChild(make("div", "panel-head", "Available Actions"));
var body2 = make("div", "panel-body"), a, row, dead = 0;
for (i = 0; i < t.acts.length; i++) {
   a = t.acts[i];
   row = make("div", "act" + (a.live ? " act-live" : ""),
            '<span class="act-cost">' + a.cost + '</span>' + a.label);
   if (a.live) { wireAction(row, a.detail, null, a.label, a.cooldownCategory); }
   else { dead++; }
   body2.appendChild(row);
}
if (dead > 0) {
   body2.appendChild(make("div", "notice",
      'Greyed interactions are not wired yet. Costs shown are the ' +
      'intended design values.'));
}
pnl2.appendChild(body2);
right.appendChild(pnl2);
}

scr.appendChild(left);
if (!infoOnly) { scr.appendChild(right); }
scr.appendChild(make("div", "clear"));
    host.appendChild(scr);
}

/* ================================================================
  SECTION I-1b : INDIVIDUAL CREW RECORD (right-click a crew dot)
  Entry 074 made this window read-only; this pass (Entry 075)
  splits its one long list into four short, named shelves -
  Status, Personality, Profile, Employment - because those are
  different questions a player is actually asking when they open
  it. Everything below is read off the live CREW record at PAINT
  time, not cached in t.rows, so a tab left open never goes stale.
  ================================================================ */

/* A HIGH NUMBER IS NOT ALWAYS A GOOD NUMBER. Health 91% is
   excellent; Hunger 91% is somebody about to collapse. "bad"
   flips which end of the bar reads as good, so the colour and
   the word always agree, whichever stat is looking at you. */
function vitalWord(v, bad, words) {
   var g = bad ? (100 - v) : v;
   return (g >= 70) ? words[0] : (g >= 40 ? words[1] : words[2]);
}
function vitalRow(label, v, bad, words) {
   var g = bad ? (100 - v) : v;
   var tone = (g >= 70) ? "#7f9161" : (g >= 40 ? "#c08a3e" : "#b05a42");
   return '<div class="navfield"><div class="navfield-k">' + label +
        '</div><div class="navfield-v"><span class="cq-num">' + v + '%</span>' +
        barLine(v, tone) +
        '<div class="navnote" style="margin-top:2px;padding-top:0;">' +
        vitalWord(v, bad, words) + '</div></div><div class="clear"></div></div>';
}
/* plain English for needKey() - same thresholds, read-only, no
   side effects, unlike crewNeed() which also advances the quote
   cycle used by the Crew Quarters "ask" button. Never call that
   one from here; this window must not spend somebody else's line. */
var OUTLOOK_WORD = {
   ill:"Not feeling well", air:"Struggling with the thin air",
   untrained:"Still finding their feet in the job",
   morale:"Morale is wearing thin", tired:"Running on empty",
   hungry:"Could use a meal", idle:"Idle, no job to focus on",
   fine:"Content"
};

/* "m"/"f" is how the sprite code has always kept sex on a crew
   record (see hair/skin fields alongside it) - Gender here reads
   that same field instead of asking for a second one that could
   go out of sync with it. */
var GENDER_WORD = { m:"Male", f:"Female" };

function buildCrewPopupScreen(host, t, c) {
   var scr = make("div", "task-screen");
   var head = make("div", "task-head",
      '<div class="task-kind">' + t.kindLabel + '</div>' +
      '<div class="task-title">' + t.title + '</div>' +
      '<div class="task-sub">' + t.sub + '</div>');
   scr.appendChild(head);

   var j = findById(JOBS, c.job || "");

   /* ROW ONE - Status, full width, same bars as before. */
   var topRow = make("div", "col-full");
   var pStatus = make("div", "panel");
   pStatus.appendChild(make("div", "panel-head", "Status"));
   var bStatus = make("div", "panel-body");
   bStatus.innerHTML =
      vitalRow("Health",  c.health,  false, ["Excellent", "Strained", "Critical"]) +
      vitalRow("Morale",  c.morale,  false, ["High spirits", "Wavering", "Low morale"]) +
      vitalRow("Fatigue", c.fatigue, true,  ["Rested", "Tiring", "Exhausted"]) +
      vitalRow("Hunger",  c.hunger,  true,  ["Well fed", "Peckish", "Starving"]);
   pStatus.appendChild(bStatus);
   topRow.appendChild(pStatus);
   scr.appendChild(topRow);
   scr.appendChild(make("div", "clear"));

   /* ROW TWO - Profile, Personality, Employment, left to right.
      Uneven row lengths are fine here (Entry 076): each panel is
      a handful of short fields, nowhere near tall enough to need
      a scrollbar inside a task window. */
   var cProfile = make("div", "col-3");
   var pProfile = make("div", "panel");
   pProfile.appendChild(make("div", "panel-head", "Profile"));
   var bProfile = make("div", "panel-body");
   bProfile.innerHTML =
      field("Role",      c.role) +
      field("Race",      c.race || "Human") +
      field("Gender",    GENDER_WORD[c.sex] || "Unspecified") +
      field("Age",       (c.age || "Unknown") + (c.age ? " years" : "")) +
      field("Homeworld", c.homeworld || "Unrecorded") +
      field("Station",   crewWhere(c)) +
      field("Doing",     simActivity(c));
   pProfile.appendChild(bProfile);
   cProfile.appendChild(pProfile);

   var cPers = make("div", "col-3");
   var pPers = make("div", "panel");
   pPers.appendChild(make("div", "panel-head", "Personality"));
   var bPers = make("div", "panel-body");
   bPers.innerHTML =
      field("Traits",   c.traits) +
      field("Hobby",    c.hobby || "None recorded") +
      field("Religion", c.religion || "Unrecorded") +
      field("Outlook",  OUTLOOK_WORD[needKey(c)] || "Content") +
      field("Name anchor", simAnchor(c)) + field("Driving need", simEscape(simDrive(c))) + simPersonal(c);
   pPers.appendChild(bPers);
   cPers.appendChild(pPers);

   var cJob = make("div", "col-3-end");
   var pJob = make("div", "panel");
   pJob.appendChild(make("div", "panel-head", "Employment"));
   var bJob = make("div", "panel-body");
   bJob.innerHTML =
      field("Job",         j ? j.label : "None") +
      field("Skill",       c.skill || "Untrained") +
      field("Acts at",     jobThreshold(c)) +
      field("Pay",         wageOf(c) ? (wageOf(c) + " sh each payday")
                                     : "Unpaid - holds no job") +
      field("Next payday", wageOf(c) ? (payrollDue() + " actions")
                                     : "Not on payroll") +
      field("Wallet",      (c.wallet || 0) + " sh");
   pJob.appendChild(bJob);
   cJob.appendChild(pJob);

   scr.appendChild(cProfile);
   scr.appendChild(cPers);
   scr.appendChild(cJob);
   scr.appendChild(make("div", "clear"));
   host.appendChild(scr);
}


/* ================================================================
  SECTION I-2 : NAVIGATION SCREEN
  Map dead centre and full width, information panels above and
  below it.

    THE NO-FARMING RULE, ENFORCED HERE:
    Selecting a body, zooming, reading panels and collecting a
    finished readout are all free. None of them can reach
    performAction. The player may study the whole chart all
    afternoon and the game will not move. Exactly two things on
    this screen commit - "Start Travel" and "Run Deep Scan" - and
    both do it for the same reason: they ask the ship to do work.
    Any button added to the action band must go through fireAction
    or be free. There is no third option.
    ================================================================ */

function buildNavScreen(host) {
  var scr = make("div", "task-screen");

    scr.appendChild(make("div", "task-head",
       '<div class="task-kind">NAV</div>' +
       '<div class="task-title">Navigation</div>' +
       '<div class="task-sub">Select a destination to read it. ' +
       'Reading costs nothing.</div>'));

    var wrap = make("div", "navwrap");

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------
    THE FRAME. One row of three columns with the chart in the
    middle, then the commitments
full width underneath.

        [ Target       ][       ][        ]
        [ Classification ] [ CHART ] [ Scan Data ]
        [ Status       ][       ][       ]
                      [Details][Distance]
        [        Target Actions           ]

      Identity reads down the left, sensor output reads down the
      right, and the chart is never pushed off centre by either.
      --------------------------------------------------------- */
    var main = make("div", "navmain");

    /* --- left column : who the target is --- */
    var cl = make("div", "navcell navcell-l");
    cl.appendChild(navPanel("Target",           "nav-name", ""));
    cl.appendChild(navPanel("Classification", "nav-class", ""));
    cl.appendChild(navPanel("Status",        "nav-status", "np-last"));
    main.appendChild(cl);

    /* --- middle column : the chart, and the two panels that
         describe the leg of the journey it is showing --- */
    var cc = make("div", "navcell navcell-c");
    var mid = make("div", "navcenter");
    mid.appendChild(buildMap());

    var under = make("div", "navrow");
    under.appendChild(navPanel("Target Details", "nav-details", "np-half"));
    under.appendChild(navPanel("Distance",     "nav-dist", "np-half-last"));
    mid.appendChild(under);

    cc.appendChild(mid);
    main.appendChild(cc);

    /* --- right column : what the sensors have to say. Free to
         grow downward for as long as it likes - nothing to its
         left depends on its height. --- */
    var cr = make("div", "navcell navcell-r");
    cr.appendChild(navPanel("Scan Data", "nav-scan", "np-last"));
    main.appendChild(cr);

    wrap.appendChild(main);

    /* --- the commitments, full width at the very bottom --- */
    var r3 = make("div", "navrow");
    r3.appendChild(navPanel("Target Actions", "nav-actions", "np-full"));
    wrap.appendChild(r3);

    scr.appendChild(wrap);
    host.appendChild(scr);

    /* size the chart to the window BEFORE anything is plotted on
       it, so the first paint is already correct */
    layoutNav();
    paintLayerButtons();
    applyPan();
    paintNavPanels();
    if (MAP.layer === "system") { startNavFX(); }
}

function navPanel(title, bodyId, cls) {
  var p = make("div", "navpanel" + (cls ? " " + cls : ""));
  p.appendChild(make("div", "navpanel-head", title));
  var b = make("div", "navpanel-body", "");
  b.id = bodyId;
  p.appendChild(b);
  return p;
}
/* Layers keep redraws cheap and independent: each draw routine
  owns exactly one layer and clears only that. The raster is a
  CSS background on #map itself, so there is no grid layer. */
function buildMap() {
   var m = make("div", null, "");
   m.id = "map";

    /* ORDER MATTERS AND IS A BUG FIX, NOT A PREFERENCE.
      The fx layer holds drifting rocks and a satellite that
      orbits Tolme at 17px - i.e. directly across its dot. Above
      the bodies layer, those 3px cosmetics intermittently ate
      clicks aimed at a real target. Cosmetics go underneath. */
    var names = ["map-routes", "map-fx", "map-bodies"], i, L;
    for (i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
       L = make("div", "maplayer", "");
       L.id = names[i];
       m.appendChild(L);
    }

    var z = make("div", "mapzoom");
    var zi = make("div", "zbtn", "+");
    var zo = make("div", "zbtn", "-");
    on(zi, "click", function () { zoomMap(1); });
    on(zo, "click", function () { zoomMap(-1); });
    z.appendChild(zi);
    z.appendChild(zo);
    m.appendChild(z);

    var sc = make("div", "mapscale", "");
    sc.id = "map-scale";
    m.appendChild(sc);

    /* the layer stack, directly under the zoom pair */
    var lb = make("div", "maplayers"), k, key, el;
    for (k = 0; k < LAYER_ORDER.length; k++) {
       key = LAYER_ORDER[k];
       el = make("div", "lbtn", LAYERS[key].label);
       el.id = "lbtn-" + key;
       bindLayer(el, key);
       lb.appendChild(el);
    }
    m.appendChild(lb);

    m.appendChild(make("div", "maphint", "Drag to pan. Selecting is free"));

    bindMapDrag(m);
    return m;
}

/* closure guard, same reason as every other binder in this file */
function bindLayer(el, key) {
   on(el, "click", function () { setLayer(key); });
}

/* ---------------- layers ---------------- */

function curLayer() { return LAYERS[MAP.layer]; }
function bodySystem(body) { return body && body.system ? body.system : "sec-kessler"; }
function currentSystem() { return findById(SECTOR_BODIES, bodySystem(findById(BODIES, MAP.here))); }
function curBodies() {
   var lay = curLayer(), all = lay.bodies, out = [], i, b, sid = currentSystem().id;
   if (lay.id === "galaxy") { return all; }
   for (i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
      b = all[i];
      if ((lay.id === "system" && bodySystem(b) === sid) ||
          (lay.id === "sector" && b.region === MAP.sector)) { out.push(b); }
   }
   return out;
}

/* ids are unique across every layer, so a lookup does not need to
  know which map the player is looking at */
function findBody(id) {
   var i, b;
   for (i = 0; i < LAYER_ORDER.length; i++) {
      b = findById(LAYERS[LAYER_ORDER[i]].bodies, id);
      if (b) { return b; }
   }
   return null;
}

/* Systems are jump targets; sensors can only scan local bodies.
   Regions are chart containers rather than destinations. */
function inRange(b) {
   if (!b || b.type === "region") { return false; }
   if (b.type === "system") { return !!b.entry; }
   return bodySystem(b) === currentSystem().id;
}
function atTarget(b) {
   return b && (b.type === "system" ? b.id === currentSystem().id : b.id === MAP.here);
}

/* Position at the current map scale, not the region being browsed. */
function homeBody() {
   var lay = curLayer(), sys = currentSystem();
   if (lay.id === "system") { return findById(BODIES, MAP.here); }
   if (lay.id === "sector") { return sys.region === MAP.sector ? sys : null; }
   return findById(GALAXY_BODIES, sys.region);
}
function viewSector(regionId) {
   var sys = currentSystem();
   if (!findById(GALAXY_BODIES, regionId)) { return; }
   MAP.sector = regionId;
   LAYERS.sector.sel = sys.region === regionId ? sys.id : null;
   setLayer("sector");
}

/* FREE. Switching scale is looking, and looking never costs. Each
  layer keeps its own zoom, pan and selection so coming back finds
  the map where it was left. */
function setLayer(key) {
   var old = curLayer();
   if (!LAYERS[key] || MAP.layer === key) { return; }

    old.zoom = MAP.zoom;
    old.sel = STATE.navTarget;

    MAP.layer  = key;
    MAP.zoom    = curLayer().zoom;
    STATE.navTarget = curLayer().sel;

    /* the drifting rocks and the station beacon belong to the
      system view; they must not keep running over a galaxy */
    stopNavFX();

    paintLayerButtons();
    applyRaster();
    applyPan();
    drawMapRoutes();
    drawMapBodies();
    paintNavPanels();

    if (MAP.layer === "system") { startNavFX(); }
}

function paintLayerButtons() {
  var i, key, el;
  for (i = 0; i < LAYER_ORDER.length; i++) {
     key = LAYER_ORDER[i];
     el = $("lbtn-" + key);
     if (el) { el.className = "lbtn" + (MAP.layer === key ? " lbtn-on" : ""); }
  }
}

/* ---------------- panning ---------------- */

/* Pan is applied by moving the three layer anchors, NOT by
  redrawing. The anchors are 0x0 positioned boxes and every dot,
  label and route is absolutely positioned inside them, so one
  style write on each moves the entire chart. Redrawing several
  hundred elements on every mousemove would be unusable in
  Trident. The raster stays put on purpose: it is a backdrop
  suggesting depth, not a coordinate grid, and it is drawn
  no-repeat so panning it would expose bare corners. */
var DRAG = { on:false, sx:0, sy:0, ox:0, oy:0, moved:0, bound:false };

function bindMapDrag(m) {
  on(m, "mousedown", mapDown);
  if (DRAG.bound) { return; }
  /* move and up go on the document so a drag survives the
     pointer leaving the map, and are bound exactly once even
     though the map itself is rebuilt on every screen change */
  DRAG.bound = true;
  on(document, "mousemove", mapMove);
  on(document, "mouseup", mapUp);
}

function mapDown(e) {
  var ev = e || window.event, lay = curLayer();
  if (!ev || ev.button === 2) { return true; } /* right-click is not a drag */
  DRAG.on = true;
  DRAG.moved = 0;
  DRAG.sx = ev.clientX;
  DRAG.sy = ev.clientY;
  DRAG.ox = lay.px;
  DRAG.oy = lay.py;
  if (ev.preventDefault) { ev.preventDefault(); }
  return false;
}
function mapMove(e) {
  if (!DRAG.on) { return true; }
  var ev = e || window.event, lay = curLayer();
  if (!ev) { return true; }
  var dx = ev.clientX - DRAG.sx, dy = ev.clientY - DRAG.sy;

    DRAG.moved = Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy);
    lay.px = DRAG.ox + dx;
    lay.py = DRAG.oy + dy;
    clampPan(lay);
    applyPan();
    return false;
}

function mapUp() {
  DRAG.on = false;
  return true;
}

/* the chart may be pulled half a screen out of place, no further,
  or it can be lost off the edge and look broken */
function clampPan(lay) {
   var mx = Math.round(MAP.vw * 0.5), my = Math.round(MAP.vh * 0.5);
   if (lay.px > mx) { lay.px = mx; }
   if (lay.px < -mx) { lay.px = -mx; }
   if (lay.py > my) { lay.py = my; }
   if (lay.py < -my) { lay.py = -my; }
}

function applyPan() {
  var lay = curLayer(), ids = ["map-routes", "map-fx", "map-bodies"], i, el;
  for (i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
     el = $(ids[i]);
     if (el) {
        el.style.left = lay.px + "px";
        el.style.top = lay.py + "px";
     }
  }
}

/* a drag that happens to end on a star must not also select it */
function dragged() { return DRAG.moved > 4; }

/* World coordinate -> screen coordinate. Two steps: zoom about the
  centre of the world, then stretch the world onto the live size of
  the map box. Every star, route dot, label, rock and ring goes
  through this pair, which is why the chart can be any size at all
  and nothing comes loose from anything else. */
function mapX(wx) { return (MAP.cx + (wx - MAP.cx) * MAP.zoom) * (MAP.vw / MAP.w); }
function mapY(wy) { return (MAP.cy + (wy - MAP.cy) * MAP.zoom) * (MAP.vh / MAP.h); }
/* ---------------- routes ---------------- */

/* Dot trails rather than lines: no CSS transforms, no canvas, no
  VML. Renders identically in every document mode. */
function drawMapRoutes() {
   var L = $("map-routes"), lay = curLayer(), here, bodies = curBodies(), i, b, lk, a2, b2;
   if (!L) { return; }
   clear(L);

 /* SYSTEM: routes are derived - they radiate from wherever the
    ship actually is, so they stay honest after it moves. */
 if (lay.id === "system") {
     here = findById(BODIES, MAP.here);
     for (i = 0; i < bodies.length; i++) {
        b = bodies[i];
        if (b.id === MAP.here) { continue; }
        routeDots(L, here, b, STATE.navTarget === b.id, false);
     }
     return;
 }

    /* Wide-layer lanes are authored context, fainter than the
      player's selected course. They do not restrict travel. */
    for (i = 0; i < lay.links.length; i++) {
       lk = lay.links[i];
       a2 = findById(lay.bodies, lk[0]);
       b2 = findById(lay.bodies, lk[1]);
       if (a2 && b2 && (lay.id !== "sector" ||
           (a2.region === MAP.sector && b2.region === MAP.sector))) { routeDots(L, a2, b2, false, true); }
    }
    if (lay.id === "sector") {
       here = homeBody(); b = findById(SECTOR_BODIES, STATE.navTarget);
       if (here && b && b.region === MAP.sector && b.id !== here.id) { routeDots(L, here, b, true, false); }
    } else if (lay.id === "galaxy") {
       var trip = findOngoing("travel"), system = trip && findById(SECTOR_BODIES, trip.target);
       here = homeBody(); b = system && findById(GALAXY_BODIES, system.region);
       if (here && b && here.id !== b.id) { routeDots(L, here, b, true, false); }
    }
    drawClusters(L, lay);
}

/* Star clusters around a region marker. Scattered from a fixed
  seed, never Math.random, or they would jump to new positions on
  every redraw, zoom and pan. */
function drawClusters(L, lay) {
   var i, j, b, rnd, a, r, d;
   if (lay.id === "galaxy" || lay.id === "sector") {
      var seed = 8721, count = lay.id === "galaxy" ? 260 : 108;
      if (lay.id === "sector") {
         for (i = 0; i < GALAXY_BODIES.length; i++) { if (GALAXY_BODIES[i].id === MAP.sector) { seed += i + 1; } }
      }
      rnd = seeded(seed);
      for (i = 0; i < count; i++) {
         d = make("div", "cdot cdot-far" + (i % 17 === 0 ? " cdot-bright" : ""));
         d.style.left = Math.round(mapX(rnd() * MAP.w)) + "px";
         d.style.top = Math.round(mapY(rnd() * MAP.h)) + "px";
         L.appendChild(d);
      }
   }
   for (i = 0; i < lay.bodies.length; i++) {
      b = lay.bodies[i];
      if (!b.cluster) { continue; }
      rnd = seeded(i + 7);
      for (j = 0; j < b.cluster; j++) {
         a = rnd() * 6.283;
         r = 16 + rnd() * 34;
         d = make("div", "cdot");
         d.style.left = Math.round(mapX(b.x + Math.cos(a) * r)) + "px";
         d.style.top = Math.round(mapY(b.y + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.62)) + "px";
         L.appendChild(d);
        }
    }
}

/* tiny deterministic generator - same seed, same sky, forever */
function seeded(seed) {
   var s = seed * 9301 + 49297;
   return function () {
      s = (s * 9301 + 49297) % 233280;
      return s / 233280;
   };
}

function routeDots(layer, a, b, selected, faint) {
  var x1 = mapX(a.x), y1 = mapY(a.y), x2 = mapX(b.x), y2 = mapY(b.y);
  var dx = x2 - x1, dy = y2 - y1;
  var len = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
  var gap = selected ? 8 : (faint ? 15 : 11);
  var n = Math.floor(len / gap);
  if (n > 90) { n = 90; }

    var i, t, d;
    for (i = 1; i < n; i++) {
       t = i / n;
       d = make("div", selected ? "rdot rdot-sel"
                         : (faint ? "rdot rdot-faint" : "rdot"));
       d.style.left = Math.round(x1 + dx * t) + "px";
       d.style.top = Math.round(y1 + dy * t) + "px";
       layer.appendChild(d);
    }
}


/* ---------------- bodies + the travelling marker ---------------- */

/* Where the green ring sits: at the origin normally, and part way
  along the route in proportion to travel progress. It advances
  only when the progress bar does, which is to say only when the
  player spends actions. */
function travelMarker() {
   var here = findById(BODIES, MAP.here);
   var t = findOngoing("travel");
   if (!t || !t.target) { return { x:here.x, y:here.y }; }
   var tb = findById(BODIES, t.target);
   if (!tb) { return { x:here.x, y:here.y }; }
   var p = ongoingPercent(t) / 100;
   return { x: here.x + (tb.x - here.x) * p,
           y: here.y + (tb.y - here.y) * p };
}

function drawMapBodies() {
  var L = $("map-bodies");
if (!L) { return; }
clear(L);

var lay = curLayer(), bodies = curBodies();
var j, b, size, dot, lab, mk, hb, ring;

/* THE SHIP'S POSITION RING IS DRAWN FIRST, NOT LAST.
   It is 26px of transparent, positioned element and it sits
   exactly on top of the body the ship is parked at. Painted
   last it swallowed every click aimed at the current
   location - the same failure recorded in Entry 015. Drawn
   first, the dot and its label sit above it and stay
   reachable, and the ring is bound as well so clicking the
   ship itself selects where the ship is. */
/* On the system layer the ring is the ship and slides along
   its course. On the wider layers there is no ship to draw at
   that scale, so it rings the system or region the ship is
   inside - "you are in here" rather than "you are here". */
hb = homeBody();
if (hb) {
    mk = (lay.id === "system") ? travelMarker() : { x:hb.x, y:hb.y };
    if (lay.id === "sector" || lay.id === "galaxy") {
       var trip = findOngoing("travel"), dest = trip && findById(SECTOR_BODIES, trip.target);
       var markerTarget = lay.id === "galaxy" && dest ? findById(GALAXY_BODIES, dest.region) : dest;
       if (markerTarget && (lay.id === "galaxy" || dest.region === hb.region)) {
          var part = ongoingPercent(trip) / 100;
          mk = {x:hb.x + (markerTarget.x - hb.x) * part, y:hb.y + (markerTarget.y - hb.y) * part};
       }
    }
    ring = make("div", "maphere");
    ring.style.left = (mapX(mk.x) - 13) + "px";
    ring.style.top = (mapY(mk.y) - 13) + "px";
    ring.style.width = "26px";
    ring.style.height = "26px";
    bindSelect(ring, hb.id);
    L.appendChild(ring);
}

for (j = 0; j < bodies.length; j++) {
   b = bodies[j];
   /* generous hit targets - these are the primary control
      of the whole screen */
   /* outer sizes now: border-box means the 2px white ring is
      inside the number, so these are 4 larger than before and
      the dot lands exactly on its coordinate */
   size = (b.type === "station") ? 18 : 16;
   if (b.type === "origin") { size = 14; }
   if (b.type === "moon") { size = 12; }
   if (b.subtype === "gas") { size = 20; }
   if (b.type === "system") { size = 18; }
   if (b.type === "region") { size = 22; }

  dot = make("div", "mapdot" +
    (b.type === "station" ? " mapdot-station" : "") +
    (b.type === "star" ? " mapdot-star" : "") +
    (b.type === "planet" ? " mapdot-planet" : "") +
    (b.type === "moon" ? " mapdot-moon" : "") +
    (b.subtype ? " mapdot-" + b.subtype : "") +
    (b.type === "belt" ? " mapdot-belt" : "") +
    (b.type === "site" ? " mapdot-site" : "") +
    (b.type === "system" ? " mapdot-sys" : "") +
    (b.type === "region" ? " mapdot-region" : "") +
    (STATE.navTarget === b.id ? " mapdot-sel" : ""));
  dot.style.left = (mapX(b.x) - size / 2) + "px";
  dot.style.top = (mapY(b.y) - size / 2) + "px";
  dot.style.width = size + "px";
  dot.style.height = size + "px";
  bindSelect(dot, b.id);
        L.appendChild(dot);

        lab = make("div", "maplabel", b.name);
        lab.style.top = (mapY(b.y) - 6) + "px";
        lab.style.width = "92px";
        /* flip the label inward near the right edge or the map's
           overflow clips it */
        if (mapX(b.x) > MAP.vw * 0.78 || (mapY(b.y) < 150 &&
            mapX(b.x) + 10 + Math.min(92, b.name.length * 5.5) > MAP.vw - 76)) {
            lab.style.left   = (mapX(b.x) - 100) + "px";
            lab.style.textAlign = "right";
        } else {
            lab.style.left   = (mapX(b.x) + 10) + "px";
            lab.style.textAlign = "left";
        }
        bindSelect(lab, b.id);
        L.appendChild(lab);
    }

    var sc = $("map-scale");
    if (sc) { sc.innerHTML = (lay.id === "system" ? currentSystem().name + " - System" :
       (lay.id === "sector" ? findById(GALAXY_BODIES, MAP.sector).name + " - Sector" : "Galaxy")) +
       " - zoom x" + MAP.zoom.toFixed(1); }
}

/* closure guard, same pattern as the other binders */
function bindSelect(el, bodyId) {
   on(el, "click", function () {
      /* the click that ends a pan is not a choice of target */
      if (dragged()) { return; }
      selectBody(bodyId);
   });
}

/* FREE. No performAction, no spawnActionMark, no tick. */
function selectBody(bodyId) {
   STATE.navTarget = bodyId;
   curLayer().sel = bodyId;
   drawMapRoutes();
   drawMapBodies();
   paintNavPanels();
}

/* FREE. */
function zoomMap(dir) {
   MAP.zoom += dir * MAP.zstep;
   if (MAP.zoom < MAP.zmin) { MAP.zoom = MAP.zmin; }
   if (MAP.zoom > MAP.zmax) { MAP.zoom = MAP.zmax; }
   MAP.zoom = Math.round(MAP.zoom * 10) / 10;

    /* keep the raster in step with the chart. Harmless no-op in
      any mode that ignores background-size. */
    applyRaster();

    drawMapRoutes();
    drawMapBodies();
}


/* ================================================================
  SECTION I-3 : MAP AMBIENT MOTION
  Cosmetic only, exactly like the crew dots. Drifting rock,
  an orbiting satellite and a blinking station beacon. This
  timer must never touch game state. It runs only while the
  Navigation screen is on show and is killed on any screen
  change, so it cannot leak.
  ================================================================ */

var NAVFX = { timer:null, rocks:[], sat:null, beacon:null, phase:0 };

function startNavFX() {
  stopNavFX();
  var L = $("map-fx");
  if (!L) { return; }

    var i, r, el;
    for (i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
       el = make("div", "rock");
       r={
          el : el,
          x : Math.random() * MAP.w,
          y : 96 + Math.random() * 120,
          vx : 0.10 + Math.random() * 0.22,
          s : 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)
       };
       el.style.width = r.s + "px";
       el.style.height = r.s + "px";
       L.appendChild(el);
       NAVFX.rocks[NAVFX.rocks.length] = r;
    }

    var bodies = curBodies(), station = null;
    for (i = 0; i < bodies.length; i++) { if (bodies[i].type === "station") { station = bodies[i]; break; } }
    if (station) {
       el = make("div", "sat"); L.appendChild(el);
       NAVFX.sat = { el:el, host:station, r:17, ang:0, speed:0.022 };
       el = make("div", "beacon"); L.appendChild(el);
       NAVFX.beacon = { el:el, host:station };
    }

    navFxTick(true); /* place static details even when motion is reduced */
    NAVFX.timer = window.setInterval(navFxTick, 60);
}

function stopNavFX() {
  if (NAVFX.timer) { window.clearInterval(NAVFX.timer); }
  NAVFX.timer = null;
  NAVFX.rocks = [];
     if ($("map-fx")) { clear($("map-fx")); }
     NAVFX.sat = null;
     NAVFX.beacon = null;
}

function navFxTick(force) {
  if (!$("map-fx")) { stopNavFX(); return; }
  if (STATE.reducedMotion && force !== true) { return; }
  var i, r;

     for (i = 0; i < NAVFX.rocks.length; i++) {
        r = NAVFX.rocks[i];
        r.x += r.vx;
        if (mapX(r.x) > MAP.vw + 12) { r.x = MAP.cx - (MAP.cx + 20) / MAP.zoom; }
        r.el.style.left = Math.round(mapX(r.x)) + "px";
        r.el.style.top = Math.round(mapY(r.y)) + "px";
     }

     if (NAVFX.sat) {
        NAVFX.sat.ang += NAVFX.sat.speed;
        var sx = NAVFX.sat.host.x + Math.cos(NAVFX.sat.ang) * NAVFX.sat.r;
        var sy = NAVFX.sat.host.y + Math.sin(NAVFX.sat.ang) * (NAVFX.sat.r * 0.55);
        NAVFX.sat.el.style.left = Math.round(mapX(sx)) + "px";
        NAVFX.sat.el.style.top = Math.round(mapY(sy)) + "px";
     }

     NAVFX.phase++;
     if (NAVFX.beacon) {
        var b = NAVFX.beacon.host;
        NAVFX.beacon.el.style.left = Math.round(mapX(b.x) - 1) + "px";
        NAVFX.beacon.el.style.top = Math.round(mapY(b.y) - 9) + "px";
        setOpacity(NAVFX.beacon.el, (NAVFX.phase % 22) < 11 ? 1 : 0.15);
     }
}


/* ================================================================
  SECTION I-4 : DERIVED DISTANCES AND PANEL PAINTING
  ================================================================ */

/* Distance is measured, never authored, so it stays truthful
  after the ship relocates. */
function navMetrics(b) {
   var here = findById(BODIES, MAP.here), origin, fromRegion, toRegion, dx, dy, px, dist;
   if (b.type === "system") {
      origin = currentSystem();
      if (b.region === origin.region) {
         dx = b.x - origin.x; dy = b.y - origin.y;
         px = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      } else {
         fromRegion = findById(GALAXY_BODIES, origin.region);
         toRegion = findById(GALAXY_BODIES, b.region);
         dx = (toRegion.x - fromRegion.x) * 1.3; dy = (toRegion.y - fromRegion.y) * 1.3;
         px = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + 150;
      }
      dist = Math.max(6, Math.round(px / 24) + 5);
   } else {
      dx = b.x - here.x; dy = b.y - here.y;
      px = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      dist = Math.max(3, Math.round(px / MAP.pxPerAction));
   }
   if (atTarget(b)) { dist = 0; }

     var navigator = assignedNavigator();
     var drivePercent = STATE.upgrades.drive ? 80 : 100;
     var navPercent = 100 - (navigator ? navigatorDiscount(navigator) : 0);
     var ly = dist * MAP.lyPerAction;
     var e13 = (ly * 9.46) / 10;  /* 1 ly = 9.46 x 10^12 km */
    var days = dist * 19;
    var mon = Math.floor(days / 30);
    var rem = days - mon * 30;

    return {
       dist : dist,
       fuel : Math.ceil(dist * drivePercent * navPercent / 10000),
       /* what the crossing ACTUALLY costs the player: the action
         that commits it, plus the distance drained afterwards.
         The panel used to print dist alone, so a 21 action trip
         quietly took 22 clicks. */
       total : dist + 1,
       ly    : ly.toFixed(1) + " ly",
       km : e13.toFixed(1) + " x 10^13 km",
       transit : mon > 0 ? "~" + plur(mon, "month") + ", " + plur(rem, "day")
                    : "~" + plur(days, "day")
    };
}

function plur(n, word) { return n + " " + word + (n === 1 ? "" : "s"); }

function paintNavPanels() {
  var b     = STATE.navTarget ? findBody(STATE.navTarget) : null;
  var here = findById(BODIES, MAP.here);
  var running = findOngoing("travel");

    if (!b) {
       setPanel("nav-name", '<span class="dim">No target selected</span>');
       setPanel("nav-class", '<span class="dim">Select a body on the chart.</span>');
       setPanel("nav-status", '<span class="dim">Idle</span>');
       setPanel("nav-details", '<span class="dim">No target.</span>');
       setPanel("nav-scan", '<span class="dim">No scan data.</span>');
       setPanel("nav-dist", '<span class="dim">No route plotted.</span>');
    } else if (b.type === "region") {
       var sectorCount = 0, regionInfo = "", ri;
       for (ri = 0; ri < SECTOR_BODIES.length; ri++) { if (SECTOR_BODIES[ri].region === b.id) { sectorCount++; } }
       for (ri = 0; ri < b.details.length; ri++) { regionInfo += field(b.details[ri][0], b.details[ri][1]); }
       setPanel("nav-name", '<div class="navname">' + b.name + '</div><div class="navsub">Galactic region</div>');
       setPanel("nav-class", b.klass);
       setPanel("nav-status", currentSystem().region === b.id ? "Current region" : "Chart available");
       setPanel("nav-details", regionInfo + field("Systems", sectorCount + " navigable"));
       setPanel("nav-scan", "Open the sector chart to choose a system. Local bodies can be scanned after arrival.");
       setPanel("nav-dist", "Select a system on the sector chart to plot a jump.");
    } else if (!inRange(b)) {
       /* Looking is always free, even across a galaxy. What the
         player gets for free is the chart entry - a name and a
         classification. Anything the SHIP would have to measure
         is refused, because the ship cannot reach it. */
       setPanel("nav-name",
          '<div class="navname">' + b.name + '</div>' +
          '<div class="navsub">Long range contact - ' +
          curLayer().name + ' chart</div>');
       setPanel("nav-class", b.klass);
       setPanel("nav-status", b.home ? "Current position"
                            : "Out of sensor range");
       setPanel("nav-details", OUT_OF_RANGE);
       setPanel("nav-scan", OUT_OF_RANGE);
       setPanel("nav-dist", OUT_OF_RANGE);

    } else {
       var m = navMetrics(b);

      setPanel("nav-name",
      '<div class="navname">' + b.name + '</div>' +
      '<div class="navsub">' + (atTarget(b)
         ? "Current position"
         : "From " + (b.type === "system" ? currentSystem().name : here.name)) + '</div>');

    setPanel("nav-class", b.klass);

    setPanel("nav-status", atTarget(b)
       ? (b.type === "system" ? "Current system" : "Current position")
       : (running ? "Crossing under way" : "Reachable"));

    /* target details, origin included here per design */
    var i, html = "";
    for (i = 0; i < b.details.length; i++) {
       html += field(b.details[i][0], b.details[i][1]);
    }
    html += field("Origin", b.type === "system" ? currentSystem().name : here.name);
    setPanel("nav-details", html);

    setPanel("nav-scan", b.type === "system"
       ? "Jump to this system, then use the System chart to scan its stars and other destinations."
       : scanReadout(b));

    setPanel("nav-dist", atTarget(b)
       ? '<span class="dim">You are already here.</span>'
       : field("Distance", m.ly) +
         field("", m.km) +
         field("Transit", m.transit) +
         field("Action cost", plur(m.total, "action")) +
         field("Fuel required", m.fuel + "%") +
         field("Navigator", assignedNavigator() ? assignedNavigator().name + " (-" + navigatorDiscount(assignedNavigator()) + "% fuel at departure)" : "None available") +
         field("", "1 to commit, " + plur(m.dist, "action") +
                " under way"));
}

/* --- the action band owns the commit buttons, so it is
   rebuilt from scratch on every paint --- */
var actions = $("nav-actions");
if (!actions) { return; }
clear(actions);

/* the previous paint's buttons are gone from the document;
  drop their refs or updateProgressUI keeps painting orphans */
PROGRESS_UI = {};

var reach = !!(b && inRange(b));
if (b && b.type === "region") {
  commandRow(actions, "View " + b.name + " sector chart", true, function () { viewSector(b.id); }, "free");
}

actions.appendChild(make("div", "actionbar",
  reach && !atTarget(b)
     ? "Course from " + (b.type === "system" ? currentSystem().name : here.name) + " to " + b.name + "."
     : (b && !reach
        ? '<span class="dim">' + (b.type === "region" ? 'Open this sector chart to plot a jump.' :
          'This contact is outside the local sensor range.') + '</span>'
        : '<span class="dim">Plot a course by selecting a ' +
          'destination.</span>')));
    var row = make("div", "actionrow");
    var scan = findOngoing("scan");

    row.appendChild(actionCell(buildProgressButton(
       "travel", b && b.type === "system" ? "Start Jump" : "Start Travel", startTravel,
       !!(reach && !atTarget(b) && !STATE.docked && STATE.engineCondition > 0 &&
          statValue("energy").value > 0 && statValue("fuel").value >= navMetrics(b).fuel),
       undefined, "space"
    )));

    /* A scan running on a DIFFERENT body must not look like it
       belongs to this one, so that case gets a dead task id of its
       own: nothing is found for it, and it paints as inert. One
       set of sensors, one scan at a time. */
    if (scan && scan.state === "running" && b && scan.target !== b.id) {
        row.appendChild(actionCell(buildProgressButton(
           "scan-busy", "Sensors busy", startScan, false, "Scan Complete", "space"
        )));
    } else {
        row.appendChild(actionCell(buildProgressButton(
           "scan", "Run Deep Scan", startScan,
           reach && b.type !== "system" && statValue("energy").value > 0, "Scan Complete", "space"
        )));
    }

    actions.appendChild(row);
    commandRow(actions, "Stand watch - advance ongoing work", !STATE.gameOver, standWatch, undefined, "space");
    actions.appendChild(make("div", "actionnote", "Standing watch spends one action and needs no item; work and survival clocks advance, with normal resource use."));
    if (PORTS[MAP.here] && !STATE.docked && !running) {
       commandRow(actions, "Dock at " + PORTS[MAP.here].name, true, function (e) {
          commitChange(e, "Docked at " + PORTS[MAP.here].name, function () {
             STATE.docked = true; contractProgress("visit", MAP.here);
             findById(INFOS, "location").value = PORTS[MAP.here].name + " - docked";
          });
       }, undefined, "space");
    }

    actions.appendChild(make("div", "actionnote",
      statValue("energy").value <= 0 ? '<span class="dim">Restore energy to use navigation and sensors.</span>' :
      (STATE.docked ? '<span class="dim">Undock at the station before plotting a crossing.</span>' :
      (STATE.engineCondition <= 0 ? '<span class="dim">The drive needs maintenance before travel.</span>' :
      (reach && !atTarget(b) && statValue("fuel").value < navMetrics(b).fuel
         ? '<span class="dim">Insufficient fuel. Right-click the fuel gauge to refuel.</span>' :
      running
         ? '<span class="dim">A crossing is already under way.</span>'
         : '<span class="dim">Committing costs one action now, then the ' +
           'distance in actions spent elsewhere aboard the ship. A deep ' +
           'scan costs one action now and ' + simScanCost() + ' spent elsewhere.</span>')))));
}

/* one slot in the action row - keeps the buttons a normal width
  instead of letting them span the panel */
function actionCell(btn) {
   var c = make("div", "actioncell");
   c.appendChild(btn);
   return c;
}

/* The scan panel is a reward, not a description. Chart data -
  name, class, distance - is free because looking is free. What
  the sensors found is not, and it stays blank until a deep scan
  has been run AND the player has gone back to read it. */
function scanReadout(b) {
   var st = findOngoing("scan"), i, html;

    /* the sensors have a horizon, and it is not negotiable */
    if (!inRange(b)) { return OUT_OF_RANGE; }

    if (!STATE.scanned[b.id]) {
       if (st && st.target === b.id) {
          return st.state === "done"
             ? '<span class="dim">Deep scan complete. Readout waiting.</span>'
             : '<span class="dim">Deep scan under way.</span>';
        }
        return '<span class="dim">No detailed data. Sensors idle.</span>';
    }

    /* tiered: what this scan found, then what it could not reach */
    html = "";
    for (i = 0; i < b.scan.length; i++) {
       html += '<div class="scanline">' + b.scan[i] + '</div>';
    }
    for (i = 0; i < b.scanLocked.length; i++) {
       html += '<div class="scanlock">' + b.scanLocked[i] +
             ' - sensors insufficient</div>';
    }
    return html;
}

function setPanel(id, html) {
  var el = $(id);
  if (el) { el.innerHTML = html; }
}

function field(k, v) {
  return '<div class="navfield"><div class="navfield-k">' + k +
       '</div><div class="navfield-v">' + v +
       '</div><div class="clear"></div></div>';
}

/* THE COMMITMENT. The only thing on this screen that costs. */
function standWatch(e) {
  if (STATE.gameOver) { return; }
  commitChange(e, "Stood watch", function () {});
}
function startTravel(e) {
   var b = STATE.navTarget ? findBody(STATE.navTarget) : null;
   if (!b || !inRange(b) || atTarget(b)) { return; }
   if (findOngoing("travel")) { return; }
   if (STATE.docked || STATE.engineCondition <= 0 || statValue("energy").value <= 0) { return; }

    var m = navMetrics(b);
    if (statValue("fuel").value < m.fuel) { return; }
    statValue("fuel").value -= m.fuel;

    /* Order matters. The initiating action is spent FIRST, so the
      tick it causes cannot eat a step of the journey it starts.
      Manifesto 1.3: one click to initiate, then the distance. */
    fireAction(e, "Course locked - " + b.name);
    if (STATE.gameOver) { return; }

    addOngoing("travel", "Under way to " + b.name, m.dist, "travel", b.id);

    paintProgress("travel");
    paintNavPanels();
    drawMapBodies();
}

/* THE SECOND COMMITMENT. Reading the chart is free, but asking
  the sensors for more is work, so it costs exactly like a
  crossing does: one action now, the rest spent elsewhere. */
function startScan(e) {
   var b = STATE.navTarget ? findBody(STATE.navTarget) : null;
   if (!b || !inRange(b) || b.type === "system") { return; }
   if (findOngoing("scan") || statValue("energy").value <= 0) { return; }

    /* same ordering rule as startTravel: spend the initiating
      action FIRST, so the tick it causes cannot eat a step of
      the work it is starting */
    var cost = simScanCost();
    STATE.sim.sensor = 0;
    fireAction(e, "Deep scan started - " + b.name);
    if (STATE.gameOver) { return; }

    addOngoing("scan", "Deep scan - " + b.name, cost, "scan", b.id);

    paintProgress("scan");
    paintNavPanels();
}

/* THE REVEAL. Called from the type table when the player clicks a
  finished scan. The data existed all along; the player earning
  the right to see it is the mechanic. */
function revealScan(bodyId) {
   var b = findById(BODIES, bodyId);
   if (!b) { return; }
   var first = !STATE.scanned[b.id];
   STATE.scanned[b.id] = true;
   simOnScan(b, first);
   fileSurvey(b);            /* the readout becomes a saleable record */
   contractProgress("scan", b.id);
   commissionProgress("scan", b.id);
   checkCommendations();
   /* look at what was just read, in case the player wandered off
      to another body while the sensors worked */
   if (bodySystem(b) === currentSystem().id) {
      LAYERS.system.sel = b.id;
      if (MAP.layer === "system") { STATE.navTarget = b.id; }
   }
   logLine("Deep scan readout filed: " + b.name +
          ". Survey record stored in the Science Room.");
}

/* Arrival. Called when the player acknowledges a finished
  crossing. The ship genuinely relocates, which is safe because
  every distance is measured from MAP.here rather than authored. */
function arriveAt(bodyId) {
   var sys = findById(SECTOR_BODIES, bodyId);
   var b = findById(BODIES, sys ? sys.entry : bodyId);
   if (!b) { return; }
   MAP.here = b.id;
   LAYERS.system.sel = b.id;
   if (sys) {
      MAP.sector = sys.region; LAYERS.sector.sel = sys.id; LAYERS.galaxy.sel = sys.region;
      if (MAP.layer === "sector") { STATE.navTarget = sys.id; }
      else if (MAP.layer === "galaxy") { STATE.navTarget = sys.region; }
      contractProgress("visit", sys.id);
      if (MAP.layer === "system" && $("map-fx")) { startNavFX(); }
   }
   if (MAP.layer === "system") { STATE.navTarget = b.id; }
   STATE.docked = !!PORTS[b.id];
   findById(INFOS, "location").value = b.name + (STATE.docked ? " - docked" : "");
   var contact = findById(INFOS, "contacts");
   if (contact) { contact.value = STATE.docked ? b.name + " - station contact" : "Charted objects in " + currentSystem().name; }
   contractProgress("visit", b.id);
   logLine("Arrived at " + b.name + (STATE.docked ? " - docked. Right-click the docked indicator to open the station" : "") + ".");
   simRemember("Arrival", "The ship arrived at " + b.name + ".");
   chronicleVisit(currentSystem()); commissionProgress("visit", b.id); checkCommendations();
   setStatus();
}


/* ================================================================

    SECTION I-3 : ENGINE ROOM
    The second task window built on the house frame: a fixed stage
    dead centre, reading panels around it, commitments full width
    underneath. The stage here is a machine rather than a chart.
 THE MACHINE is pure markup - absolutely positioned divs inside
 a fixed 560x300 box. No canvas, no SVG, no images: a single
 .hta has nowhere to keep an image and Trident cannot be
 trusted with the rest. Every part is drawn from a table below,
 so the illustration is data and not three hundred lines of
 hand-written HTML.

 ALL OF IT IS FLAVOUR EXCEPT ONE READING. The condition meter
 is the only thing on the machine connected to state; the
 gauges, valves, cylinders and statistics exist to make the
 drive feel like a machine that could go wrong.
 ================================================================ */

function buildEngineScreen(host, t) {
  var scr = make("div", "task-screen");

  scr.appendChild(make("div", "task-head",
     '<div class="task-kind">ROOM</div>' +
     '<div class="task-title">Engine Room</div>' +
     '<div class="task-sub">Propulsion and power - the drive wears ' +
     'with every action spent aboard.</div>'));

  var wrap = make("div", "navwrap");
  var main = make("div", "navmain");

  /* --- left : what the drive is doing ------------------- */
  var cl = make("div", "navcell navcell-l");
  cl.appendChild(navPanel("Engine Condition", "eng-cond", ""));
  cl.appendChild(navPanel("Wear",                "eng-wear", ""));
  cl.appendChild(navPanel("Drive",               "eng-drive", "np-last"));
  main.appendChild(cl);

  /* --- centre : the machine ----------------------------- */
  var cc = make("div", "navcell navcell-c");
  var mid = make("div", "navcenter");
  mid.appendChild(buildMachine());

  var under = make("div", "navrow");
  under.appendChild(navPanel("Maintenance", "eng-maint", "np-half"));
  under.appendChild(navPanel("Readings", "eng-read", "np-half-last"));
  mid.appendChild(under);

  cc.appendChild(mid);
  main.appendChild(cc);

  /* --- right : who is in here --------------------------- */
  var cr = make("div", "navcell navcell-r");
  cr.appendChild(navPanel("Engineering Crew", "eng-crew", "np-last"));
  main.appendChild(cr);

  wrap.appendChild(main);
    var r3 = make("div", "navrow");
    r3.appendChild(navPanel("Engine Actions", "eng-actions", "np-full"));
    wrap.appendChild(r3);

    scr.appendChild(wrap);
    host.appendChild(scr);

    paintEngine();
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
  THE MACHINE, AS DATA
  Each row is [class, left, top, width, height, html]. Height or
  width of 0 means the rule supplies it. Anything decorative gets
  pointer-events:none through .mach-part, because scenery painted
  over a control has swallowed a click three separate times in
  this project already.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function buildMachine() {
   var m = make("div", null);
   m.id = "machine";
   m.style.width = STAGE.engine.w + "px";
   m.style.height = STAGE.engine.h + "px";

    var k, p, i2, a, x, y, cx, cy, r;

    /* --- chassis corner brackets --------------------------- */
    var BRK = [[16, 16, 1, 1], [634, 16, -1, 1],

/* one absolutely positioned part of the illustration */
function mpart(cls, x, y, w, h, html) {
   var el = make("div", "mach-part " + cls, html);
   el.style.left = x + "px";
   el.style.top = y + "px";
   if (w) { el.style.width = w + "px"; }
   if (h) { el.style.height = h + "px"; }
   return el;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
  PAINTING THE ENGINE
  Called after every action and after every repair. Safe to call
  when the window is not open - every lookup is guarded.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function paintEngine() {
   if (!$("eng-actions")) { return; }

  var c = STATE.engineCondition;
  var cost = maintCost();
  var eng = assignedEngineer();
  var run = maintRunning();
  var tone, word;

  if (c >= 75)     { tone = "#7f9161"; word = "NOMINAL"; }
  else if (c >= 50) { tone = "#c08a3e"; word = "SERVICEABLE"; }
  else if (c >= 25) { tone = "#c08a3e"; word = "DEGRADED"; }
  else          { tone = "#b05a42"; word = "CRITICAL"; }

  /* the meter on the machine */
  if ($("eng-meter")) {
     $("eng-meter").style.width     = Math.round(420 * (c / 100)) + "px";
     $("eng-meter").style.background = tone;
  }
  if ($("eng-pct")) { $("eng-pct").innerHTML = c + "%"; }
  if ($("eng-word")) {
     $("eng-word").innerHTML = word;
     $("eng-word").style.color = tone;
  }

  setPanel("eng-cond",
     '<div class="navname" style="color:' + tone + ';">' + c + '%</div>' +
     '<div class="navsub">' + word + '</div>' +
     field("Threshold", ENGINE.warnBelow + "% - warning line"));

  setPanel("eng-wear",
     field("Rate", "1% per " + ENGINE.wearEvery + " actions") +
     field("Next step", (ENGINE.wearEvery - STATE.wearTick) +
           " action" + (ENGINE.wearEvery - STATE.wearTick === 1 ? "" : "s")) +
     field("Full cycle", (100 * ENGINE.wearEvery) + " actions"));

  setPanel("eng-drive",
     field("Class", "Kestrel light hauler") +
     field("Core", "Primary - single") +
     field("Cylinders", "12 in bank 1"));

  setPanel("eng-maint",
     (c >= 100
        ? '<span class="dim">Engine is at full condition. ' +
          'Nothing to maintain.</span>'
        : field("Cost now", cost + " action" + (cost === 1 ? "" : "s")) +
          field("Formula", "1 action per 10% missing") +
          field("Restores", "to 100%")));

  setPanel("eng-read",
     field("Output", "4.21 TJ") +
      field("Coolant", "Stable") +
      field("Bearing wear", (Math.round((100 - c) * 0.7) / 10) + " mm"));

    setPanel("eng-crew",
       (eng
         ? '<div class="navname">' + eng.name + '</div>' +
           '<div class="navsub">' + eng.role + ' - maintenance job</div>' +
           field("Skill", eng.skill) +
           field("Acts at", effectiveJobAt(eng) + "% condition" +
                (effectiveJobAt(eng) !== eng.jobAt
                   ? " (air: was " + eng.jobAt + ")" : "")) +
           field("Activity", eng.activity) +
           '<div class="navnote">He holds the maintenance job and will ' +
           'service the drive unasked - but not before it falls to ' +
           eng.jobAt + '%, which is long past the warning. Training at ' +
           'a station, or a better engineer, raises that.</div>'
         : '<span class="dim">Nobody holds the maintenance job. The ' +
           'commander runs it personally, or nobody does.</span>'));

    paintEngineActions(c, cost, eng, run);
}

/* the commitment band, rebuilt whenever the situation changes */
function paintEngineActions(c, cost, eng, run) {
   var band = $("eng-actions");
   if (!band) { return; }
   clear(band);

    /* the old buttons are gone - drop their DOM refs or the
      progress painter will write into detached elements */
    PROGRESS_UI["maint"] = null;
    PROGRESS_UI["maint-eng"] = null;

    band.appendChild(make("div", "actionbar",
      c >= 100
         ? '<span class="dim">The drive is at full condition. ' +
           'Maintenance cannot be run on a perfect engine.</span>'
         : "Maintenance will cost " + cost + " action" +
           (cost === 1 ? "" : "s") + " spent anywhere aboard, and " +
           "restores the drive to 100%."));

    var row = make("div", "actionrow");

    /* ONE maintenance slot. If the engineer took the job on himself
      the same slot shows HIS progress - the player watches it fill
      rather than owning it.

     THIS ROW IS A LIST, NOT A PAIR. Every future engine job -
     overhaul a cylinder, purge the coolant loop, retune the
     flux, strip the turbine - appends one more actionCell here
     and one more TASK_TYPES entry. The machine already has the
     parts drawn for them. No layout change will be needed:
       .actionrow centres whatever it is given. */
    if (findOngoing("maint-eng")) {
        row.appendChild(actionCell(buildProgressButton(
          "maint-eng", "Engineer working", startMaintSelf, false)));
    } else {
        row.appendChild(actionCell(buildProgressButton(
          "maint", "Run Maintenance", startMaintSelf, c < 100 && !findOngoing("project-cooling"))));
    }

    band.appendChild(row);
    band.appendChild(make("div", "clear"));
}

function startMaintSelf(e) { startMaint(e, "maint", "the commander"); }

/* Refuses a perfect engine, refuses a second spanner, otherwise
  commits the work and charges the action that started it. */
function startMaint(e, id, who) {
   if (STATE.engineCondition >= 100) {
      logLine("Maintenance refused - the drive is already at full condition.");
      return;
   }
   if (maintRunning()) { return; }

    var cost = maintCost();
    MAINT_CLAIM = true;
    try {
       fireAction(e, "Engine maintenance begun by " + who);
    } catch (err) { MAINT_CLAIM = false; throw err; }
    MAINT_CLAIM = false;

    var t = addOngoing(id, "Maintenance - " + who, cost, "maint", "engine");
    if (t) { t.by = who; }

    paintEngine();
}

function startCookSelf(e) { startCook(e, "cook", "the commander"); }

/* Refuses a full rack, refuses a second pot on the stove, else
   commits the work at rate 1 - the commander is not a trained
   cook and never claims to be. */
function startCook(e, id, who) {
   if (MESS.rack >= MESS.capacity) {
      logLine("Cooking refused - the rack is already full.");
      return;
   }
   if (findOngoing("cook") || findOngoing("project-food") || PROJECT_CLAIM === "food") { return; }

    var w = assignedCook();
    var rate = (who === "the commander") ? 1 : (w ? w.jobAt : 1);
    var cost = crewCost(Math.ceil((MESS.capacity - MESS.rack) / rate));

    COOK_CLAIM = true;
    try {
       fireAction(e, "Cooking begun by " + who);
    } catch (err) { COOK_CLAIM = false; throw err; }
    COOK_CLAIM = false;

    var t = addOngoing(id, "Cooking - " + who, cost, "cook", "mess");
    if (t) { t.by = who; t.rate = rate; }

    paintMess();
}


/* ================================================================
  SECTION I-4 : THE O2 FILTER ROOM
  Same frame as Navigation and the Engine Room: a fixed stage
  centre-top, reading columns either side, paired panels beneath
  it, one full-width band of commitments at the bottom.
  The only things on this screen that are not scenery are the
  state of the three slots and the charge left in the bank.
  ================================================================ */
function buildO2Screen(host, t) {
   var scr = make("div", "task-screen");

    scr.appendChild(make("div", "task-head",
       '<div class="task-kind">ROOM</div>' +
       '<div class="task-title">O2 Filter Room</div>' +
      '<div class="task-sub">Air is the only thing aboard that ' +
      'nobody can do without.</div>'));

    var wrap = make("div", "navwrap");
    var main = make("div", "navmain");

    var cl = make("div", "navcell navcell-l");
    cl.appendChild(navPanel("Air Quality", "o2-air-p", ""));
    cl.appendChild(navPanel("Filter Lifespan", "o2-life", ""));
    cl.appendChild(navPanel("Slots",         "o2-slotsp", "np-last"));
    main.appendChild(cl);

    var cc = make("div", "navcell navcell-c");
    var mid = make("div", "navcenter");
    mid.appendChild(buildFilterMachine());

    var under = make("div", "navrow");
    under.appendChild(navPanel("System Status", "o2-status", "np-half"));
    under.appendChild(navPanel("Pro-Action Burst", "o2-burst", "np-half-last"));
    mid.appendChild(under);

    cc.appendChild(mid);
    main.appendChild(cc);

    var cr = make("div", "navcell navcell-r");
    cr.appendChild(navPanel("Canister Inventory", "o2-rack", ""));
    cr.appendChild(navPanel("Life Support Crew", "o2-crew", "np-last"));
    main.appendChild(cr);

    wrap.appendChild(main);

    var r3 = make("div", "navrow");
    r3.appendChild(navPanel("Filter Actions", "o2-actions", "np-full"));
    wrap.appendChild(r3);

    scr.appendChild(wrap);
    host.appendChild(scr);

    paintO2();
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------

  Positioned divs again. Scenery carries .o2-part and therefore
  pointer-events:none - the three install buttons are the only
  live things in the box and they are appended LAST so nothing is
  ever painted over them. Fourth time that rule has earned its
  keep in this project.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
var DUST = [[48,66],[96,88],[150,62],[204,94],[262,70],[318,100],
         [372,64],[430,92],[486,72],[534,96],[72,102],[128,74],

 buildFilterMachine() {
   var m = make("div", null);

    m.appendChild(el);
    el = opart("o2-neck", sx + 78, 154, 24, 8, "");

    m.appendChild(el);

    el = opart("o2-state", sx + 8, 242, 164, 14, "EMPTY");

    m.appendChild(el);

    m.appendChild(opart("o2-track", sx + 30, 260, 120, 8, ""));

    el.id = "o2-bar" + k;
    m.appendChild(el);

    /* the live control - deliberately NOT a .o2-part */

    el.id = "o2-btnwrap" + k;
    el.style.left = (sx + 5) + "px";
        el.style.top = "286px";
