/* one absolutely positioned piece of scenery */
function opart(cls, x, y, w, h, html) {
   var el = make("div", "o2-part " + cls, html);
   el.style.left = x + "px";
   el.style.top = y + "px";
   if (w) { el.style.width = w + "px"; }
   if (h) { el.style.height = h + "px"; }
   return el;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
  PAINTING
  Everything visible about the bank is derived from LIFE.slots and
  STATE.filterLife. Nothing is stored twice.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function paintO2() {
   if (!$("o2-actions")) { return; }

    var i, sl, el, run = bankRunning(), tone = airTone(), word = airWord();
    var pct = Math.round((STATE.filterLife / LIFE.lifeMax) * 100);

    paintAir(run, word, tone);

    for (i = 0; i < LIFE.slots.length; i++) {
       sl = LIFE.slots[i];

        el = $("o2-well" + i);
        if (el) {
           el.className = "o2-part o2-well" +
              (sl.state === "empty" ? " o2-well-bare" : "");
        }
        el = $("o2-can" + i);
        if (el) {
           el.style.display = (sl.state === "empty") ? "none" : "block";
           el.className = "o2-part o2-can" +
              (sl.state === "active" ? " o2-can-live" : "");
        }
        el = $("o2-neck" + i);
    if (el) { el.style.display = (sl.state === "empty") ? "none" : "block"; }

    el = $("o2-state" + i);
    if (el) {
       el.innerHTML = (sl.state === "empty" ? "EMPTY"
                 : (sl.state === "installed" ? "INSTALLED" : (run ? "ACTIVE" : "NO POWER")));
       el.style.color = (sl.state === "active") ? "#7f9161"
                  : ((sl.state === "installed") ? "#8c6f4e" : "#b05a42");
    }
    el = $("o2-bar" + i);
    if (el) {
       el.style.width = (sl.state === "active"
          ? Math.round(120 * (pct / 100)) : 0) + "px";
    }
}

paintO2Buttons();

setPanel("o2-air-p",
   '<div class="navname" style="color:' + tone + ';">' + word + '</div>' +
   '<div class="navsub">' + (run
      ? "Scrubbed and circulating"
      : "Unfiltered - the bank is not running") + '</div>' +
   barLine(airPercent(), tone) +
   field("Cabin air", run ? "Replenished"
                   : (STATE.airHold + " of " + AIR.holdMax)) +
   field("Declines", "one step per " + AIR.step + " actions") +
   field("Crew", airPenalty()) +
   (airStage() < 3
      ? '<div class="navnote">Bad air harms the crew and can eventually ' +
        'kill them. It also slows their work and delays their response.</div>'
      : ""));

setPanel("o2-life",
   '<div class="navname">' + STATE.filterLife +
   ' <span class="navsub">of ' + LIFE.lifeMax + '</span></div>' +
   '<div class="navsub">actions of clean air</div>' +
   barLine(pct, tone) +
   field("Burn rate", LIFE.decay + " per action") +
   field("Full charge", (LIFE.lifeMax / LIFE.decay) + " actions"));

var sh = "", st;
for (i = 0; i < LIFE.slots.length; i++) {
   st = LIFE.slots[i].state;
   sh += field(LIFE.slots[i].name,
      st === "empty" ? "bare" : (st === "installed" ? "seated" : "running"));
}
setPanel("o2-slotsp", sh);

/* "3 of 10" read as a fraction of something the player
  thought he had ten of. The count is the count; the rack
      size is its own line. */
    setPanel("o2-rack",
       '<div class="navname">' + LIFE.canisters + '</div>' +
       '<div class="navsub">canisters in the rack</div>' +
       field("Rack holds", LIFE.capacity) +
       field("Per install", "1 canister") +
       field("Full bank", LIFE.slots.length + " canisters") +
       '<div class="navnote">A canister leaves the rack the moment an ' +
       'install is committed. Stations sell them; the Recyclers can ' +
       'make one from salvage.</div>');

    var hand = assignedFilterHand();
    setPanel("o2-crew",
       (hand
         ? '<div class="navname">' + hand.name + '</div>' +
           '<div class="navsub">' + hand.role + ' - filter job</div>' +
           field("Skill", hand.skill) +
           field("Acts at", AIR_STAGES[hand.jobAt].word + " air") +
           field("Activity", hand.activity) +
           field("Seating", crewCost(2) + " actions per slot") +
           '<div class="navnote">He holds the filter job and works the ' +
           'bank unasked - but not until the air is already ' +
           AIR_STAGES[hand.jobAt].word + ', by which time the crew have ' +
           'been labouring for a while. He is slowed by the same bad ' +
           'air he is there to fix.</div>'
         : '<span class="dim">Nobody holds the filter job. The ' +
           'commander seats every canister personally.</span>'));

    setPanel("o2-status",
       field("Intake", "Open") +
       field("Manifold", run ? "Circulating" : "Static") +
       field("Scrubber", run ? "Running" : "Idle") +
       field("Seated", (slotsIn("installed") + slotsIn("active")) +
           " of " + LIFE.slots.length));

    setPanel("o2-burst",
       '<div class="navnote" style="border:none;padding-top:0;margin-top:0;">' +
       'Starting the bank costs one ordinary action and hands ten back: ' +
       'every job already running jumps forward by ten actions. The ' +
       'counter does not move and nothing wears. It is the only thing ' +
       'aboard that gives time instead of taking it.</div>');

    paintO2Band(run);
}

/* the chamber: specks of dirt, or the clean streaks of moving air */
/* THE INDICATOR ABOVE THE SLOTS.
  One bar, full and green while the bank runs, then draining and
  shifting green -> yellow -> orange -> red in four steps of five
  actions once there is nothing left to filter with. The grime in
  the chamber thickens with every step, so the state is readable
  even out of the corner of an eye. */
function paintAir(run, word, tone) {
  var air = $("o2-air"), i, el, n;
  if (!air) { return; }
  var st = airStage(), pct = airPercent();

    clear(air);
    air.className = "o2-part o2-air" + (st === 4 ? " o2-air-clean" : "");

    air.appendChild(make("div", "o2-airlab", "CABIN AIR"));

    el = make("div", "o2-airword", word);
    el.style.color = tone;
    air.appendChild(el);

    air.appendChild(make("div", "o2-airsub", run
       ? (STATE.filterLife + " filtered")
       : (STATE.airHold + " of " + AIR.holdMax + " left")));

    air.appendChild(make("div", "o2-airtrack"));
    el = make("div", "o2-airfill");
    el.style.width   = Math.round(544 * (pct / 100)) + "px";
    el.style.background = tone;
    air.appendChild(el);

    /* four step marks, so the drop can be seen coming */
    for (i = 1; i < 4; i++) {
       el = make("div", "o2-airnotch");
       el.style.left = Math.round(544 * (i / 4)) + 8 + "px";
       air.appendChild(el);
    }

    if (run) {
       for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
          el = make("div", "o2-streak");
          el.style.left = (60 + i * 130) + "px";
          el.style.top = "52px";
          air.appendChild(el);
       }
    } else {
       n = (4 - st) * 4;       /* the worse it gets, the dirtier it looks */
       for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          el = make("div", "o2-dust");
          el.style.left = (14 + i * 33) + "px";
          el.style.top = (48 + (i % 3) * 5) + "px";
          air.appendChild(el);
       }
    }
}

/* the three install buttons, rebuilt whenever anything changes */
function paintO2Buttons() {
   var i, wrap, sl, lab, live;
    for (i = 0; i < LIFE.slots.length; i++) {

    wrap = $("o2-btnwrap" + i);
      if (!wrap) { continue; }
      clear(wrap);
      PROGRESS_UI["o2s" + i] = null; /* drop the detached ref first */

        sl = LIFE.slots[i];
        live = false;
        if (findOngoing("o2s" + i))        { lab = "Install Canister"; }
        else if (sl.state === "active") { lab = bankRunning() ? "Running" : "No power"; }
        else if (sl.state === "installed") { lab = "Seated"; }
        else if (LIFE.canisters <= 0)      { lab = "No canisters"; }
        else { lab = "Install Canister"; live = true; }

        wrap.appendChild(buildProgressButton("o2s" + i, lab, installFn(i), live));
    }
}

function paintO2Band(run) {
  var band = $("o2-actions");
  if (!band) { return; }
  clear(band);
  PROGRESS_UI["o2-run"] = null;

    var ready = bankReady() && !run && statValue("energy").value > 0;
    band.appendChild(make("div", "actionbar",
      run
         ? '<span class="dim">The bank is running. ' + STATE.filterLife +
           ' actions of clean air left.</span>'
         : (statValue("energy").value <= 0
             ? '<span class="dim">No power. Recharge energy to run the filter bank.</span>'
             : (ready
                ? "All three slots are seated. Starting the bank costs one " +
                  "action and advances every running job by ten."
                : '<span class="dim">Seat a canister in all three slots ' +
                  'before the bank can be started.</span>'))));

    var row = make("div", "actionrow");
    row.appendChild(actionCell(buildProgressButton(
      "o2-run", run ? "Filters running" : "Turn on Filter",
      turnOnFilter, ready)));
    band.appendChild(row);
    band.appendChild(make("div", "clear"));
}

/* ================================================================
  SECTION I-4c : THE MESS HALL
  Same frame as the Engine Room and the O2 Filter Room: a fixed
  stage centre-top, reading columns either side, paired panels
  beneath it, one full-width band of commitments at the bottom.
  There is only one moving part to watch - the rack - but it is
  watched by five different clocks at once: the cook filling it
  and four crew members quietly emptying it, all on their own
  schedule. Nothing else in the game has that yet.
  ================================================================ */
function buildMessScreen(host, t) {
   var scr = make("div", "task-screen");

    scr.appendChild(make("div", "task-head",
       '<div class="task-kind">ROOM</div>' +
       '<div class="task-title">Mess Hall</div>' +
       '<div class="task-sub">Hunger does not knock - it is on a ' +
       'clock, same as everything else aboard.</div>'));

    var wrap = make("div", "navwrap");
    var main = make("div", "navmain");

    var cl = make("div", "navcell navcell-l");
    cl.appendChild(navPanel("Rack",            "mess-rack-p", ""));
    cl.appendChild(navPanel("Hunger Cycle",    "mess-cycle", ""));
    cl.appendChild(navPanel("Starvation",      "mess-starve", "np-last"));
    main.appendChild(cl);

    var cc = make("div", "navcell navcell-c");
    var mid = make("div", "navcenter");
    mid.appendChild(buildMessMachine());

    var under = make("div", "navrow");
    under.appendChild(navPanel("Cooking",     "mess-cook-p", "np-half"));
    under.appendChild(navPanel("Crew Appetite", "mess-appetite", "np-half-last"));
    mid.appendChild(under);

    cc.appendChild(mid);
    main.appendChild(cc);

    var cr = make("div", "navcell navcell-r");
    cr.appendChild(navPanel("Galley Crew", "mess-crew", "np-last"));
    main.appendChild(cr);

    wrap.appendChild(main);

    var r3 = make("div", "navrow");
    r3.appendChild(navPanel("Mess Actions", "mess-actions", "np-full"));
    wrap.appendChild(r3);

    scr.appendChild(wrap);
    host.appendChild(scr);

    paintMess();
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
  THE COUNTER
  Positioned divs again, same discipline as the reactor and the
  filter bank: everything decorative carries .mess-part and
  pointer-events:none, the rack gauge and the four hunger clocks
  are rebuilt live by paintMess and carry their own ids instead. */
function mspart(cls, x, y, w, h, html) {
   var el = make("div", "mess-part " + cls, html);
   el.style.left = x + "px";
   el.style.top = y + "px";
   if (w) { el.style.width = w + "px"; }
   if (h) { el.style.height = h + "px"; }
   return el;
}

function buildMessMachine() {
   var m = make("div", null);
   m.id = "messmach";
   m.style.width = STAGE.mess.w + "px";
   m.style.height = STAGE.mess.h + "px";

    var k, el;

    /* --- the serving counter, top to bottom of the stage ----- */
    m.appendChild(mspart("mess-counter", 20, 14, 560, 40, ""));
    m.appendChild(mspart("mess-mini", 26, 19, 70, 10, "GALLEY"));

    /* --- the rack gauge - the one thing that actually moves --- */
    m.appendChild(mspart("mess-rackbox", 20, 70, 560, 90, ""));
    m.appendChild(mspart("mess-mini", 28, 76, 110, 10, "RATION RACK"));
    el = mspart("mess-track", 40, 110, 520, 22, "");
    m.appendChild(el);
    el = mspart("mess-fill", 40, 110, 0, 22, "");
    el.id = "mess-bar";
    m.appendChild(el);
    el = mspart("mess-readout", 40, 136, 520, 16, "");
    el.id = "mess-readout";
    m.appendChild(el);

    /* --- four plates, one per crew member, each its own clock -- */
    m.appendChild(mspart("mess-mini", 28, 182, 140, 10, "WHO EATS NEXT"));
    for (k = 0; k < CREW.length; k++) {
       el = mspart("mess-plate", 20 + k * 141, 200, 130, 70, "");
       m.appendChild(el);
       el = mspart("mess-plate-name", 26 + k * 141, 206, 118, 14, "");
       el.id = "mess-pname" + k;
       m.appendChild(el);
       el = mspart("mess-track", 26 + k * 141, 228, 118, 12, "");
       m.appendChild(el);
       el = mspart("mess-fill mess-fill-small", 26 + k * 141, 228, 0, 12, "");
       el.id = "mess-ptick" + k;
       m.appendChild(el);
       el = mspart("mess-plate-sub", 26 + k * 141, 246, 118, 14, "");
       el.id = "mess-psub" + k;
       m.appendChild(el);
    }

    return m;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
  PAINTING
  Everything visible is derived from MESS.rack/capacity and each
  crew member's own hungerTick. Nothing is stored twice.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function paintMess() {
   if (!$("mess-actions")) { return; }

    var pct = Math.round((MESS.rack / MESS.capacity) * 100);
    var tone = (pct >= 60) ? "#7f9161" : (pct >= 25 ? "#c08a3e" : "#b05a42");
    var cook = assignedCook(), i, c, tp;

    if ($("mess-bar")) {
       $("mess-bar").style.width = Math.round(520 * (pct / 100)) + "px";
       $("mess-bar").style.background = tone;
    }
    if ($("mess-readout")) {
       $("mess-readout").innerHTML = MESS.rack + " of " + MESS.capacity +
            " rations on the rack";
    }

    for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) {
       c = CREW[i];
       tp = Math.round(((c.hungerTick || 0) / MESS_EVERY) * 100);
       if ($("mess-pname" + i)) { $("mess-pname" + i).innerHTML = c.name; }
       if ($("mess-ptick" + i)) {
          $("mess-ptick" + i).style.width = Math.round(118 * (tp / 100)) + "px";
          $("mess-ptick" + i).style.background =
             (c.hunger >= 70) ? "#b05a42" : "#7f9161";
       }
       if ($("mess-psub" + i)) {
          $("mess-psub" + i).innerHTML = (MESS_EVERY - (c.hungerTick || 0)) +
               " actions to next meal";
       }
    }

    setPanel("mess-rack-p",
       '<div class="navname" style="color:' + tone + ';">' + MESS.rack +
       ' <span class="navsub">of ' + MESS.capacity + '</span></div>' +
       '<div class="navsub">rations on hand</div>' +
       barLine(pct, tone) +
       field("Capacity", MESS.capacity + " rations, hard ceiling"));

    setPanel("mess-cycle",
       field("Every crew member", MESS_EVERY + " of their own actions") +
       field("On a successful meal", "hunger falls by 40") +
       field("On an empty rack", "hunger rises by 15 instead"));

    setPanel("mess-starve",
       field("Risk begins at", MESS_STARVE + "% hunger") +
       field("Cost", "1 health every " + MESS_STARVE_EVERY + " actions") +
       '<div class="navnote">Slow on purpose - the same law bad air ' +
       'already follows. Nobody starves on the spot.</div>');

    setPanel("mess-cook-p",
       MESS.rack >= MESS.capacity
          ? '<span class="dim">Rack is full. Nothing to cook for.</span>'
          : field("Cost now", Math.ceil((MESS.capacity - MESS.rack) /
                 (cook ? cook.jobAt : 1)) + " actions") +
            field("Rate", (cook ? cook.jobAt : 1) + " ration(s) per action") +
            field("Restores", "rack to full"));

    setPanel("mess-appetite",
       field("Hungry now", (function () {
          var n = 0, j;
          for (j = 0; j < CREW.length; j++) { if (CREW[j].hunger > 70) { n++; } }
          return n + " of " + CREW.length;
       }())) +
       field("Average hunger", (function () {
          var s = 0, j;
          for (j = 0; j < CREW.length; j++) { s += CREW[j].hunger; }
          return Math.round(s / CREW.length) + "%";
       }())));

    setPanel("mess-crew",
       (cook
         ? '<div class="navname">' + cook.name + '</div>' +
           '<div class="navsub">' + cook.role + ' - kitchen job</div>' +
           field("Skill", cook.skill) +
           field("Acts at", jobThreshold(cook)) +
           field("Activity", cook.activity) +
           '<div class="navnote">She holds the kitchen job and will ' +
           'start cooking unasked once the rack falls to half - ' +
           'training her raises how fast the rack refills.</div>'
         : '<span class="dim">Nobody holds the kitchen job. The ' +
           'commander cooks personally, or nobody does.</span>'));

    paintMessBand(cook);
}

function paintMessBand(cook) {
   var band = $("mess-actions");
   if (!band) { return; }
   clear(band);
   PROGRESS_UI["cook"] = null;

    var full = MESS.rack >= MESS.capacity;
    band.appendChild(make("div", "actionbar",
      findOngoing("project-food")
         ? '<span class="dim">Hydroponics has reserved space for produce processing.</span>'
         : full
         ? '<span class="dim">The rack is full. Cooking is refused ' +
           'until something is eaten.</span>'
         : "Cooking fills the rack over time at the acting cook's " +
           "rate, and a hungry crew member may still empty a ration " +
           "out from under it while it runs."));

    var row = make("div", "actionrow");
    if (findOngoing("cook")) {
       row.appendChild(actionCell(buildProgressButton(
         "cook", "Cook in progress", startCookSelf, false)));
    } else {
       row.appendChild(actionCell(buildProgressButton(
         "cook", "Cook a Batch", startCookSelf, !full && !findOngoing("project-food"))));
    }
    band.appendChild(row);
    band.appendChild(make("div", "clear"));
}

/* a plain proportion bar for a reading panel */
function barLine(pct, tone) {
   var w = pct;
   if (w < 0) { w = 0; }
   if (w > 100) { w = 100; }
   return '<div class="navbar"><div class="navbar-in" style="width:' + w +
        '%;background:' + tone + ';"></div></div>';
}
/* ================================================================
  SECTION I-5 : CREW QUARTERS
  The order sheet. Looking at a crew member is free, writing an
  order down is free, changing your mind is free. Nothing is
  spent until the whole sheet is handed out at the bottom of the
  screen - one mark, one feed line, one payment.
  ================================================================ */
function buildCrewScreen(host, t) {
   var scr = make("div", "task-screen");

 scr.appendChild(make("div", "task-head",
    '<div class="task-kind">ROOM</div>' +
    '<div class="task-title">Crew Quarters</div>' +
    '<div class="task-sub">Shared bunks, lockers, and the only ' +
    'place aboard where orders are written down.</div>'));

 var wrap = make("div", "navwrap");
 var main = make("div", "navmain");

 var cl = make("div", "navcell navcell-l");
 cl.appendChild(navPanel("Crew", "cq-roster", "np-last"));
 main.appendChild(cl);

 var cc = make("div", "navcell navcell-c");
 var mid = make("div", "navcenter");
 mid.appendChild(buildHallway());

 var trow = make("div", "navrow");
 trow.appendChild(navPanel("The Figure", "cq-talk", "np-full"));
 mid.appendChild(trow);

 var under = make("div", "navrow");
 under.appendChild(navPanel("Condition", "cq-cond", "np-half"));
 under.appendChild(navPanel("Standing", "cq-stand", "np-half-last"));
 mid.appendChild(under);

 cc.appendChild(mid);
 main.appendChild(cc);

 var cr = make("div", "navcell navcell-r");
 cr.appendChild(navPanel("Orders", "cq-orders", ""));
 cr.appendChild(navPanel("Order Sheet", "cq-sheet", "np-last"));
 main.appendChild(cr);

 wrap.appendChild(main);

 var r3 = make("div", "navrow");
 r3.appendChild(navPanel("Assignments", "cq-band", "np-full"));
 wrap.appendChild(r3);
    scr.appendChild(wrap);
    host.appendChild(scr);

    paintCrewScreen();
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
  THE HALLWAY
  Lockers down both walls, a door at the far end, a light strip
  overhead. All scenery, all .cq-part, no clicks.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function buildHallway() {
   var m = make("div", null);
   m.id = "hallway";
   m.style.width = STAGE.crew.w + "px";
   m.style.height = STAGE.crew.h + "px";

    var k, x, el;

    m.appendChild(cpart("cq-wall", 0, 0, 560, 230, ""));
    m.appendChild(cpart("cq-floor", 0, 230, 560, 70, ""));
    for (k = 0; k < 4; k++) {    /* floorboards, widening */
       m.appendChild(cpart("cq-board", 0, 236 + k * (8 + k * 4), 560, 1, ""));
    }
    m.appendChild(cpart("cq-skirt", 0, 226, 560, 4, ""));

    /* ceiling light */
    m.appendChild(cpart("cq-light", 236, 0, 88, 9, ""));
    m.appendChild(cpart("cq-glow", 216, 9, 128, 4, ""));

    /* the door at the far end */
    m.appendChild(cpart("cq-door", 236, 64, 88, 162, ""));
    m.appendChild(cpart("cq-dpane", 248, 78, 64, 52, ""));
    m.appendChild(cpart("cq-dhand", 306, 150, 8, 14, ""));
    m.appendChild(cpart("cq-mini", 236, 52, 88, 10, "DECK A"));

    /* two banks of lockers */
    for (k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
       x = (k < 4) ? (16 + k * 40) : (384 + (k - 4) * 40);
       m.appendChild(cpart("cq-lock", x, 70, 38, 156, ""));
       m.appendChild(cpart("cq-lvent", x + 8, 80, 22, 2, ""));
       m.appendChild(cpart("cq-lvent", x + 8, 85, 22, 2, ""));
       m.appendChild(cpart("cq-lvent", x + 8, 90, 22, 2, ""));
       m.appendChild(cpart("cq-lhand", x + 28, 140, 4, 16, ""));
       m.appendChild(cpart("cq-lnum", x + 6, 208, 26, 10,
                    "0" + (k + 1)));
    }

    /* the figure stands here */
    m.appendChild(cpart("cq-shadow", 248, 222, 64, 10, ""));
    /* ONE LAYER FOR THE WHOLE SCENE. The figure is no longer
      alone in a 72x84 box - a cot, a bench or a crate stands
    beside it, so the layer is the full stage and everything
    in it is placed in hallway coordinates. Scenery, so it
    takes no clicks. */
  el = make("div", "cq-scene");
  el.id = "crew-scene";
  m.appendChild(el);

  return m;
}
function cpart(cls, x, y, w, h, html) {
  var el = make("div", "cq-part " + cls, html);
  el.style.left = x + "px";
  el.style.top = y + "px";
  if (w) { el.style.width = w + "px"; }
  if (h) { el.style.height = h + "px"; }
  return el;
}
