         "..kkkk.......","kkk..........","k.k..........","kk...........",

        "kkk.........." ],
  wrench:[ "..kk...kk..","..kkk.kkk..","...kkkkk...","....kkk....",
        "....mkm....","....mkm....","....mkm....","....mkm....",
        "....mkm....","...kkkkk..." ],
  mop : [ ".....k.....",".....k.....",".....k.....",".....k.....",
        ".....k.....",".....k.....","...kkkkk...","..kmmmmmk..",
        "..kmmmmmk..","...kkkkk..." ],
  chart: [ "kkkkkkkkk","kwwwwwwwk","kwkwwwwwk","kwwkwwwwk","kwwwkwwwk",
        "kwwwwkwwk","kwwwwwwwk","kkkkkkkkk" ],
  tank : [ "...kk...","...kk...","..kkkk..",".kmmmmk.","kmmmmmmk",
        "kmmmmmmk","kmmmmmmk","kmmmmmmk","kmmmmmmk",".kkkkkk." ],
  crate: [ "kkkkkkkkkk","kcccccccck","kcckkkkcck","kcccccccck",
        "kcckkkkcck","kcccccccck","kkkkkkkkkk" ]
};
var JOB_TOOL = { maintenance:"wrench", cleaner:"mop",
         navigation:"chart", filters:"tank" };

/* HATS. Worn over the head, drawn after the figure, "j" taking
  the job's own colour. A hat reads across the room faster than
  a tunic does - at 4px the yellow helmet and the white cap are
  telling you the trade before you have focused on the figure.
  The slate used for life support is deliberately muted: the
  palette has no true blue in it and is not getting one. */
var HATS = {
   helmet : [ "...kkkkkkkk...", "..kjjjjjjjjk..", ".kjjjjjjjjjjk.",
          ".kjjjjjjjjjjk.", "kkkkkkkkkkkkkk" ],
   cap : [ "...kkkkkkkk...", "..kjjjjjjjjk..", ".kjjjjyjjjjjk.",
          ".kkkkkkkkkkkk.", "..kkkkkkkkkk.." ],
   bandana: [ "...kkkkkkkk...", "..kjjjjjjjjk..", ".kjjjjjjjjjjk.",
          ".kkjjjjjjjjkk.", "..k.kk..kk.k.." ]
};
var JOB_HAT = { maintenance:["helmet", "#e0b53a"], /* hard hat */
           navigation :["cap", "#faf7f2"], /* peaked cap */
           cleaner :["bandana","#7f9161"], /* kerchief */
           filters :["helmet", "#6e8491"] }; /* slate helm */
var FLOORY = 230; /* the deck line inside the hallway */

/* ONE BODY, FOUR HEADS.
  A style is a sparse set of row overrides on SPRITE - only the
  rows that differ are stored, so a new haircut is four short
  strings and not a second sprite to keep in step with the
  first. Chibi has no neck: the jaw at row 14 sits straight on
  the collar at row 15. */
var HAIR_STYLES = {
   cowlick : {},                     /* the base head */
   crop : { 0:SP_BLANK, 1:SP_BLANK, 2:SP_BLANK, 3:SP_BLANK },
   bun : { 0:SP_BLANK,
             1:".......kkk........",
             2:"......khHk........",
             3:"......khhk........" },
   long : { 0:SP_BLANK, 1:SP_BLANK, 2:SP_BLANK, 3:SP_BLANK,
             14:"..khksssssssskhk..",
             15:"..khkcccccccckhk..",
             16:".khcccccccccccchk.",
             17:".khsccccyyccccshk." },
   /* no hair at all - the dome is skin and only the outline
     stays. Kept for hires as much as for the crew aboard. */
   bald : { 0:SP_BLANK, 1:SP_BLANK, 2:SP_BLANK, 3:SP_BLANK,
             5:"..kkssssssssssskk.", 6:".kssssssssssssssk.",
             7:".kssssssssssssssk.", 8:".kssssssssssssssk.",
             9:".kssssssssssssssk.", 10:".ksssseesseessssk.",
            11:".ksssseesseessssk.", 12:".kssssssssssssssk.",
            13:"..kssssssssssssk.." },
   /* a little left, round the sides */
   thin : { 0:SP_BLANK, 1:SP_BLANK, 2:SP_BLANK, 3:SP_BLANK,
             5:"..kkssssssssssskk.", 6:".kssssssssssssssk.",
             7:".khsssssssssssshk." }
};

/* Row 9 rebuilt with a taller eye and a lash tick at each outer
  corner. SPLICED into whatever row 9 the style left behind -
  write it as a fixed string and a bald head grows hair again. */
function femaleRow(r9) {
   return r9.substring(0, 5) + "eeesseee" + r9.substring(13);
}
var PX = 4;

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
  THE SCENE
  What is standing around the figure says what the sheet is
  about to do to them. Priority is what matters most: a body in
  the medical bay first, then schooling, then a change of trade,
  then nobody wanting them at all.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function crewScene(c) {
   var o = STATE.pendingOrders[c.id] || {};
   var sc = { pose:"stand", props:[] };
   var jid, tool;

  if (o.doc || atDoc(c)) {           /* on the cot */
     sc.pose = "lie";
     sc.props[sc.props.length] = ["bed", 226, onDeck(PROPS.bed)];
     sc.props[sc.props.length] = ["cross", 252, 138];
    sc.lieOn = onDeck(PROPS.bed) - LIE.length * PX + 12;
    return sc;
  }
  if (o.learnOn || o.learnSt) {          /* at the bench */
      sc.props[sc.props.length] = ["desk", 120, onDeck(PROPS.desk)];
      return sc;
  }
  /* THE TRADE THEY WILL BE DOING - staged if the sheet changes
     it, otherwise the one they already hold. A working hand
     should look like one; only the crate marks it as NEW. */
  jid = (o.job !== undefined) ? o.job : (c.job || "");
  if (jid) {
      tool = JOB_TOOL[jid];
      if (o.job !== undefined && o.job !== (c.job || "")) {
         sc.props[sc.props.length] = ["crate", 170, onDeck(PROPS.crate)];
      }
      if (tool) {
         sc.props[sc.props.length] =
            [tool, 312, FLOORY - 14 - PROPS[tool].length * PX];
      }
      return sc;
  }
  if (!c.job) {                    /* nobody wants him */
      sc.pose = "sit";
      sc.props[sc.props.length] = ["zzz", 300, 118];
      return sc;
  }
  return sc;
}
function onDeck(rows) { return FLOORY - rows.length * PX; }

/* redrawn only when it would look different - this layer is
  several hundred divs and paintCrewScreen runs every action */
var FIGURE_SIG = "";

function paintSprite(c) {
  var host = $("crew-scene"), i, sc, look, sig;
  if (!host) { return; }
  if (!c) { clear(host); FIGURE_SIG = ""; return; }

  sc = crewScene(c);
  look = spriteLook(c);
  sig = c.id + "|" + sc.pose + "|" + look.cloth + "|" +
        (look.hat || "-") + "|" + c.hairStyle;
  for (i = 0; i < sc.props.length; i++) { sig += "|" + sc.props[i][0]; }
  if (sig === FIGURE_SIG) { return; }
  FIGURE_SIG = sig;

  clear(host);
  for (i = 0; i < sc.props.length; i++) {
     drawPix(host, PROPS[sc.props[i][0]], sc.props[i][1],
           sc.props[i][2], c, look);
    }
    if (sc.pose === "lie") {
       drawPix(host, LIE, 230, sc.lieOn, c, look);
    } else if (sc.pose === "sit") {
       drawPix(host, SIT, 244, onDeck(SIT), c, look); /* eyes shut */
    } else {
       drawPix(host, figureRows(c, !!look.hatKind), 244,
             onDeck(SPRITE), c, look);
       if (look.hatKind) {     /* the hat goes on last, over the hair */
          drawPix(host, HATS[look.hatKind], 252,
                onDeck(SPRITE) + 12, c, look);
       }
    }
}

/* The standing figure: haircut, then the hat, then the face.
  NOTHING POKES OUT OF A HELMET - rows 0 to 3 are the cowlick
  and the bun, and a hat blanks them outright. */
function figureRows(c, hatted) {
   var st = HAIR_STYLES[c.hairStyle || "cowlick"] || {}, out = [], r;
   for (r = 0; r < SPRITE.length; r++) {
      out[r] = (st[r] !== undefined) ? st[r] : SPRITE[r];
   }
   if (hatted) {
      for (r = 0; r < 4; r++) { out[r] = SP_BLANK; }
   }
   if (c.sex === "f") { out[9] = femaleRow(out[9]); }
   return out;
}

/* one grid of pixels, placed in hallway coordinates */
function drawPix(host, rows, ox, oy, c, look) {
   var r, q, ch, el, col;
   for (r = 0; r < rows.length; r++) {
      for (q = 0; q < rows[r].length; q++) {
         ch = rows[r].charAt(q);
         if (ch === ".") { continue; }
         col = (ch === "h") ? (c.hair || "#5e3622")
            : (ch === "H") ? (c.hair2 || "#804e2e")
            : (ch === "s") ? (c.skin || "#f7e4c0")
            : (ch === "e") ? "#3a1c2e"
            : (ch === "k") ? "#1a1614"
            : (ch === "b") ? "#1a1614"
            : (ch === "w") ? "#faf7f2"
            : (ch === "r") ? "#b05a42"
            : (ch === "g") ? "#bfcdba"
            : (ch === "m") ? "#cbb89c"
            : (ch === "j") ? (look.hat || "#cbb89c")
            : (ch === "y") ? (look.btn || "#e2b63c")
            : (ch === "c") ? look.cloth
            : (ch === "d") ? look.dark
            : "#5c5145";
            el = make("div", "cq-px");
            el.style.left   = (ox + q * PX) + "px";
            el.style.top    = (oy + r * PX) + "px";
            el.style.width    = PX + "px";
            el.style.height = PX + "px";
            el.style.background = col;
            host.appendChild(el);
        }
    }
}

/* what the figure is wearing: the STAGED job, not the saved one,
  so the player sees the change before paying for it */
function spriteLook(c) {
   var o = STATE.pendingOrders[c.id];
   if ((o && o.doc) || atDoc(c)) {
      /* patient gown - even the buckle goes quiet */
      return { cloth:"#e8e2d6", dark:"#cbb89c", btn:"#cbb89c" };
   }
   var jid = (o && o.job !== undefined) ? o.job : (c.job || "");
   var j = findById(JOBS, jid), hat = JOB_HAT[jid];
   j = j ? j : JOBS[0];
   return { cloth:j.cloth, dark:j.dark,
          hatKind:(hat ? hat[0] : null),
          hat: (hat ? hat[1] : null) };
}

/* ---------------- selection is free ------------------------- */
function selectCrew(id) {
   STATE.crewSel = id;
   paintCrewScreen();            /* no action, no mark, no tick */
}
function selCrew() {
   var c = findById(CREW, STATE.crewSel);
   return c ? c : (CREW.length ? CREW[0] : null);
}

/* ---------------- staging ----------------------------------- */
function stageJob(id, jobId) {
   var c = findById(CREW, id);
   if (!c ||
 ordersRunning() || crewBusy(c)) { return; }
   var o = STATE.pendingOrders[id] || {};
   if ((c.job || "") === jobId) { delete o.job; } /* no change, no charge */
   else { o.job = jobId; }
   keepOrder(id, o);
   paintCrewScreen();
}
function toggleOrder(id, oid) {
   /* the UI does not wire this row without a dock, but the rule
      belongs with the data, not with the button */
   if (oid === "learnSt" && !STATE.docked) { return; }
   var person = findById(CREW, id);
   if (oid === "rest" && person && person.fatigue < 25 && person.morale >= 70 &&
       !(STATE.pendingOrders[id] && STATE.pendingOrders[id].rest)) { return; }
  if (ordersRunning())                { return; }
  if (crewBusy(findById(CREW, id)))           { return; }
  var o = STATE.pendingOrders[id] || {};
  if (o[oid]) { delete o[oid]; } else { o[oid] = true; }
  keepOrder(id, o);
  paintCrewScreen();
}
function keepOrder(id, o) {
   var k, any = false;
   for (k in o) { if (o.hasOwnProperty(k)) { any = true; } }
   if (any) { STATE.pendingOrders[id] = o; }
   else { delete STATE.pendingOrders[id]; }
}
/* What a single line on the sheet costs. It is never a flat
  number: handing someone the life support job is not the same
  size of decision as handing them a mop, and teaching them
  either one costs what that knowledge is worth. */
/* THE PRICE OF ONE ORDER, FOR ONE JOB.
  Every caller must say which job it means. Twice now a caller
  has been allowed to assume, and twice it assumed the job the
  crew member is leaving instead of the one he is taking:
  Entry 048 charged a cleaner's price for an engineer's
  schooling, and then the per-person task lengths disagreed
  with the sheet total they were cut from. There is one price
  list and it answers questions - it does not guess them. */
/* The ACTIONS an order costs are the crew's time. The SHIPLETS
  are what it costs the ship - and only schooling costs those:
  somebody has to be paid to teach. Aboard is cheap and slow, a
  station has instructors and charges for them. Charged once,
  when the sheet is handed over, never while it is being
  written. */
function orderFeeFor(jid, oid) {
   var j = findById(JOBS, jid);
   if (oid === "learnOn") { return j && j.feeOn ? j.feeOn : 0; }
   if (oid === "learnSt") { return j && j.feeSt ? j.feeSt : 0; }
   return 0;
}
function orderFee(c, oid) {
   var o = STATE.pendingOrders[c.id];
   var jid = (o && o.job !== undefined) ? o.job : (c.job || "");
   return orderFeeFor(jid, oid);
}
function crewFeeOf(c) {
   var o = STATE.pendingOrders[c.id], i, n = 0;
   if (!o) { return 0; }
   for (i = 0; i < ORDERS.length; i++) {
      if (o[ORDERS[i].id]) { n += orderFee(c, ORDERS[i].id); }
   }
   return n;
}
function ordersFee() {
   var id, c, n = 0;
    for (id in STATE.pendingOrders) {
       if (!STATE.pendingOrders.hasOwnProperty(id)) { continue; }
       c = findById(CREW, id);
       if (c) { n += crewFeeOf(c); }
    }
    return n;
}

function orderCostFor(jid, oid) {
  var j = findById(JOBS, jid);
  if (oid === "doc") { return 1; }
  if (oid === "fire") { return 5; }
  if (oid === "learnOn") { return j && j.learnOn ? j.learnOn : 1; }
  if (oid === "learnSt") { return j && j.learnSt ? j.learnSt : 2; }
  return 1;
}

/* what the pad shows: priced against the job STAGED on the sheet
  above it, falling back to the one they already hold */
function orderCost(c, oid) {
   var o = STATE.pendingOrders[c.id];
   var jid = (o && o.job !== undefined) ? o.job : (c.job || "");
   return orderCostFor(jid, oid);
}

function jobCost(jid) {
  var j = findById(JOBS, jid);
  return j ? j.cost : 1;
}
function crewCostOf(c) {
  var o = STATE.pendingOrders[c.id], i, n = 0;
  if (!o) { return 0; }
  if (o.job !== undefined) { n += jobCost(o.job); }
  for (i = 0; i < ORDERS.length; i++) {
     if (o[ORDERS[i].id]) { n += orderCost(c, ORDERS[i].id); }
  }
  return n;
}
function ordersCost() {
  var id, c, n = 0;
  for (id in STATE.pendingOrders) {
     if (!STATE.pendingOrders.hasOwnProperty(id)) { continue; }
     c = findById(CREW, id);
     if (c) { n += crewCostOf(c); }
  }
  return n;
}
function orderedCount() {
  var id, n = 0;
  for (id in STATE.pendingOrders) {
     if (STATE.pendingOrders.hasOwnProperty(id)) { n++; }
  }
    return n;
}

/* ---------------- the batch --------------------------------- */
function ordersAvailable() {
   var id, c;
   for (id in STATE.pendingOrders) {
      if (STATE.pendingOrders.hasOwnProperty(id)) {
         c = findById(CREW, id); if (c && crewBusy(c)) { return false; }
      }
   }
   return true;
}
function commitOrders(e) {
   var n = ordersCost(), id;
   if (n <= 0 || ordersRunning() || !ordersAvailable()) { return; }

    /* the schooling is paid for here or the sheet does not go out
       at all - a half-paid order would teach half a lesson */
    var fee = ordersFee();
    if (fee > STATE.shiplets) {
        logLine("Refused - the sheet needs " + fee + " sh in fees and " +
              "the purse holds " + STATE.shiplets + ".");
        return;
    }

    var sheet = STATE.pendingOrders;
    STATE.pendingOrders = {};        /* the sheet is handed over */
    STATE.shiplets -= fee;           /* reserve fees before this action can trigger payday */

    /* ONE CLICK IS ONE ACTION. Handing the sheet over is a single
      act and costs a single action, exactly like locking a
      course or starting a scan. The price of the orders is not
      charged here in a lump - it is the WORK, and the crew
      spend it carrying the orders out while the ship goes on
      around them. Charging it all at once made one click move
      every other countdown aboard by four or five steps, which
      is not an action economy, it is a teleport. */
    for (id in sheet) { if (sheet.hasOwnProperty(id)) { CREW_CLAIMS[id] = true; } }
    try { fireAction(e, "Crew assignments issued"); }
    finally { for (id in sheet) { if (sheet.hasOwnProperty(id)) { delete CREW_CLAIMS[id]; } } }
    if (STATE.gameOver) { return; }

    /* queued AFTER that action, or the sheet would eat its own
       first step - the same trap as the engineer's */
    if (fee > 0) {
        paintResources();
        logLine("Training fees paid - " + fee + " sh. Purse " +
              STATE.shiplets + " sh.");
    }
    queueOrders(sheet, n);
    logLine("Crew assignments updated. " + n + " actions of work.");

    refreshLifeInfo();
    paintIndicators();
    paintCrewScreen();
}

/* One task per crew member, however many lines they were given.
  The sidebar grows a line for each, and the roster locks them
  out until it is finished. */
/* ONE task for the whole sheet, carrying the whole sheet, under
  the id of the button at the bottom - so that button IS the
  progress bar, exactly like every other commitment in the game.
  Until it fills, nobody takes new orders. If the player left
  somebody off the sheet, that is a decision he has made. */
function queueOrders(sheet, total) {
   var id, c, t, n;

    /* the bar at the bottom: the whole sheet, all of it */
    t = addOngoing("crew-assign", "Carrying out orders",
                total, "crewOrder", "crew");
    if (t) { t.sheet = sheet; }

    /* and one task each, sized to what THAT person was asked to
      do, so nobody is held by somebody else's workload */
    for (id in sheet) {
       if (!sheet.hasOwnProperty(id)) { continue; }
       c = findById(CREW, id);
       if (!c) { continue; }
       n = sheetCost(c, sheet[id]);
       t = addOngoing("cw-" + id, "Orders - " + c.name.split(" ")[0],
                   n, "crewJob", id);
       if (t) { t.who = id; t.orders = sheet[id]; }
       c.activity = sheet[id].doc ? "On the way to the medical bay"
                           : "Carrying out orders";
    }
    paintIndicators();
}

/* the same sum the sheet showed, read from a sheet already
  handed over */
function sheetCost(c, o) {
   var i, n = 0, jid;
   if (!o) { return 1; }
   /* the sheet has already been handed over, so STATE.pending-
      Orders is empty: the staged job must come out of the sheet
      itself or these tasks will not add up to the bar the
      player was charged for */
   jid = (o.job !== undefined) ? o.job : (c.job || "");
   if (o.job !== undefined) { n += jobCost(o.job); }
   for (i = 0; i < ORDERS.length; i++) {
       if (o[ORDERS[i].id]) { n += orderCostFor(jid, ORDERS[i].id); }
   }
   return n < 1 ? 1 : n;
}
/* what the order was actually FOR, applied when it is finished */
function applyOrderPayload(c, o) {
   if (!o) { return; }
   /* FIRST, because nothing else on the sheet means anything to
      somebody who is being put off the ship. Doing this last
      left a medical countdown running for a man who was not
      aboard. */
   if (o.fire) { fireCrew(c); return; }
   if (o.rest) {
      c.fatigue = Math.max(0, c.fatigue - 25); c.morale = Math.min(100, c.morale + 5);
      logLine(c.name + " took a restorative break.");
      simRemember("Rest", c.name + " took a restorative break.", c.id);
   }
   if (o.job !== undefined) { applyJob(c, o.job); }
   if (o.doc) {
        /* the sheet is done; the doctor is not. This is the one
           order whose consequence outlives the order itself. */
        var d = addOngoing("doc-" + c.id, "Medical - " + c.name.split(" ")[0],
                     DOC_AWAY, "crewDoc", c.id);
        if (d) { d.who = c.id; }
        c.activity = "In the medical bay";
        logLine(c.name + " went into the medical bay - about " +
              DOC_AWAY + " actions.");
    }
    if (o.learnOn) { trainCrew(c, 1, "aboard"); }
    if (o.learnSt && STATE.docked) { trainCrew(c, 2, "at the station"); }
    if (!o.doc) { c.activity = "Back on station"; }
}

/* the sheet as a whole is either out or it is not */
function ordersRunning() { return findOngoing("crew-assign"); }

/* a hand is unavailable if the running sheet has their name on
  it, or if the doc still has them */
function crewBusy(c) {
   if (!c) { return null; }
   var d = findOngoing("doc-" + c.id), social = findOngoing("project-social"), i, t;
   if (CREW_CLAIMS[c.id]) { return {left:1}; }
   if (d) { return d; }
   if (social && (social.who === c.id || social.other === c.id)) { return social; }
   d = findOngoing("cw-" + c.id);
   if (d) { return d; }
   for (i = 0; i < STATE.ongoing.length; i++) {
      t = STATE.ongoing[i]; if (t.state === "running" && t.by === c.name) { return t; }
   }
   return null;
}
function atDoc(c) {
   return c ? findOngoing("doc-" + c.id) : null;
}

/* A unique job belongs to one pair of hands. Handing it over
  takes it off whoever had it, which is the only honest way to
  do it - two engineers both "on call" would just race. */
function applyJob(c, jid) {
   var j = findById(JOBS, jid), i;
   if (j && j.unique) {
      for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) {
         if (CREW[i] !== c && CREW[i].job === jid) {
            CREW[i].job = "";
            logLine(CREW[i].name + " was relieved of the " +
                  j.label.toLowerCase() + " job.");

    }
        }
    }
    c.job = jid;
    var jobRoom = {maintenance:"engine", filters:"o2", kitchen:"mess", navigation:"bridge", cleaner:"quarters"};
    if (jobRoom[jid]) { c.room = jobRoom[jid]; }
    if (jid === "") {
       logLine(c.name + " has no standing job.");
       return;
    }
    if (!c.skill) { c.skill = "Untrained"; }
    c.jobAt = jobBase(jid);
    logLine(c.name + " now holds the " + j.label.toLowerCase() + " job.");
}
function jobBase(jid) {
   if (jid === "maintenance") { return 30; }
   if (jid === "filters") { return 1; }
   if (jid === "navigation") { return 1; }
   if (jid === "kitchen") { return 1; } /* rations per action, Untrained */
   return 0;
}
/* steps = how far this session moves them. A station has
  instructors and a simulator; the ship has a manual. */
function trainCrew(c, steps, where) {
   var j = findById(JOBS, c.job || ""), k;
   c.skill = (c.skill === "Untrained" || !c.skill) ? "Trained" : "Practised";
   if (j && j.trainStep) {
      for (k = 0; k < steps; k++) {
          c.jobAt = Math.min(j.trainCap,
                       (c.jobAt || jobBase(c.job)) + j.trainStep);
      }
      logLine(c.name + " trained " + where + " - now acts at " +
             c.jobAt + j.unit + ".");
   } else {
      logLine(c.name + " trained " + where +
             ", but holds no job to use it on.");
   }
}
/* The order the Commander calls "fire" - unemployment, not an
  airlock. He stays aboard, stops drawing a wage, stops doing
  the job, and joins the others drifting in the corridor. */
function fireCrew(c) {
   if (!c.job) {
      logLine(c.name + " holds no job to be taken off.");
      return;
   }
   layOff(c, "dismissed by the commander");
}

/* ---------------- painting ---------------------------------- */
function paintCrewScreen() {
   if (!$("cq-band")) { return; }
   var c = selCrew();

    paintRoster();
    paintSprite(c);
    paintTalk(c);
    paintCrewPanels(c);
    paintOrders(c);
    paintSheet();
    paintCrewBand();
}

function paintRoster() {
  var host = $("cq-roster"), i, c, row, o;
  if (!host) { return; }
  clear(host);

  /* Four numbers that mean four different things. Crammed onto
    one line they read as one number with decoration - the
    Commander could not tell the purse from the bill. */
  host.appendChild(make("div", "cq-pay",
     '<div class="cq-payh">PAYROLL</div>' +
     payLine("Wages owed", payrollBill() + " sh") +
     payLine("Every",         PAY.every + " actions") +
     payLine("Next pay", "in " + payrollDue()) +
     payLine("Purse",         STATE.shiplets + " sh")));
  for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) {
     c = CREW[i];
     o = STATE.pendingOrders[c.id];
     var bt = crewBusy(c);
     row = make("div", "cq-row" +
          (c.id === STATE.crewSel ? " cq-row-sel" : "") +
          (bt ? " cq-row-busy" : ""));
     row.innerHTML =
        '<span class="cq-dot" style="background:' + c.colour + ';"></span>' +
        '<span class="cq-nm">' + c.name + '</span>' +
        (bt ? '<span class="cq-flag cq-flag-busy">' + bt.left + '</span>'
           : (o ? '<span class="cq-flag">order</span>' : "")) +
        '<div class="cq-rl">' + (bt
           ? (atDoc(c) ? "In the medical bay" : "Carrying out orders")
           : (shortRole(c.role) +
              (c.job ? " - " + jobLabel(c.job) : ""))) + '</div>';
     wireSelect(row, c.id);
     host.appendChild(row);
  }
}
function payLine(k, v) {
  return '<div class="cq-payrow"><span class="cq-payk">' + k +
        '</span><span class="cq-payv">' + v +
        '</span><div class="clear"></div></div>';
}
function wireSelect(el, id) {
  on(el, "click", function (e) {
     selectCrew(id);
     if (e && e.stopPropagation) { e.stopPropagation(); }
     if (window.event) { window.event.cancelBubble = true; }
     return false;
  });
}
function jobLabel(jid) {
  var j = findById(JOBS, jid);
  return j ? j.label : "None";
}

/* TALK IS NOT AN ORDER. It is one action, spent on the spot,
  and what it buys is information: what this person actually
  needs, in their own words. Everything else on this screen is
  the commander deciding; this is the crew answering. */
function paintTalk(c) {
   var host = $("cq-talk"), row, btn;
   if (!host) { return; }
   clear(host);
   if (!c) { return; }

  row = make("div", "cq-talkrow");
  if (atDoc(c)) {
     btn = make("div", "cq-talkbtn cq-talkbtn-off",
              c.name.split(" ")[0] + " is in the medical bay");
  } else {
     btn = make("div", "cq-talkbtn",
              "Talk to " + c.name.split(" ")[0]);
     wireTalk(btn);
  }
  row.appendChild(btn);
  row.appendChild(make("div", "cq-says", c.said
     ? '"' + simEscape(c.said) + '"'
     : '<span class="dim">You have not asked them anything yet.</span>'));
  row.appendChild(make("div", "clear"));
  host.appendChild(row);
}
function wireTalk(el) {
   on(el, "click", function (e) { talkTo(e); });
}
/* FREE, and it hands out nothing but words. A button that costs
  one action and gives a small reward is a button the player
  will hammer - so this one costs nothing and rewards nothing.
  All it does is let the crew answer. */
function talkTo(e) {
   var c = selCrew();
   if (!c || atDoc(c)) { return; }
   c.said = crewNeed(c);
   logLine(c.name + ': "' + c.said + '"');
   paintCrewScreen();
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
  WHAT THEY SAY
  Ask once and you get the loudest thing. Ask again and you get
  another line about the same trouble - people repeat themselves
  differently, and a player who keeps asking should hear a
  person, not a recording. The order of the tests is the order
  of what hurts: a sick body and bad air first, then exhaustion,
  hunger, low morale and the need for training.
  Every line points at something fixable on another screen.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
var NEED_LINES = {
   ill : [
       "I am not right. I should see the doc.",
       "Been feeling rough for a while now. Do not make me say it twice.",
       "I can work. I would rather not, but I can work.",
       "Whatever I picked up, it has not let go of me yet."
     ],
     air : [
        "The air in here is filthy. Sort the filters and I will sort everything else.",
        "Every breath tastes of the last one. How long has the bank been dead?",
        "My head is splitting and it is not the work.",
        "You can smell the ship going stale. That is not supposed to happen."
     ],
     untrained : [
        "I am doing the {job} work on guesswork. Teach me properly and I will catch things sooner.",
        "Nobody ever showed me the {job} job. I copy what I saw the last one do.",
        "I will keep guessing at {job} if you like. It has held so far.",
        "Send me to learn the {job} work. I would rather know than hope."
     ],
     morale : [
        "Put me on something else. This job is wearing on me.",
        "I am not asking for much. Just something different for a while.",
        "Same station, same hours, same walls. You see the problem.",
        "I have stopped looking forward to my shifts."
     ],
     tired : [
        "I need a shift off my feet.",
        "I have been awake longer than the drive has.",
        "Give me an hour in the bunk and I will be twice the use."
     ],
     hungry : [
        "When did we last eat properly?",
        "Rations again. I am starting to dream about the mess hall.",
        "Feed the crew, commander. It is cheaper than replacing us."
     ],
     idle : [
        "Give me something to be responsible for.",
        "I will take any job going. Standing about is worse than work.",
        "You have a spare pair of hands here doing nothing."
     ],
     fine : [
        "Nothing to report. The {job} work is in hand.",
        "All quiet. I will tell you the moment it is not.",
        "Ship is behaving. Long may it last.",
        "No complaints today, and that is rare enough to mention."
     ]
};

function needKey(c) {
  if (c.health < 75)                  { return "ill"; }
  if (airStage() <= 1)                 { return "air"; }
  if (c.fatigue > 70)                 { return "tired"; }
  if (c.hunger > 70)                   { return "hungry"; }
  if (c.morale < 60)                   { return "morale"; }
  if (c.job && (c.skill === "Untrained" || !c.skill)) { return "untrained"; }
  if (!c.job)                      { return "idle"; }
    return "fine";
}

function crewNeed(c) {
  var key = needKey(c);
  var lines = NEED_LINES[key];
  var j = findById(JOBS, c.job || "");
  var text;

    /* a different line each time, in order, so asking twice is
       worth something and asking ten times is not a jackpot */
    if (c.saidKey !== key) { c.saidKey = key; c.saidN = 0; }
    else { c.saidN = (c.saidN || 0) + 1; }

    text = lines[c.saidN % lines.length];
  if (key === "fine" && c.saidN % 4 === 1 && c.hobby) { text = "When I have a quiet watch: " + c.hobby + "."; }
  if (key === "fine" && c.saidN % 4 === 3) {
    var i, m;
    for (i = STATE.sim.memories.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      m = STATE.sim.memories[i];
      if (m.who === c.id || m.other === c.id) { text = "I keep thinking about this: " + m.text; break; }
    }
  }
  while (text.indexOf("{job}") >= 0) {
       text = text.replace("{job}", j ? j.label.toLowerCase() : "ship");
    }
    return text;
}

function paintCrewPanels(c) {
  if (!c) { setPanel("cq-cond", ""); setPanel("cq-stand", ""); return; }
  setPanel("cq-cond",
     statLine("Health", c.health, false) +
     statLine("Morale", c.morale, false) +
     statLine("Fatigue", c.fatigue, true) +
     statLine("Hunger", c.hunger, true));

    var j = findById(JOBS, c.job || ""), thr = jobThreshold(c);

   setPanel("cq-stand",
      field("Role", c.role) +
      field("Job",     j ? j.label : "None") +
      field("Skill", c.skill || "Untrained") +
      field("Acts at", thr) +
      field("Pay",     wageOf(c)
                    ? wageOf(c)
 + " sh each payday"
                    : "Unpaid - holds no job") +
      field("Station", crewWhere(c)) +
      field("Doing", simActivity(c)) +
      '<div class="navnote">' + c.traits + '</div>');
}
/* A high number is not always a good number: 90 health is
  excellent and 90 hunger is a problem. good=false reads the bar
  upside down for the tone, while the bar itself still shows the
  real value. */
function statLine(k, v, bad) {
  var g = bad ? (100 - v) : v;
  var tone = (g >= 70) ? "#7f9161" : (g >= 40 ? "#c08a3e" : "#b05a42");
  return '<div class="navfield"><div class="navfield-k">' + k +
       '</div><div class="navfield-v"><span class="cq-num">' + v +
       '</span>' + barLine(v, tone) + '</div><div class="clear"></div></div>';
}
function roomName(id) {
  var r = findById(ROOMS, id);
  return r ? r.name : "-";
}

function paintOrders(c) {
  var host = $("cq-orders"), i, o, sel, op, row, jid;
  if (!host) { return; }
  clear(host);
  if (!c) { return; }

  host.appendChild(make("div", "cq-sub", c.name));

  /* While the sheet is out, the pad is shut - for everybody,
     not only for the names on it. The pad is not there to be
     argued with; it is simply closed. */
  var busy = crewBusy(c), out = ordersRunning();
  if (busy || out) {
      host.appendChild(make("div", "cq-closed",
         (atDoc(c) ? "In the medical bay."
               : (busy ? "Carrying out orders." : "Orders in hand.")) +
         "<br>" + (busy || out).left + " action" +
         ((busy || out).left === 1 ? "" : "s") + " remaining."));
      return;
  }

  o = STATE.pendingOrders[c.id] || {};
  jid = (o.job !== undefined) ? o.job : (c.job || "");

  host.appendChild(make("div", "cq-lab", "Standing job"));
  sel = make("select", "cq-sel");
  for (i = 0; i < JOBS.length; i++) {
     op = document.createElement("option");
     op.value = JOBS[i].id;
     op.text = JOBS[i].label;
     if (JOBS[i].id === jid) { op.selected = true; }
     sel.appendChild(op);
  }
  wireJob(sel, c.id);
  host.appendChild(sel);
  host.appendChild(make("div", "cq-cost",
     (o.job !== undefined
        ? ("staged - " + jobCost(jid) + " action" +
           (jobCost(jid) === 1 ? "" : "s"))
        : ("costs " + jobCost(jid) + " to hand over"))));
  host.appendChild(make("div", "cq-lab", "Orders"));
  var od, cost, locked;
  for (i = 0; i < ORDERS.length; i++) {
     od = ORDERS[i];
     cost = orderCost(c, od.id);
     locked = (od.id === "learnSt" && !STATE.docked) ||
              (od.id === "rest" && c.fatigue < 25 && c.morale >= 70 && !o.rest);
     row = make("div", "cq-ord" + (o[od.id] ? " cq-ord-on" : "") +
                  (locked ? " cq-ord-off" : ""));
     var fee = orderFee(c, od.id);
     row.innerHTML =
        '<span class="cq-box">' + (o[od.id] ? "x" : "") + '</span>' +
        '<span class="cq-ordl">' + od.label + '</span>' +
        '<span class="cq-ordc">' + cost +
        (fee ? ' &middot; ' + fee + ' sh' : '') + '</span>' +
        '<div class="cq-ordn">' +
        (locked ? (od.id === "rest" ? "already rested" : "no station in reach") : od.note) + '</div>';
     if (!locked) { wireOrder(row, c.id, od.id); }
     host.appendChild(row);
  }

}
function wireJob(sel, id) {
  on(sel, "change", function () { stageJob(id, sel.value); });
}
function wireOrder(el, cid, oid) {
  on(el, "click", function (e) {
     toggleOrder(cid, oid);
     if (e && e.stopPropagation) { e.stopPropagation(); }
     if (window.event) { window.event.cancelBubble = true; }
     return false;
  });
}

function paintSheet() {
  var host = $("cq-sheet"), id, o, c, i, bits, html = "";
  if (!host) { return; }
  for (id in STATE.pendingOrders) {
     if (!STATE.pendingOrders.hasOwnProperty(id)) { continue; }
     o = STATE.pendingOrders[id];
     c = findById(CREW, id);
     if (!c) { continue; }
     bits = [];
     if (o.job !== undefined) { bits[bits.length] = jobLabel(o.job); }
     for (i = 0; i < ORDERS.length; i++) {
        if (o[ORDERS[i].id]) { bits[bits.length] = ORDERS[i].label; }
     }
     html += field(c.name.split(" ")[0],
                bits.join(", ") + ' <span class="cq-sub2">' +
                crewCostOf(c) + '</span>');
  }
  setPanel("cq-sheet", html ||
     '<span class="dim">Nothing written down yet.</span>');
}

function paintCrewBand() {
  var band = $("cq-band"), n = ordersCost(), who = orderedCount();
  var out = ordersRunning();
  if (!band) { return; }
  clear(band);
  PROGRESS_UI["crew-assign"] = null;

    /* No instructions. A fact, or nothing. */
    band.appendChild(make("div", "actionbar",
       out
         ? '<span class="dim">Orders in hand.</span>'
         : (n > 0
            ? ("Orders written for " + who + " crew member" +
               (who === 1 ? "" : "s") + "." +
               (ordersAvailable() ? "" : " A selected crew member is busy.") +
               (ordersFee() ? " Training fees " + ordersFee() +
                        " sh of " + STATE.shiplets + "." : ""))
            : '<span class="dim">No orders written.</span>')));

    /* THE SAME BUTTON, THE SAME BAR. buildProgressButton finds
      the "crew-assign" task on its own and fills green as the
      ship spends actions; while it fills it is inert, and no
      new orders can be written by anyone. */
    var row = make("div", "actionrow");
    row.appendChild(actionCell(buildProgressButton(
       "crew-assign", "Assign Tasks (" + n + " Action" +
       (n === 1 ? "" : "s") + ")", commitOrders, n > 0 && ordersAvailable())));
    band.appendChild(row);
    band.appendChild(make("div", "clear"));
}


/* ================================================================
  SECTION J : SIDE PANEL
  ================================================================ */

function buildSidePanel() {
  var sp = $("sidepanel"), i, html;
  if (!sp) { return; }
  clear(sp);

    /* --- vessel identity and spec sheet : folded ---------- */
    html = '<div class="sp-ship">' + SHIP.name + '</div>' +
         '<div class="sp-sub">' + SHIP.className +
         '<br>Registry ' + SHIP.registry + '</div>';
    /* Grouped, and ruled between groups. Anything whose value is
      a sentence gets the label on its own line with the text
      beneath it - cramming those into a right-hand column was
      what made the card look like a jumble. */
    html += spPair("Built", SHIP.built) + '<div class="sp-hr"></div>' +
          spLong("Yard", SHIP.yard) +
         spLong("Refit", SHIP.refit) +
         spLong("Drive", SHIP.drive) + '<div class="sp-hr"></div>' +
         spPair("Length", SHIP.length) + spPair("Beam", SHIP.beam) +
         spPair("Height", SHIP.height) + spPair("Mass", SHIP.mass) +
         '<div class="sp-hr"></div>' +
         spPair("Decks", SHIP.decks) + spPair("Berths", SHIP.berths) +
         spPair("Rooms", ROOMS.length + " aboard");
    sp.appendChild(dropBlock("vessel", "Vessel", html));

    /* --- resources : folded ------------------------------- */
    html = "";
    for (i = 0; i < RESOURCES.length; i++) {
       html += '<div class="sp-row"><span class="sp-key">' + RESOURCES[i].label +
             '</span><span class="sp-val num" id="res-' + i + '">' +
             resourceValue(RESOURCES[i]) + '</span></div>';
    }
    sp.appendChild(dropBlock("resources", "Resources", html));

    /* --- crew : folded ------------------------------------ */
    html = "";
    for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) {
       html += '<div class="sp-row"><span class="sp-key">' + CREW[i].name +
             '</span><span class="sp-val-dim">' + shortRole(CREW[i].role) +
             '</span></div>';
    }
    if (STATE.passengers.length) { html += spPair("Passengers", STATE.passengers.length); }
    sp.appendChild(dropBlock("crew", "Crew", html));

    /* Active contracts remain readable while away from the mission board. */
    html = "";
    for (i = 0; i < CONTRACTS.length; i++) {
       if (STATE.contracts[CONTRACTS[i].id] === "active" || STATE.contracts[CONTRACTS[i].id] === "ready") {
          html += spLong(CONTRACTS[i].title, CONTRACTS[i].note +
             (STATE.contracts[CONTRACTS[i].id] === "ready" ? " Ready to collect." : ""));
       }
    }
    var commission = STATE.commissions.active;
    if (commission) {
      html += spLong("Commission", simEscape(commissionDescription(commission)) + " - " +
        commission.progress + " / " + commissionGoal(commission.kind) +
        (commission.progress >= commissionGoal(commission.kind) ? ". Ready to collect at a station." : "."));
    }
    sp.appendChild(dropBlock("contracts", "Contracts", html || '<div class="sp-dim">No active contracts.</div>'));

    /* --- events : folded. Kind only, details in the task window. --- */
    sp.appendChild(dropBlockEl("events", "Events", buildEventsBody()));

    /* --- indicators : never folded, this is the glance ---- */
    var ind = make("div", "sp-block", '<div class="sp-title">Indicators</div>');
    var strip = make("div", "ind-strip");
    strip.id = "ind-strip";
    ind.appendChild(strip);
    sp.appendChild(ind);
    paintIndicators();
}

/* A block whose body the player folds away. The open/shut state
  lives in STATE, so a rebuild never springs them all open. */
/* Same block, but the body is an element rather than a string -
  the events list carries buttons, and a button needs a handler,
  which innerHTML cannot give it. */
function spPair(k, v) {
   return '<div class="sp-row"><span class="sp-key">' + k +
        '</span><span class="sp-val-dim">' + v + '</span></div>';
}
function spLong(k, v) {
   return '<div class="sp-long"><div class="sp-longk">' + k +
        '</div><div class="sp-longv">' + v + '</div></div>';
}

function dropBlockEl(key, title, bodyEl) {
  var open = !!STATE.spOpen[key];
  var b = make("div", "sp-block");

    var head = make("div", "sp-drop" + (open ? " sp-drop-open" : ""), title);
    head.appendChild(make("div", "sp-caret" + (open ? " sp-caret-open" : "")));
    bindDrop(head, key);
    b.appendChild(head);

    if (open) {
       var body = make("div", "sp-body");
       body.appendChild(bodyEl);
       b.appendChild(body);
    }
    return b;
}

/* One row per event: the KIND, and a button that opens its task.
  No detail, no countdown, no severity - the player is told that
  something of this sort has been noticed, and must go and look.
  Opening it is free; only what happens INSIDE will cost. */
function buildEventsBody() {
   var wrap = make("div", null), i, ev, row, btn;
   if (EVENTS.length === 0) {
      wrap.appendChild(make("div", "sp-dim", "Nothing reported."));
      return wrap;
   }
   for (i = 0; i < EVENTS.length; i++) {
      ev
  = EVENTS[i];
      row = make("div", "sp-evt");
      row.appendChild(make("div", "sp-evt-kind", ev.kind));
      btn = make("div", "sp-evt-btn", "Open");
      wireEventOpen(btn, ev.id);
      row.appendChild(btn);
      row.appendChild(make("div", "clear"));
      wrap.appendChild(row);
   }
   return wrap;
}
function wireEventOpen(el, id) {
   on(el, "click", function (e) {
      openTask("event", id, false); /* tab only - no jump, no action */
      if (e && e.stopPropagation) { e.stopPropagation(); }
      if (window.event) { window.event.cancelBubble = true; }
      return false;
   });
}

function dropBlock(key, title, innerHtml) {
    var open = !!STATE.spOpen[key];
    var b = make("div", "sp-block");

    var head = make("div", "sp-drop" + (open ? " sp-drop-open" : ""), title);
    head.appendChild(make("div", "sp-caret" + (open ? " sp-caret-open" : "")));
    bindDrop(head, key);
    b.appendChild(head);

    if (open) { b.appendChild(make("div", "sp-body", innerHtml)); }
    return b;
}

/* closure guard, same pattern as every other binder here */
function bindDrop(el, key) {
   on(el, "click", function () {
      STATE.spOpen[key] = !STATE.spOpen[key];
      buildSidePanel();        /* free - the sidebar costs nothing */
   });
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
  THE INDICATOR STRIP
  One line per running process, drawn bottom-up.

    Green lines are the player's own committed work and SHRINK as
    they finish - a short line means "nearly ready". Red lines are
    ambient ship processes and GROW - a tall red line is the ship
    telling the player something is getting away from them.

  Repainted whenever the task list changes; never labelled.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function indicatorLines() {
   var out = [], i, t, pct;

    /* THE ENGINE WARNING. Silent above the threshold; below it a
       red line appears and climbs as the condition falls, so the
       worse it gets the harder it is to miss. Leftmost, because
       it is the one line that means trouble rather than work. */
    if (STATE.engineCondition < ENGINE.warnBelow) {
        out[out.length] = {
           pct : Math.round(((ENGINE.warnBelow - STATE.engineCondition) /
                        ENGINE.warnBelow) * 100),
           grow : true
        };
    }

    /* THE AIR. Silent while the bank runs or the room is still
       clean; below that a second red line grows as it declines. */
    if (airStage() < 4) {
        out[out.length] = {
          pct : Math.round(((4 - airStage()) / 4) * 100),
          grow : true
        };
    }

    for (i = 0; i < STATE.ongoing.length; i++) {
       t = STATE.ongoing[i];
       pct = (t.total > 0) ? Math.round((t.left / t.total) * 100) : 0;
       if (t.state !== "running") { pct = 0; }
       out[out.length] = { pct:pct, grow:false };
    }
    for (i = 0; i < EVENTS.length; i++) {
       t = EVENTS[i];
       var spec = incidentSpec(t), stage = spec.stages[t.stage];
       pct = Math.round(100 * (t.stage + (stage.ticks - t.left) / stage.ticks) / (spec.stages.length - 1));
       out[out.length] = { pct:pct, grow:true };
    }
    return out;
}

var IND = { h:104, gap:5 }; /* strip height and line pitch */

function paintIndicators() {
  var strip = $("ind-strip");
  if (!strip) { return; }
  clear(strip);

    var lines = indicatorLines(), i, ln, h, x, el;
    /* IND.h must match .ind-strip in the CSS. Closer together
       than before as well - the strip has to hold a busy ship. */
    if (lines.length === 0) {
        strip.appendChild(make("div", "ind-none", "-"));
        return;
    }

    for (i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
       ln = lines[i];
       h = Math.round(IND.h * (ln.pct / 100));
       if (h < 1) { h = 1; }
       if (h > IND.h) { h = IND.h; }
       x = i * IND.gap;

        el = make("div", "ind-ghost");
        el.style.left = x + "px";
        el.style.height = (IND.h - h) + "px";
        strip.appendChild(el);

        el = make("div", "ind-line" + (ln.grow ? " ind-grow" : ""));
        el.style.left = x + "px";
        el.style.height = h + "px";
        strip.appendChild(el);
    }
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
  THE PINNED FOOT
  Ship functions as symbols, then the build marker last. Save and
  Load are one door, so they are one button.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function buildSideFoot() {
   var sf = $("sidefoot");
   if (!sf) { return; }
   clear(sf);

    var row = make("div", "sp-icons");
    row.appendChild(iconButton("manifest", "Ship Manifest",
       ["ico-mast", "ico-sail", "ico-hull"]));
    row.appendChild(iconButton("log", "Activity Log",
       ["ico-line1", "ico-line2", "ico-line3"]));
    row.appendChild(iconButton("files", "Save / Load Game",
       ["ico-disk", "ico-shut", "ico-lab"]));
    row.appendChild(iconButton("settings", "Settings",
       ["ico-ring", "ico-t1", "ico-t2", "ico-t3", "ico-t4"]));
    sf.appendChild(row);
    var quick = make("div", "sp-quick"), wiki = make("button", "", "Wiki"), n = readyCommendations();
    var awards = make("button", "", "Rewards" + (n ? " (" + n + ")" : ""));
    wiki.title = "Open the ship's handbook"; awards.title = "Open commendations and rewards";
    on(wiki, "click", function () { openTask("wiki", "main", true); });
    on(awards, "click", function () { openTask("awards", "main", true); });
    quick.appendChild(wiki); quick.appendChild(awards); sf.appendChild(quick);
    sf.appendChild(make("div", "sp-build", "Spaceship Command"));
}

function iconButton(key, title, parts) {
  var b = make("div", "sp-ico"), i;
  b.title = title;              /* the only label they get */
  for (i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
     b.appendChild(make("div", "ico-part " + parts[i]));
  }
  on(b, "click", function () { openPopup(key); });
  return b;
}

function shortRole(role) {
  var cut = role.indexOf(" /");
  return cut > 0 ? role.substring(0, cut) : role;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
  THE STORES
  Every total is computed, never stored twice. A room window, a
  briefing and the sidebar all call these, so they cannot
  disagree with each other.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* The sidebar used to be built once and then left to rot: the
  purse could empty and the rack could run dry while the panel
  still showed the boot figures. This rewrites the VALUES only -
  no rebuild, no flicker, and it does nothing at all while the
  block is folded away. */
function paintResources() {
   var i, el;
   for (i = 0; i < RESOURCES.length; i++) {
      el = $("res-" + i);
      if (el) { el.innerHTML = resourceValue(RESOURCES[i]); }
    }
}

function resourceValue(r) {
  if (r.from === "purse") { return STATE.shiplets; }
  if (r.from === "fuelCells" || r.from === "repairKits" || r.from === "medkits") { return STATE[r.from]; }
  if (r.from === "o2") { return LIFE.canisters; }
  if (r.from === "rations") { return MESS.rack; }
  if (r.from === "goods") { return cargoUsed() + " m3"; }
  if (r.from === "survey") { return SURVEY.length + " logs"; }
  return r.value;
}

function cargoUsed() {
  var i, v = 0;
  for (i = 0; i < GOODS.length; i++) { v += GOODS[i].vol; }
  return v;
}

function cargoWorth() {
  var i, v = 0;
  for (i = 0; i < GOODS.length; i++) { v += STATE.docked ? lotPrice(GOODS[i]) : GOODS[i].value; }
  return v;
}

function surveyWorth() {
  var i, v = 0;
  for (i = 0; i < SURVEY.length; i++) { v += SURVEY[i].value; }
  return v;
}

/* how many filters still have something in them */
function filtersLive() {
   return bankRunning() ? LIFE.slots.length : 0;
}

function lifeSummary() {
  if (bankRunning()) {
     return "Filters running - " + STATE.filterLife + " of " +
          LIFE.lifeMax + " actions of air";
  }
  if (STATE.airHold > 0) {
     return (STATE.filterLife > 0 && statValue("energy").value <= 0 ? "POWER LOST - " : airWord() + " - ") + STATE.airHold +
          " actions of cabin air left";
  }
  return "FOUL - no filtration, no reserve";
}

/* A deep scan is worth data. Filed under the body's name so the
  Science Room can show where each log came from. */
function fileSurvey(b) {
   var i, worth;
   for (i = 0; i < SURVEY.length; i++) {
      if (SURVEY[i].id === "sv-" + b.id) { return; } /* already held */
    }
    worth = SURVEY_WORTH[b.type];
    if (!worth) { worth = 60; }
    SURVEY[SURVEY.length] = {
       id:"sv-" + b.id, name:b.name, src:"Deep scan",
       value:worth, state:"filed"
    };
}


/* ================================================================
  SECTION K : FLOATING POPUPS
  Side panel items open here rather than replacing the main area,
  so the idle screen stays readable behind them.
  ================================================================ */

function openPopup(key) {
  if (key === "files" || key === "save" || key === "load") { filesPopup(); return; }
  if (key === "settings") {
    var old = $("pop-settings"); if (old) { old.parentNode.removeChild(old); }
  }
  var spec = popupSpec(key);
  showPopup(spec.title, spec.html, key);
  if (key === "settings") { wireSettings(); }
}
function wireSettings() {
  on($("settings-motion"), "click", function () {
    STATE.reducedMotion = !STATE.reducedMotion;
    while (STATE.reducedMotion && MARKS.length) { retireMark(MARKS[0]); }
    paintSettings();
  });
  bindSetting("settings-text", "largeText");
  bindSetting("settings-confirm", "confirmRisk");
  bindSetting("settings-labels", "hideCrewLabels");
  bindSetting("settings-sfx", "soundEffects");
  bindSetting("settings-music", "music");
  on($("settings-theme"), "change", function () {
    STATE.options.theme = $("settings-theme").value; applyPreferences(); paintSettings();
  });
  on($("settings-audio-level"), "change", function () {
    STATE.options.audioLevel = parseFloat($("settings-audio-level").value); applyPreferences(); paintSettings();
  });
  paintSettings();
}
function bindSetting(id, key) {
  on($(id), "click", function () {
    STATE.options[key] = !STATE.options[key]; applyPreferences(); paintSettings();
    if (key === "music" && STATE.options.music) { startAudioFromGesture(); }
  });
}
function applyPreferences() {
  var o = STATE.options || newGameOptions(), theme = THEMES[o.theme] ? o.theme : "classic", cls = "";
  if (o.largeText) { cls += "large-text "; }
  if (o.hideCrewLabels) { cls += "hide-crew-labels "; }
  if (theme !== "classic") { cls += "theme-" + theme; }
  if (document.body) { document.body.className = cls; }
  syncAudioOptions(false);
  if ($("map")) { applyRaster(); }
}
function confirmRisk(message) {
  return !STATE.options.confirmRisk || (typeof window.confirm === "function" && window.confirm(message));
}
function paintSettings() {
  var b = $("settings-motion");
  if (b) { b.innerHTML = STATE.reducedMotion ? "Enable decorative motion" : "Reduce decorative motion"; }
  b = $("settings-text"); if (b) { b.innerHTML = STATE.options.largeText ? "Use standard reading text" : "Use larger reading text"; }
  b = $("settings-confirm"); if (b) { b.innerHTML = STATE.options.confirmRisk ? "Disable confirmations" : "Enable confirmations"; }
  b = $("settings-labels"); if (b) { b.innerHTML = STATE.options.hideCrewLabels ? "Show crew labels" : "Hide crew labels"; }
  b = $("settings-sfx"); if (b) { b.innerHTML = STATE.options.soundEffects ? "Sound effects: On" : "Sound effects: Off"; }
  b = $("settings-music"); if (b) { b.innerHTML = STATE.options.music ? "Ambient soundtrack: On" : "Ambient soundtrack: Off"; }
  b = $("settings-theme"); if (b) { b.value = THEMES[STATE.options.theme] ? STATE.options.theme : "classic"; }
  b = $("settings-audio-level"); if (b) { b.value = String(audioLevel()); }
}

/* Anything written to the log reaches an open log popup at once.
  A record the player is staring at while it goes stale is worse
  than no record: it says, wrongly, that nothing happened. */
function refreshLogPopup() {
   var b = $("pop-log-body");
   if (!b) { return; }
   b.innerHTML = popupSpec("log").html;
}

/* The window chrome itself. Every floating panel in the game is
  built here - side panel items and idle-screen briefings alike -
  so they can never drift apart in look or behaviour. */
/* key is optional: a popup that names itself can be found again
  and refreshed in place. The Activity Log needs that - it is
  carried from screen to screen and must keep telling the truth
  while it sits there, not freeze at the moment it was opened. */
function showPopup(title, html, key) {
   var pop = make("div", "pop");
   if (key) { pop.id = "pop-" + key; }
   var off = (STATE.popups % 5) * 22;
   STATE.popups++;

    pop.style.left = (300 + off) + "px";
    pop.style.top = (90 + off) + "px";

    var head = make("div", "pop-head", title);
    var x = make("span", "pop-x", "x");
    on(x, "click", function () { pop.parentNode.removeChild(pop); });
    head.appendChild(x);

    pop.appendChild(head);
    var body = make("div", "pop-body", html);
    if (key) { body.id = "pop-" + key + "-body"; }
    pop.appendChild(body);
    document.body.appendChild(pop);

    makeDraggable(pop, head);
}

function popupSpec(key) {
  var html = "", i, c, r;

    if (key === "manifest") {
       html = '<div class="panel-head" style="margin:-11px -13px 10px -13px;">Crew</div>';

    for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) {
       c = CREW[i];
       r = findById(ROOMS, c.room);
       html += '<div class="kv"><div class="kv-k">' + c.name +
             '</div><div class="kv-v">' + c.role + ' - ' + r.name +
             '</div><div class="clear"></div></div>';
    }
    html += '<div class="panel-head" style="margin:14px -13px 10px -13px;">Compartments</div>';
    for (i = 0; i < ROOMS.length; i++) {
       html += '<div class="kv"><div class="kv-k">' + ROOMS[i].name +
             '</div><div class="kv-v">' + ROOMS[i].systems +
             '</div><div class="clear"></div></div>';
    }
    return { title:"Ship Manifest", html:html };
  }

    if (key === "log") {
       for (i = STATE.feed.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { /* newest first */
          html += '<div class="feed-line"><span class="feed-time num">' +
                STATE.feed[i].t + '</span>' + STATE.feed[i].s + '</div>';
       }
       return { title:"Activity Log", html:html };
    }

    if (key === "save" || key === "load" || key === "files") {
       return {
          title: (key === "files" ? "Save / Load Game"
                             : (key === "save" ? "Save Game" : "Load Game")),
          html : '<div class="notice">Use the Save / Load buttons to preserve or restore the voyage.</div>'
       };
    }

    return {
       title:"Settings",
      html :'<div class="notice">Preferences are free to change and are saved with the voyage.</div>' +
         '<div class="setting-row"><b>Colour palette</b><br>Change the bridge and instrument colours.<br><select id="settings-theme">' +
           '<option value="classic">Flight Deck - parchment</option><option value="void">Deep Space - cyan</option>' +
           '<option value="aurora">Aurora - mint</option><option value="nebula">Nebula - violet</option><option value="ember">Ember - copper</option></select></div>' +
         '<div class="setting-row"><b>Ambient soundtrack</b><br>A quiet, synthesized shipboard theme. Audio begins after a click.<br><button id="settings-music"></button></div>' +
         '<div class="setting-row"><b>Sound effects</b><br>Soft console clicks, scan pings, drive cues and completion chimes.<br><button id="settings-sfx"></button></div>' +
         '<div class="setting-row"><b>Audio level</b><br>Overall music and effects volume.<br><select id="settings-audio-level">' +
           '<option value="0.18">Quiet</option><option value="0.4">Standard</option><option value="0.65">Loud</option><option value="0.9">Very loud</option></select></div>' +
         '<div class="setting-row"><b>Decorative motion</b><br>Pause map and crew drift, tab glows and action marks.<br><button id="settings-motion"></button></div>' +
         '<div class="setting-row"><b>Reading text</b><br>Enlarge the main reading and action text.<br><button id="settings-text"></button></div>' +
         '<div class="setting-row"><b>Confirmations</b><br>Ask before jettisoning, abandoning, story decisions, saving or loading.<br><button id="settings-confirm"></button></div>' +
         '<div class="setting-row"><b>Crew labels</b><br>Show or hide names on the ship diagram.<br><button id="settings-labels"></button></div>'
   };
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
  IDLE-SCREEN BRIEFINGS
  A left click anywhere on the idle screen answers two questions
  and nothing else: what am I looking at, and what could be done
  to it. The costs shown are the same descriptors the task window
  renders, read from describeTarget, so a briefing can never
  drift out of step with the window it describes.

  Strictly free. It reads state, writes none, and spends no
  action - the idle screen remains the one place that costs the
  player nothing.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function openBrief(kind, id) {
   var b = briefSpec(kind, id);
   showPopup(b.title, b.html);
}

function briefSpec(kind, id) {
  if (kind === "nav") { return navBrief(); }

  var t = describeTarget(kind, id), html = "", i, a, lim;

  html += '<div class="notice" style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">' +
       t.sub + '</div>';

  lim = t.rows.length;
  if (lim > 5) { lim = 5; }   /* a briefing, not the file */
  for (i = 0; i < lim; i++) {
     html += kvRow(t.rows[i][0], t.rows[i][1]);
  }

  if (t.acts.length) {
    html += popHead("Actions in this window");
    for (i = 0; i < t.acts.length; i++) {
       a = t.acts[i];
       html += '<div class="act"><span class="act-cost">' + a.cost +
             '</span>' + a.label + (a.live ? " - wired" : "") + '</div>';
    }
  }

  html += '<div class="notice" style="margin-top:10px;">' +
       'Right-click to open the ' + t.title + ' window. It waits in ' +
         'the tab bar - you are not taken there.</div>';

    return { title: t.kindLabel + " - " + t.title, html: html };
}

/* The chart has no describeTarget rows - it builds its own screen -
  so its briefing is written out here. */
function navBrief() {
   var html =
      '<div class="notice" style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">The ship chart. ' +
      'Everything that is only LOOKING at it is free.</div>' +
      kvRow("Scales", "System, Sector and Galaxy") +
      kvRow("Switching", "The three buttons on the chart - free") +
      kvRow("Panning", "Hold the left button and drag the chart") +
      kvRow("Selecting", "Click any marker to read it - free") +
      kvRow("Galaxy", "Select a region, then open its sector chart - free") +
      kvRow("Sector", "Select a system and jump to its entry star") +
      popHead("Actions in this window") +
      '<div class="act"><span class="act-cost">varies</span>' +
      'Start Travel - wired</div>' +
      '<div class="act"><span class="act-cost">' + simScanCost() +
      ' actions</span>Run Deep Scan - wired</div>' +
      '<div class="notice" style="margin-top:10px;">Travel costs one ' +
      'action per step of charted distance, so the price is the ' +
      'crossing itself. Both run in the background and drain from ' +
      'actions spent anywhere on the ship.</div>' +
      '<div class="notice" style="margin-top:6px;">Travel also uses fuel; right-click the fuel gauge to transfer a cell. ' +
      'Right-click to open the Navigation window. It waits in the tab bar - you are not ' +
      'taken there.</div>';
   return { title:"NAV - Navigation", html:html };
}

/* the two scraps of markup every popup repeats */
function kvRow(k, v) {
   return '<div class="kv"><div class="kv-k">' + k +
        '</div><div class="kv-v">' + v +
        '</div><div class="clear"></div></div>';
}

function popHead(text) {
  return '<div class="panel-head" style="margin:14px -13px 10px -13px;">' +
       text + '</div>';
}

/* simple drag, written without modern event APIs */
function makeDraggable(pop, handle) {
   var dragging = false, ox = 0, oy = 0;

    on(handle, "mousedown", function (e) {
      var ev = e || window.event;
      dragging = true;
      ox = ev.clientX - pop.offsetLeft;
       oy = ev.clientY - pop.offsetTop;
       if (ev.preventDefault) { ev.preventDefault(); }
       return false;
    });

    on(document, "mousemove", function (e) {
       if (!dragging) { return; }
       var ev = e || window.event;
       pop.style.left = (ev.clientX - ox) + "px";
       pop.style.top = (ev.clientY - oy) + "px";
    });

    on(document, "mouseup", function () { dragging = false; });
}


/* ================================================================
  SECTION L : STATUS BAR
  ================================================================ */

/* THE ONLY STRIP OF SCREEN VISIBLE FROM EVERY WINDOW.
  The activity feed lives on the idle screen, so a player who
  seats three canisters and starts the bank - all of it done
  inside the filter room - saw nothing happen anywhere. The
  last line of the log now rides here, so the ship can always
  answer "what just happened" without changing screens. */
function setStatus() {
   var bar = $("statusbar");
   if (!bar) { return; }
   var open = STATE.tabs.length;
   var last = STATE.feed.length
          ? STATE.feed[STATE.feed.length - 1].s : "";
   bar.innerHTML =
      SHIP.name + " - " + findById(INFOS, "location").value +
      " | Actions <span class='num'>" + actionCounter + "</span>" +
      " | Open tasks <span class='num'>" + open + "</span>" +
      (last ? " | <span class='st-last'>" + last + "</span>" : "");
}

function addSystemBody(id, type, name, x, y, sys, text) {
  var reading = type === "star" ? "Stellar output has been charted." :
    (type === "station" ? "A working dock answers on the approach channel." :
    (type === "planet" ? "Surface contours have been recorded." :
    (type === "moon" ? "A natural satellite follows a stable orbit." :
    (type === "belt" ? "Loose material is spread across the plotted belt." : "The landmark has been plotted for later investigation."))));
  var body = {id:id, type:type, name:name, x:x, y:y, system:sys.id,
    klass:type === "star" ? "Charted star" : (type === "station" ? "Working station" :
      (type === "planet" ? "Charted world" : (type === "moon" ? "Natural satellite" :
      (type === "belt" ? "Debris belt" : "Unoccupied landmark")))),
    details:[["System", sys.name], ["Region", findById(GALAXY_BODIES, sys.region).name]],
    scan:[text, reading], scanLocked:[type === "station" ? "Station manifest" : "Detailed spectral survey"]};
  BODIES.push(body);
  return body;
}
function buildGalaxyContent() {
  var i, row, sys, slug, entry, landmark, hub = {}, region;
  SECTOR_BODIES[0].region = "gal-inner"; SECTOR_BODIES[0].entry = "kessler";
  hub["gal-inner"] = "sec-kessler";
  for (i = 0; i < STAR_CATALOG.length; i++) {
    row = STAR_CATALOG[i]; slug = row[0].substring(4); entry = slug + "-star";
    sys = findById(SECTOR_BODIES, row[0]);
    if (!sys) {
      sys = {id:row[0], type:"system", name:row[2], x:row[3], y:row[4],
        klass:"Charted star system", details:[["Charted bodies", "3"]], scan:[], scanLocked:[]};
      SECTOR_BODIES.push(sys);
      if (hub[row[1]]) { SECTOR_LINKS.push([hub[row[1]], sys.id]); }
      else { hub[row[1]] = sys.id; }
    } else {
      if (sys.id === "sec-pell") { sys.details[0][1] = "2 previously reported; 3 now charted"; }
      sys.details.push(["Navigable", "3 bodies"]);
    }
    sys.region = row[1]; sys.entry = entry;
    addSystemBody(entry, "star", row[5], 100 + (i % 3) * 32, 58 + (i % 2) * 14, sys, row[9]);
    addSystemBody(slug + "-world", row[6].indexOf("Belt") >= 0 ? "belt" : "planet",
      row[6], 390 + (i % 3) * 28, 64 + (i % 2) * 20, sys, row[9]);
    landmark = slug + (row[8] ? "-port" : "-site");
    addSystemBody(landmark, row[8] ? "station" : "site", row[7], 260 + (i % 3) * 45, 210, sys, row[9]);
    if (row[8]) { PORTS[landmark] = {name:row[7], prices:PORT_PRICES[row[8]], tip:row[9] + " " + PORT_HINTS[row[8]]}; }
  }
  for (i = 0; i < GALAXY_BODIES.length; i++) {
    region = GALAXY_BODIES[i]; region.cluster += 10;
  }
}

  {id:"ice", label:"Outer ice world", atmo:"Nitrogen frost", scan:"A broad ice mantle covers a fractured silicate core.", locked:"Subsurface ocean mapping"},

var ORBITAL_MOON_NAMES = ["Moth", "Nacre", "Orrery", "Peregrine", "Quietus", "Rill", "Sable", "Tern", "Umbra", "Vesper", "Wisp", "Yarrow"];
function expandLocalCharts() {
  var i, sys, word, profile, world, moon, key, value, x, y;
  for (i = 0; i < SECTOR_BODIES.length; i++) {
    sys = SECTOR_BODIES[i]; word = sys.name.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]+/g, " ").replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, "").split(" ")[0];
    profile = ORBITAL_WORLDS[i % ORBITAL_WORLDS.length];
    x = 470 + (i % 5) * 28; y = 88 + (i % 5) * 22;
    world = addSystemBody(sys.id.substring(4) + "-outer", "planet",
      ORBITAL_PLANET_NAMES[i % ORBITAL_PLANET_NAMES.length] + " " + word,
      x, y, sys, profile.scan);
    world.subtype = profile.id; world.klass = profile.label;
    world.details.push(["Atmosphere", profile.atmo], ["Orbital band", "Outer system"]);
    world.scan = [profile.scan, "This world is charted beyond the system's primary traffic lane."];
    world.scanLocked = [profile.locked, "High-resolution orbital survey"];

    x = 36 + (i % 5) * 24; y = 194 + (i % 4) * 16;
    moon = addSystemBody(sys.id.substring(4) + "-moon", "moon",
      ORBITAL_MOON_NAMES[(i * 5) % ORBITAL_MOON_NAMES.length] + " " + word,
      x, y, sys, "A small satellite traces a quiet path beyond the mapped world.");
    moon.klass = "Natural satellite - stable orbit";
    moon.details.push(["Satellite of", world.name], ["Surface", i % 2 ? "Heavily cratered" : "Icy regolith"]);
    moon.scan = ["A natural satellite follows a stable orbit.", "The surface is " + (i % 2 ? "heavily cratered" : "covered in icy regolith") + "."];
    moon.scanLocked = ["Subsurface structure", "Full orbital mechanics"];

    for (var j = 0; j < sys.details.length; j++) {
      key = sys.details[j][0]; value = sys.details[j][1];
      if (key === "Charted bodies") { sys.details[j][1] = sys.id === "sec-kessler" ? "8" : "5"; }
      else if (key === "Navigable") { sys.details[j][1] = "5 local destinations"; }
    }
    if (sys.id === "sec-kessler") { sys.klass = "Eight charted destinations"; }
    else if (sys.klass === "Charted star system") { sys.klass = "Five charted destinations"; }
  }
}

function statValue(id) { return findById(STATS, id); }
function clampStat(id, delta) {
  var s = statValue(id), before;
  if (!s) { return; }
  before = s.value; s.value = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, s.value + delta));
  if (id === "energy" && before > 0 && s.value === 0) {
    if (STATE.filterLife > 0) { STATE.airHold = AIR.holdMax; }
    logLine("Power exhausted. The filter bank has stopped; restore energy to restart it.");
  } else if (id === "energy" && before === 0 && s.value > 0) {
    logLine("Power restored. Any charged filter bank resumes without another bonus.");
  }
  if (id === "energy" && ((before === 0) !== (s.value === 0))) {
    refreshLifeInfo(); paintIndicators(); paintO2();
  }
}
function lotPrice(g) {
  var port = PORTS[MAP.here], factor = port && port.prices[g.kind];
  return Math.round(g.value * (factor || 1));
}
function cargoReserved() {
  var i, n = 0, t;
  for (i = 0; i < STATE.ongoing.length; i++) {
    t = STATE.ongoing[i]; if (t.type === "salvage" && t.state === "running") { n += t.vol; }
  }
  return n;
}
function contractProgress(goal, target) {
  var i, j, q, cargo, changed = false;
  for (i = 0; i < CONTRACTS.length; i++) {
    q = CONTRACTS[i];
    if (STATE.contracts[q.id] !== "active" || q.target !== target ||
        (q.goal !== goal && !(goal === "visit" && (q.goal === "freight" || q.goal === "passenger")))) { continue; }
    if (q.goal === "freight") {
      cargo = findById(GOODS, "contract-" + q.id);
      if (!cargo) { continue; }
      for (j = GOODS.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) { if (GOODS[j] === cargo) { GOODS.splice(j, 1); } }
    }
    if (q.goal === "passenger") {
      cargo = findById(STATE.passengers, q.id);
      if (!cargo) { continue; }
      for (j = STATE.passengers.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) { if (STATE.passengers[j] === cargo) { STATE.passengers.splice(j, 1); } }
    }
    STATE.contracts[q.id] = "ready"; changed = true;
    logLine("Contract ready to collect: " + q.title + ".");
  }
  if (changed) { buildSidePanel(); }
}

/* Shared screen primitives use the existing task-window styling. */
function contentScreen(host, kind, title, sub) {
  var scr = make("div", "task-screen");
  scr.appendChild(make("div", "task-head", '<div class="task-kind">' + kind +
    '</div><div class="task-title">' + title + '</div><div class="task-sub">' + sub + '</div>'));
  host.appendChild(scr);
  return scr;
}
function contentPanel(parent, title) {
  var p = make("div", "panel"), body = make("div", "panel-body");
  p.appendChild(make("div", "panel-head", title));
  p.appendChild(body); parent.appendChild(p); return body;
}
function commandRow(parent, label, enabled, fn, cost, cooldownCategory, cooldownId) {
  var action = isActionCost(cost), displayCost = cost || "1 action";
  var el = make("div", "act" + (enabled ? " act-live" : "") + (enabled && action ? " act-action" : ""),
    '<span class="act-cost">' + displayCost + '</span>' + label);
  var slug = String(label || "action").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
  var occurrence = COMMAND_ROW_COUNTS[slug] || 0, id, key, category;
  COMMAND_ROW_COUNTS[slug] = occurrence + 1;
  id = cooldownId || ("command:" + slug + ":" + occurrence);
  key = actionCooldownKey(id);
  category = actionCooldownCategory(label, cooldownCategory);
  if (enabled) {
    if (action) {
      registerActionCooldownControl({key:key, kind:"command", element:el, baseClass:el.className,
        idleCost:displayCost, idleTitle:el.title || ""});
      on(el, "click", function (e) {
        return commitActionButton(e, key, category, function () { return fn(e); });
      });
    } else { on(el, "click", fn); }
  }
  parent.appendChild(el);
}
function repaintCurrent() {
  buildSidePanel();
  switchTab(STATE.activeTab);
}
/* Apply the purchase before the tick, so payroll cannot spend the
   same shiplets between the affordability check and the payment. */
function commitChange(e, message, change) {
  if (STATE.gameOver) { return; }
  change();
  fireAction(e, message);
  if (!STATE.gameOver) { repaintCurrent(); }
}
function buildInfoScreen(host, t) {
  var n = findById(INFOS, t.id), sys = currentSystem();
  var scr = contentScreen(host, "READOUT", n.label, "Live ship information");
  var body = contentPanel(scr, "Readout");
  body.innerHTML = field("Reading", n.value) + field("System", sys.name) +
    field("Region", findById(GALAXY_BODIES, sys.region).name);
  if (t.id === "life") {
    commandRow(body, "Open O2 Filter Room", true, function () { openTask("room", "o2", true); }, "free");
  } else {
    commandRow(body, "Open Navigation", true, function () { openTask("nav", "main", true); }, "free");
    commandRow(body, "Open Comms Relay", true, function () { openTask("room", "r4", true); }, "free");
  }
}

function buildSystemScreen(host, t) {
  var s = statValue(t.id), config = {

function buildStoresScreen(host, t) {

  var body = contentPanel(scr, cargo ? "Cargo manifest" : "Survey records"), i;

function buyLargerShip(e) {
  if (STATE.gameOver || !STATE.docked || !PORTS.hasOwnProperty(MAP.here) ||
      STATE.shipClass !== "wren" || STATE.shiplets < LARGE_SHIP_PRICE) { return false; }
  if (typeof window.confirm !== "function" || !window.confirm("Buy SC Tessellate for 4,000 shiplets? " +
      "The crew, cargo, equipment, refits, tasks and voyage records transfer. This purchase is permanent.")) { return false; }
  commitChange(e, "Commissioned SC Tessellate", function () {
    STATE.shiplets -= LARGE_SHIP_PRICE;
    STATE.shipClass = "kestrel";
    SHIP = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(LARGE_SHIP));
    CARGO.capacity = Math.max(CARGO.capacity, shipCargoCapacity("kestrel", cargoRefitLevel()));
    applyShipLayout();
    simRemember("Work", "The crew transferred from SC Wren to SC Tessellate at " + PORTS[MAP.here].name + ".");
  });
  return true;
}
