/* Escalations and their effects are defined by INCIDENT_TYPES. A
   newly reported incident starts counting on the following action. */
function incidentSpec(ev) { return findById(INCIDENT_TYPES, ev.type); }
function removeIncident(id) {
  var i, ev = findById(EVENTS, id);
  if (ev && ev.type === "crew" && ev.a && ev.b) {
    simChangeBond(ev.a, ev.b, 12);
    simRemember("Connection", simCrewName(ev.a) + " and " + simCrewName(ev.b) + " settled their dispute.", ev.a, ev.b);
  }
  for (i = EVENTS.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { if (EVENTS[i].id === id) { EVENTS.splice(i, 1); } }
  if (findOngoing("incident-" + id)) { clearOngoing("incident-" + id); }
  if (ev) { STATE.chronicle.incidents++; checkCommendations(); }
}
function incidentEffect(step, ev) {
  var i;
  if (ev.type === "crew" && ev.a && ev.b) {
    simChangeBond(ev.a, ev.b, -8);
    simRemember("Conflict", simCrewName(ev.a) + " and " + simCrewName(ev.b) + " remain in conflict.", ev.a, ev.b);
  }
  if (step.hull) { clampStat("hull", step.hull); }
  if (step.shield) { clampStat("shield", step.shield); }
  if (step.energy) { clampStat("energy", step.energy); }
  if (step.morale) {
    for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) { CREW[i].morale = Math.max(0, CREW[i].morale + step.morale); }
  }
}
function tickIncidents() {
  var i, j, ev, spec, step, exists, changed = false;
  for (i = EVENTS.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    ev = EVENTS[i]; spec = incidentSpec(ev);
    if (!spec) { continue; }
    ev.left--;
    if (ev.left > 0) { continue; }
    ev.stage++; step = spec.stages[ev.stage];
    incidentEffect(step, ev); logLine(step.text); changed = true;
    if (!step.ticks) { EVENTS.splice(i, 1); }
    else { ev.left = step.ticks; }
  }
  for (i = 0; i < INCIDENT_TYPES.length; i++) {
    spec = INCIDENT_TYPES[i]; exists = false;
    for (j = 0; j < EVENTS.length; j++) { if (EVENTS[j].type === spec.id) { exists = true; } }
    if (!exists && actionCounter >= spec.first && (actionCounter - spec.first) % spec.every === 0 &&
        (spec.id !== "crew" || CREW.length >= 2)) {
      ev = {id:spec.id + "-" + actionCounter, type:spec.id, kind:spec.kind,
        source:spec.source, stage:0, left:spec.stages[0].ticks};
      if (spec.id === "crew") { step = simDisputePair(); ev.a = step[0]; ev.b = step[1]; }
      EVENTS.push(ev);
      logLine("New " + spec.kind.toLowerCase() + " report. Open Events to investigate."); changed = true;
    }
  }
  if (changed) {
    buildSidePanel();
    if (STATE.activeTab.indexOf("event:") === 0) { switchTab(STATE.activeTab); }
  }
  paintIndicators();
}
function incidentHand(ev) {
  var i, c, score, best = null, bestScore = -1, spec = incidentSpec(ev);
  for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) {
    c = CREW[i]; if (crewBusy(c) || STATE.pendingOrders[c.id]) { continue; }
    score = c.morale;
    if ((spec.kind === "Mechanical" || spec.kind === "Electrical") && c.job === "maintenance") { score += 100; }
    if (spec.kind === "Environmental" && c.job === "filters") { score += 100; }
    if (spec.kind === "Crew" && c.id !== ev.a && c.id !== ev.b) { score += 100; }
    if (score > bestScore) { best = c; bestScore = score; }
  }
  return best;
}
function beginIncidentWork(e, id) {
  var ev = findById(EVENTS, id), worker = ev && incidentHand(ev), task;
  if (!worker || STATE.gameOver || findOngoing("incident-" + id)) { return; }
  CREW_CLAIMS[worker.id] = true;
  try { fireAction(e, worker.name + " assigned to " + incidentSpec(ev).title); }
  finally { delete CREW_CLAIMS[worker.id]; }
  if (!STATE.gameOver && findById(EVENTS, id) && findById(CREW, worker.id)) {
    task = addOngoing("incident-" + id, "Resolving " + incidentSpec(ev).title, 6, "incident", id);
    if (task) { task.by = worker.name; task.who = worker.id; }
    repaintCurrent();
  }
}
function buildIncidentScreen(host, t, ev) {
  var spec = incidentSpec(ev), step = spec.stages[ev.stage];
  var scr = contentScreen(host, "EVENT", spec.title, "Reported by " + ev.source);
  var body = contentPanel(scr, "Report");
  body.innerHTML = field("Condition", step.text) + field("Next change", ev.left + " actions") +
    (ev.type === "crew" && ev.a && ev.b ? field("Involved", simEscape(simCrewName(ev.a)) + " / " + simEscape(simCrewName(ev.b)) +
      " - bond " + simBond(ev.a, ev.b)) : "") +
    '<div class="notice">Ignore it and the situation will advance with your other actions.</div>';
  var needsKit = typeof spec.requiresKit === "boolean" ? spec.requiresKit : spec.kind !== "Crew";
  commandRow(body, spec.remedy + (needsKit ? " - use one repair kit" : ""), !needsKit || STATE.repairKits > 0, function (e) {
    commitChange(e, spec.remedy, function () { if (needsKit) { STATE.repairKits--; } removeIncident(ev.id); });
  }, undefined, "systems");
  var hand = incidentHand(ev);
  commandRow(body, "Assign crew to resolve - 6 actions of work" + (hand ? " (" + simEscape(hand.name) + ")" : " (none available)"),
    !findOngoing("incident-" + ev.id) && !!hand, function (e) { beginIncidentWork(e, ev.id); });
}
TASK_TYPES.incident = {autoClear:true, quiet:true, onDone:function (t) {
  if (findById(EVENTS, t.target)) { removeIncident(t.target); logLine("Crew resolved the report."); buildSidePanel(); }
}};
TASK_TYPES.salvage = {autoClear:true, quiet:true, onDone:function (t) {
  STATE.lotSerial++;
  GOODS.push({id:"recovery-" + STATE.lotSerial, name:"Recovered salvage", vol:t.vol,
    value:30, kind:"Salvage", risk:false});
  logLine("Salvage secured in the cargo hold.");
  commissionProgress("salvage", "");
}};
TASK_TYPES.surveyPackage = {autoClear:true, quiet:true, onDone:function (t) {
  var record = findById(SURVEY, t.target);
  if (record && record.state !== "packaged") {
    record.state = "packaged"; record.value = Math.ceil(record.value * 1.15);
    logLine("Survey packaged - " + record.name + ".");
  }
}};

/* Loss is explicit; a lost hand cannot be paid, healed or assigned. */
function checkLoss() {
  var i, j, c, task, lost = false;
  for (i = CREW.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    c = CREW[i];
    if (c.health > 0) { continue; }
    logLine(c.name + " has died.");
    delete STATE.pendingOrders[c.id]; clearOngoing("cw-" + c.id); clearOngoing("doc-" + c.id);
    for (j = STATE.ongoing.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      task = STATE.ongoing[j];
      if (task.type === "shipProject" && (task.who === c.id || task.other === c.id)) {
        clearOngoing(task.id); logLine("Crew work was interrupted by the loss."); continue;
      }
      if (task.by === c.name) {
        if (task.type === "o2slot") { LIFE.canisters = Math.min(LIFE.capacity, LIFE.canisters + 1); }
        clearOngoing(task.id);
      }
    }
    CREW.splice(i, 1); lost = true;
  }
  if (lost) { buildSidePanel(); }
  if (!STATE.gameOver && (statValue("hull").value <= 0 || CREW.length === 0)) {
    STATE.gameOver = statValue("hull").value <= 0 ? "The hull has failed." : "The crew have been lost.";
    logLine("Ship lost. " + STATE.gameOver); showLoss();
  }
}
function showLoss() {
  var veil = make("div", "", ""), box = make("div", "notice");
  veil.id = "game-over";
  veil.style.cssText = "position:fixed;z-index:9999;left:0;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:#f4efe6;";
  box.style.cssText = "width:420px;margin:150px auto;padding:24px;";
  box.innerHTML = '<div class="task-title">Ship lost</div><p>' + STATE.gameOver +
    '</p><p>Load a saved game or start a new voyage.</p><div id="loss-message"></div>';
  var slot = make("select", "");
  slot.innerHTML = '<option value="1">Save slot 1</option><option value="2">Save slot 2</option><option value="3">Save slot 3</option>';
  box.appendChild(slot);
  commandRow(box, "Load saved game", true, function () { $("loss-message").innerHTML = loadGame(slot.value); }, "free");
  commandRow(box, "Start a new voyage", true, function () { restartVoyage(); }, "free");
  commandRow(box, "Return to main menu", true, function () { showTitleMenu(true); }, "free");
  veil.appendChild(box); document.body.appendChild(veil);
}

/* Save all mutable stores, not just STATE. HTA saves UTF-16 text
   beside the application; the browser preview uses localStorage. */
function saveSnapshot() {
  var views = {}, i, layer;
  for (i = 0; i < LAYER_ORDER.length; i++) {
    layer = LAYERS[LAYER_ORDER[i]];
    views[layer.id] = {zoom:layer.zoom, px:layer.px, py:layer.py, sel:layer.sel};
  }
  return {format:"spaceship-command-1", state:STATE, actions:actionCounter, ship:SHIP,
    rooms:ROOMS, crew:CREW, stats:STATS, infos:INFOS, life:LIFE, mess:MESS,
    cargo:CARGO, goods:GOODS, survey:SURVEY, map:MAP, views:views,
    events:EVENTS, scanCost:SCAN_COST};
}
function saveSlot(slot) { return slot === 2 || slot === "2" ? 2 : (slot === 3 || slot === "3" ? 3 : 1); }
function saveFilename(slot) { return saveSlot(slot) === 1 ? "Spaceship_save.txt" : "Spaceship_save_" + saveSlot(slot) + ".txt"; }

  var bio = ((c.role || "") + " " + (c.traits || "") + " " + (c.hobby || "")).toLowerCase();

  if (/engineer|mechanic|repair|wrench/.test(bio)) { return "Maker"; }
  if (/support|spare|suppl|methodical/.test(bio)) { return "Keeper"; }
  if (/story|stories|notices|flower|recording/.test(bio)) { return "Witness"; }
  return "Companion";
}
function simDrive(c) {
  if (c.health < 75 || airStage() <= 1) { return "Safety - care and breathable air"; }
  if (c.fatigue > 70) { return "Rest - a break from the watch"; }
  if (c.hunger > 70) { return "Nourishment - a reliable meal"; }
  if (c.morale < 60) { return "Belonging - a change of pace or company"; }
  if (!c.job || c.skill === "Untrained" || !c.skill) { return "Mastery - useful work and training"; }
  if (simAnchor(c) === "Wayfinder") { return "Discovery - a new place or a quiet watch"; }
  if (simAnchor(c) === "Maker") { return "Mastery - something worth making"; }
  if (simAnchor(c) === "Keeper") { return "Safety - keeping the ship supplied"; }
  return "Belonging - stories and company";
}

}

    for (j = i + 1; j < CREW.length; j++) { pairs.push([CREW[i], CREW[j]]); }

/* A tired, healthy crew member may take a short break of their own.

function simCrewName(id) { var c = findById(CREW, id); return c ? c.name : "a former crew member"; }

/* Every project pays its inputs at commitment, reserves its output,

var PROJECT_CLAIM = "", CREW_CLAIMS = {};
var SHIP_PROJECTS = {
  kit:{label:"Turn recovered salvage into one repair kit", room:"r2", energy:3, work:4, lot:"Salvage"},
  sensors:{label:"Calibrate the next deep scan", room:"r3", energy:4, work:3},
  cooling:{label:"Cool and stabilize the drive (+15% condition)", room:"r5", energy:5, work:4},
  food:{label:"Process produce into eight rations", room:"r8", energy:3, work:3, lot:"Perishable"},
  oxygen:{label:"Recycle salvage into an O2 canister", room:"r9", energy:3, work:4, lot:"Salvage"},
  fuel:{label:"Refine salvage into a fuel cell", room:"r10", energy:4, work:5, lot:"Salvage"},
  brace:{label:"Use salvage to patch the hull (+15%)", room:"r11", energy:4, work:4, lot:"Salvage"},
  observe:{label:"Record the present location", room:"r12", energy:3, work:4},

function projectLot(kind) {

function possibleCanisterReturns() {

  }

function projectBlock(id) {

  if (statValue("energy").value <= p.energy) { return "Needs more than " + p.energy + "% energy."; }
  if (p.lot && projectLot(p.lot) < 0) { return "Needs an uncommitted " + p.lot.toLowerCase() + " cargo lot."; }
  if (id === "oxygen" && LIFE.canisters + possibleCanisterReturns() >= LIFE.capacity) {

  if (id === "food" && (MESS.rack > MESS.capacity - 8 || findOngoing("cook"))) {

  if (id === "cooling" && (STATE.engineCondition >= 100 || maintRunning())) { return "The drive is sound or already under maintenance."; }
  if (id === "sensors" && (STATE.sim.insight < 1 || STATE.sim.sensor || findOngoing("scan"))) {

function projectButton(body, id) {

function startProject(e, id, selected) {
  var p = SHIP_PROJECTS[id], payload = null, pending, lot, task, first, second, i;
  if (!p || STATE.gameOver || projectBlock(id)) { return; }

TASK_TYPES.shipProject = {autoClear:true, quiet:true, onDone:function (t) {

  if (id === "fuel") { STATE.fuelCells++; text = "The reserve crew refined a fuel cell."; }

  if (id === "r6" || id === "r7") {

      '<div class="notice">A transfer loses five points in conversion. At zero energy, life support and powered work stop until power returns.</div>';
    if (id === "r6") {
      commandRow(body, "Divert 20 shields into 15 energy", statValue("shield").value >= 20 && statValue("energy").value <= 85, function (e) {
        commitChange(e, "Shields diverted to power", function () { clampStat("shield", -20); clampStat("energy", 15); });
      });
    } else {
      commandRow(body, "Divert 20 energy into 15 shields", statValue("energy").value >= 20 && statValue("shield").value <= 85, function (e) {
        commitChange(e, "Power diverted to shields", function () { clampStat("energy", -20); clampStat("shield", 15); });
      });
    }
    return;
  }
  if (id === "r12") {
    var sys = currentSystem(), history = WORLD_HISTORY[sys.region];
    body.innerHTML = field("Location", findById(BODIES, MAP.here).name) + field("Region", findById(GALAXY_BODIES, sys.region).name) +
      field("History", history[0]) + '<div class="notice">Each location can produce one 65-shiplet observation for the Science Room.</div>';
  } else {
    var details = field("Energy", statValue("energy").value + "%");
    if (id === "r2") { details += field("Repair kits", STATE.repairKits) + field("Salvage lots", countProjectLots("Salvage")); }
    if (id === "r3") { details += field("Insight", STATE.sim.insight) + field("Calibration", STATE.sim.sensor ? "Stored" : "None") +
      field("Next scan", simScanCost() + " work actions"); }
    if (id === "r5") { details += field("Drive", STATE.engineCondition + "%") + field("Maintenance", maintRunning() ? "In progress" : "Available"); }
    if (id === "r8") { details += field("Rations", MESS.rack + " / " + MESS.capacity) + field("Produce lots", countProjectLots("Perishable")); }
    if (id === "r9") { details += field("O2 canisters", LIFE.canisters + " / " + LIFE.capacity) + field("Salvage lots", countProjectLots("Salvage")); }
    if (id === "r10") { details += field("Fuel cells", STATE.fuelCells) + field("Salvage lots", countProjectLots("Salvage")); }
    if (id === "r11") { details += field("Hull", statValue("hull").value + "%") + field("Salvage lots", countProjectLots("Salvage")); }
    body.innerHTML = details + '<div class="notice">Inputs are consumed at the start. Work advances through actions elsewhere and pauses without power.</div>';
  }
  for (p in SHIP_PROJECTS) { if (SHIP_PROJECTS.hasOwnProperty(p) && SHIP_PROJECTS[p].room === id) { projectButton(body, p); } }
}
function countProjectLots(kind) {
  var i, n = 0;
  for (i = 0; i < GOODS.length; i++) { if (GOODS[i].kind === kind && !GOODS[i].contractId && !GOODS[i].risk) { n++; } }
  return n;
}
function simOnScan(b, first) {
  if (first) { simRemember("Discovery", "The crew scanned " + b.name + "."); }
  if (b.id === "halvan" && STATE.sim.signal === "dormant") {
    STATE.sim.signal = "intercepted"; simRemember("Signal", "An old relay at Halvan's Reach repeats a name.");
    logLine("An unusual signal was intercepted. Open the Comms Relay.");
  }
  if (b.id === "echo-site" && STATE.sim.signal === "coordinates") {
    STATE.sim.signal = "request"; simRemember("Signal", "The Choir Array carries a request from Silicon Marrow.");
    logLine("The Choir Array answered. Open the Comms Relay.");
  }
}
function simScanCost() { return Math.max(1, SCAN_COST - (STATE.sim.sensor ? 2 : 0)); }
function migrateSimSave() {
  var i, t, seen = {}, tabs = [], c;
  fitRooms(ROOMS);
  if (!STATE.sim) {
    STATE.sim = newSimState();
    if (STATE.scanned.halvan) { STATE.sim.signal = "intercepted"; simRemember("Signal", "An old relay at Halvan's Reach repeats a name."); }
  }
  for (i = 0; i < CREW.length; i++) { c = CREW[i]; if (c.room === "test") { c.room = "simulacron"; } }
  for (i = 0; i < STATE.tabs.length; i++) {
    t = STATE.tabs[i];
    if (t.kind === "room" && t.id === "test") {
      t.id = "simulacron"; t.key = "room:simulacron"; t.title = "Simulacron Core"; t.kindLabel = "ROOM"; t.sub = ROOM_FITS.simulacron[1];
    }
    if (!seen[t.key]) { tabs.push(t); seen[t.key] = true; }
  }
  STATE.tabs = tabs;
  if (STATE.activeTab === "room:test") { STATE.activeTab = "room:simulacron"; }
  if (STATE.freshTabs["room:test"]) { STATE.freshTabs["room:simulacron"] = true; }
  delete STATE.freshTabs["room:test"];
  for (i = 0; i < EVENTS.length; i++) {
    if (EVENTS[i].type === "crew" && !EVENTS[i].a && CREW.length >= 2) {
      var pair = simDisputePair(); EVENTS[i].a = pair[0]; EVENTS[i].b = pair[1];
    }
  }
  if (typeof STATE.medkits === "undefined") { STATE.medkits = 2; }
}
function validDreamPart(p) {
  return typeof p === "string" || (saveObject(p) && typeof p.kind === "string" && typeof p.text === "string" &&
    typeof p.who === "string" && typeof p.other === "string");
}
function validSimSave(s, actions) {
  var i, k, m, ids = {}, max = 0;
  if (!saveObject(s) || s.version !== 1 || !saveNumber(s.serial) || s.serial % 1 ||
      !saveNumber(s.insight) || s.insight > 5 || s.insight % 1 || (s.sensor !== 0 && s.sensor !== 1) ||
      !/^(dormant|intercepted|decoding|coordinates|request|preserved|sold)$/.test(s.signal) ||
      !saveObject(s.bonds) || !saveObject(s.observed) || !saveObject(s.broadcasts) ||
      !saveArray(s.memories) || s.memories.length > 32 || !saveArray(s.dreams) || s.dreams.length > 6) { return false; }
  for (k in s.bonds) { if (s.bonds.hasOwnProperty(k) && (!/^[a-z0-9_-]+~[a-z0-9_-]+$/.test(k) ||
      typeof s.bonds[k] !== "number" || !isFinite(s.bonds[k]) || s.bonds[k] < -100 || s.bonds[k] > 100)) { return false; } }
  for (k in s.observed) { if (s.observed.hasOwnProperty(k) && (!findById(BODIES, k) || s.observed[k] !== true)) { return false; } }
  for (k in s.broadcasts) { if (s.broadcasts.hasOwnProperty(k) && (!findById(SECTOR_BODIES, k) || s.broadcasts[k] !== true)) { return false; } }
  for (i = 0; i < s.memories.length; i++) {
    m = s.memories[i];
    if (!m || !saveNumber(m.id) || !m.id || m.id % 1 || ids[m.id] || typeof m.kind !== "string" ||
        typeof m.text !== "string" || typeof m.who !== "string" || typeof m.other !== "string" ||
        typeof m.processed !== "boolean" || !saveNumber(m.at) || m.at > actions) { return false; }
    ids[m.id] = true; max = Math.max(max, m.id);
  }
  if (s.serial < max) { return false; }
  for (i = 0; i < s.dreams.length; i++) {
    m = s.dreams[i]; if (!m || typeof m.text !== "string" || !saveNumber(m.at) || m.at > actions) { return false; }
  }
  return true;
}


/* ================================================================
  SECTION N : INITIALISATION
  ================================================================ */

function init() {
  applyPreferences();
  try {
     window.resizeTo(1440, 940);
     window.moveTo(
        Math.max(0, Math.floor((screen.availWidth - 1440) / 2)),
        Math.max(0, Math.floor((screen.availHeight - 940) / 2))
     );
  } catch (err) { /* window ops can fail if the host blocks them */ }

  document.oncontextmenu = function () { return false; };

  /* the layout follows the window from here on */
  window.onresize = onWindowResize;
  on($("tab-left"), "click", function () { $("taskbar").scrollLeft -= 220; });
  on($("tab-right"), "click", function () { $("taskbar").scrollLeft += 220; });
  on($("tab-home"), "click", function () { switchTab("home"); });

  /* the life support readout is the filter rack, not a slogan */
  findById(INFOS, "life").value = lifeSummary();

  buildSidePanel();

 buildSideFoot();
  renderTabs();
  buildIdleScreen();

  logLine("Command dashboard online. All primary systems reporting.");
  logLine("Rell Aventine assumed the bridge watch.");
    logLine("Jax Moreno logged a maintenance note: coolant line, port manifold.");
    logLine("Shield generator operating at 62%.");
    logLine("Suri Tal is preparing rations in the mess hall.");
    logLine("No contacts within scan range. Holding position at Kessler Drift.");
    logLine("Life support is on reserve. Seat three canisters and start the filter bank.");
    logLine("First contract: reach Tolme Anchorage. Right-click Navigation to plot a course.");

    setStatus();
    BOOT_SNAPSHOT = JSON.stringify(saveSnapshot());
    showTitleMenu(false);

    /* cosmetic only - see Section F */
    window.setInterval(driftTick, 55);
}

var WIKI_VIEW = {query:"", selected:"first-watch"};
function wikiMatches(entry, query) {
  return (entry.title + " " + entry.group + " " + entry.text).toLowerCase().indexOf(query.toLowerCase()) >= 0;
}
function buildWikiScreen(host) {
  var scr = contentScreen(host, "WIKI", "Ship's Handbook", "Search the offline handbook. Reading and navigation are free."),
    layout = make("div", "wiki-layout"), index = make("div", "wiki-index"), article = make("div", "wiki-article"),
    search = make("input", "wiki-search"), list = make("div", "wiki-list");
  search.type = "text"; search.placeholder = "Search the handbook"; search.value = WIKI_VIEW.query;
  search.setAttribute("aria-label", "Search the ship's handbook");
  index.appendChild(search); index.appendChild(list); layout.appendChild(index); layout.appendChild(article); scr.appendChild(layout);
  function draw() {
    var i, e, matches = [], selected = null, group = "", button;
    for (i = 0; i < WIKI.length; i++) { if (wikiMatches(WIKI[i], WIKI_VIEW.query)) { matches.push(WIKI[i]); } }
    for (i = 0; i < matches.length; i++) { if (matches[i].id === WIKI_VIEW.selected) { selected = matches[i]; } }
    if (!selected && matches.length) { selected = matches[0]; WIKI_VIEW.selected = selected.id; }
    clear(list); clear(article);
    if (!selected) { list.appendChild(make("div", "navnote", "No matching entries.")); return; }
    for (i = 0; i < matches.length; i++) {
      e = matches[i];
      if (e.group !== group) { group = e.group; list.appendChild(make("div", "wiki-group", simEscape(group))); }
      button = make("button", "wiki-link" + (e.id === selected.id ? " wiki-current" : ""), simEscape(e.title));
      button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", e.id === selected.id ? "true" : "false");
      (function (id, el) { on(el, "click", function () { WIKI_VIEW.selected = id; draw(); }); }(e.id, button));
      list.appendChild(button);
    }
    article.appendChild(make("div", "panel-head", simEscape(selected.group)));
    article.appendChild(make("h2", "wiki-title", simEscape(selected.title)));
    article.appendChild(make("p", "wiki-copy", simEscape(selected.text)));
    if (selected.link) {
      (function (entry) {
        commandRow(article, entry.linkLabel, true, function () {
          openTask(entry.link === "nav" ? "nav" : "room", entry.link === "nav" ? "main" : entry.link, true);
        }, "free");
      }(selected));
    }
  }
  function filter() { WIKI_VIEW.query = search.value; draw(); }
  on(search, "input", filter); on(search, "keyup", filter); on(search, "change", filter); draw();
}

function ownCount(map) { var k, n = 0; for (k in map) { if (map.hasOwnProperty(k) && map[k] === true) { n++; } } return n; }
function chronicleValue(key) {
  var i, n = 0, j = STATE.chronicle;
  if (key === "systems" || key === "regions") { return ownCount(j[key]); }
  if (key === "scans") {
    for (i = 0; i < BODIES.length; i++) { if (STATE.scanned[BODIES[i].id] === true) { n++; } }
    return n;
  }
  if (key === "contracts") {
    for (i = 0; i < CONTRACTS.length; i++) { if (STATE.contracts[CONTRACTS[i].id] === "complete") { n++; } }
    return n;
  }
  if (key === "commissions") { return STATE.commissions.completed; }
  if (key === "actions") { return actionCounter; }
  if (key === "berth") { return /^(ready|complete)$/.test(STATE.contracts.arrival || "") ? 1 : 0; }
  if (key === "signal") { return /^(preserved|sold)$/.test(STATE.sim.signal) ? 1 : 0; }

function chronicleVisit(sys) {

}
function checkCommendations(silent) {

  for (i = 0; i < COMMENDATIONS.length; i++) {
    a = COMMENDATIONS[i];
    if (!STATE.chronicle.earned[a.id] && chronicleValue(a.metric) >= a.goal) {
      STATE.chronicle.earned[a.id] = true; changed = true;
      if (!silent) { logLine("Commendation earned: " + a.title + ". Claim its reward in Rewards."); }
    }
  }
  if (changed && !silent) { buildSideFoot(); }
}
function readyCommendations() {
  var i, n = 0, j = STATE.chronicle;

  return n;
}

}
function rewardText(r) {
  var out = [];

  if (r.fuel) { out.push(r.fuel + " fuel cell" + (r.fuel === 1 ? "" : "s")); }
  if (r.kits) { out.push(r.kits + " repair kit" + (r.kits === 1 ? "" : "s")); }
  if (r.med) { out.push(r.med + " medkit" + (r.med === 1 ? "" : "s")); }

}
function claimCommendation(id) {

  j.claimed[id] = true; r = a.reward;

  STATE.repairKits += r.kits || 0; STATE.medkits += r.med || 0;
  logLine("Reward claimed: " + a.title + " - " + rewardText(r) + ".");
  paintResources(); buildSideFoot();
  if (STATE.activeTab === "awards:main" && host) { switchTab(STATE.activeTab); host.scrollTop = scroll; }
  return true;
}
function buildAwardsScreen(host) {
  var scr = contentScreen(host, "LOGBOOK", "Commendations & Rewards", "Progress is earned through play; claiming a reward is free and can be done once."),
    summary = contentPanel(scr, "Captain's log"), grid = make("div", "award-grid"), i, a, card, status, barEl, button, amount;
  summary.className += " awards-summary";
  summary.innerHTML = field("Rank", captainRank() + " (cosmetic)") + field("Commendations", ownCount(STATE.chronicle.earned) + " / " + COMMENDATIONS.length) +
    field("Unclaimed rewards", readyCommendations()) + field("Systems / regions visited", ownCount(STATE.chronicle.systems) + " / " + ownCount(STATE.chronicle.regions)) +
    field("Unique deep scans", chronicleValue("scans")) + field("Completed commissions", STATE.commissions.completed);
  for (i = 0; i < COMMENDATIONS.length; i++) {
    a = COMMENDATIONS[i]; amount = Math.min(a.goal, chronicleValue(a.metric));
    status = STATE.chronicle.claimed[a.id] ? "Claimed" : (STATE.chronicle.earned[a.id] ? "Ready to claim" : amount + " / " + a.goal);
    card = make("div", "award-card");
    card.appendChild(make("div", "award-title", simEscape(a.title) + '<span class="award-status">' + status + '</span>'));
    card.appendChild(make("div", "award-detail", simEscape(a.detail)));
    barEl = make("div", "award-track", '<div class="award-fill" style="width:' + Math.round(100 * amount / a.goal) + '%;"></div>');
    barEl.setAttribute("aria-label", "Progress " + amount + " of " + a.goal); card.appendChild(barEl);
    button = make("button", "award-claim", STATE.chronicle.claimed[a.id] ? "Reward claimed" : "Claim " + rewardText(a.reward));
    button.disabled = !STATE.chronicle.earned[a.id] || !!STATE.chronicle.claimed[a.id] || !!STATE.gameOver;
    (function (id, el) { on(el, "click", function () { claimCommendation(id); }); }(a.id, button));
    card.appendChild(button); grid.appendChild(card);
  }
  scr.appendChild(grid);
}

/* The offer is deterministic for a port and a serial. It remains
   fixed in the save once accepted, and pays only after collection. */
function commissionGoal(kind) { return kind === "salvage" ? 2 : 1; }
function commissionPrice(kind) { return kind === "visit" ? 450 : (kind === "scan" ? 550 : (kind === "salvage" ? 240 : 0)); }
function commissionOffer(kind) {
  var here = currentSystem(), local = [], fresh = [], all = [], i, b, sys, hash = 0, pool;
  var originRegion, candidateRegion, nearest, bestDistance, distance;
  if (!STATE.docked || !PORTS[MAP.here] || !commissionPrice(kind)) { return null; }
  if (kind === "salvage") { return {kind:kind, origin:MAP.here, target:"", progress:0, reward:commissionPrice(kind)}; }
  for (i = 0; i < BODIES.length; i++) {
    b = BODIES[i]; sys = findById(SECTOR_BODIES, bodySystem(b));
    if (!sys || (kind === "visit" && (!PORTS[b.id] || b.id === MAP.here)) ||
        (kind === "scan" && (sys.id === here.id || b.type === "origin"))) { continue; }
    all.push(b);
    if (sys.region === here.region) {
      local.push(b); if (kind === "scan" && !STATE.scanned[b.id]) { fresh.push(b); }
    }
  }
  /* A region with only two ports needs a nearby alternative if
     the player rotates a visit offer, rather than the same route forever. */
  if (kind === "visit" && local.length < 2) {
    originRegion = findById(GALAXY_BODIES, here.region);
    while (local.length < 2 && local.length < all.length) {
      nearest = null; bestDistance = Infinity;
      for (i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
        b = all[i]; if (local.indexOf(b) >= 0) { continue; }
        sys = findById(SECTOR_BODIES, bodySystem(b)); candidateRegion = findById(GALAXY_BODIES, sys.region);
        distance = Math.pow(originRegion.x - candidateRegion.x, 2) + Math.pow(originRegion.y - candidateRegion.y, 2);
        if (distance < bestDistance) { nearest = b; bestDistance = distance; }
      }
      if (!nearest) { break; }
      local.push(nearest);
    }
  }
  pool = fresh.length ? fresh : (local.length ? local : all);
  if (!pool.length) { return null; }
  for (i = 0; i < MAP.here.length; i++) { hash += MAP.here.charCodeAt(i) * (i + 1); }
  b = pool[(hash + STATE.commissions.serial) % pool.length];
  return {kind:kind, origin:MAP.here, target:b.id, progress:0, reward:commissionPrice(kind)};
}
function commissionDescription(c) {
  var b = findById(BODIES, c.target), sys = b && findById(SECTOR_BODIES, bodySystem(b));
  var where = sys ? " (" + sys.name + ", " + findById(GALAXY_BODIES, sys.region).name + ")" : "";
  if (c.kind === "visit") { return "Visit " + b.name + where; }
  if (c.kind === "scan") { return "Read a deep scan of " + b.name + where; }
  return "Recover two salvage lots while under way";
}
function acceptCommission(e, kind) {
  var offer = commissionOffer(kind);
  if (!offer || STATE.gameOver || STATE.commissions.active) { return; }
  commitChange(e, "Commission accepted", function () { STATE.commissions.active = offer; });
}
function commissionProgress(kind, target) {
  var c = STATE.commissions.active;
  if (!c || c.kind !== kind || c.progress >= commissionGoal(kind) || (kind !== "salvage" && c.target !== target)) { return; }
  c.progress++;
  if (c.progress === commissionGoal(kind)) {
    simRemember("Work", "The crew completed a commission: " + commissionDescription(c) + ".");
    logLine("Commission objective complete. Collect at any station.");
  }
  buildSidePanel();
}
function collectCommission(e) {
  var c = STATE.commissions.active;
  if (!c || !STATE.docked || !PORTS[MAP.here] || c.progress < commissionGoal(c.kind) || STATE.gameOver) { return; }
  commitChange(e, "Commission paid", function () {
    STATE.shiplets += c.reward; STATE.commissions.completed++; STATE.commissions.serial++; STATE.commissions.active = null;
  });
}
function abandonCommission(e) {
  if (!STATE.commissions.active || !STATE.docked || !PORTS[MAP.here] || STATE.gameOver ||
      !confirmRisk("Abandon this commission? The reward will be lost.")) { return; }
  commitChange(e, "Commission abandoned", function () { STATE.commissions.serial++; STATE.commissions.active = null; });
}
function buildCommissionBoard(body) {
  var c = STATE.commissions.active, kinds = ["visit", "scan", "salvage"], i, offer;
  body.appendChild(make("div", "cq-sub", "Repeatable commissions"));
  if (c) {
    body.appendChild(make("div", "notice", simEscape(commissionDescription(c)) + " - " + c.progress + " / " + commissionGoal(c.kind) +
      ". Payment: " + c.reward + " sh at any station."));
    commandRow(body, "Collect commission - " + c.reward + " sh", c.progress >= commissionGoal(c.kind), collectCommission);
    commandRow(body, "Abandon commission and rotate offers", true, abandonCommission);
  } else {
    body.appendChild(make("div", "navnote", "Choose one commission. Objectives begin after acceptance; offers rotate after collection or abandonment."));
    for (i = 0; i < kinds.length; i++) {
      offer = commissionOffer(kinds[i]); if (!offer) { continue; }
      (function (o) { commandRow(body, "Accept: " + simEscape(commissionDescription(o)) + " - " + o.reward + " sh", true,
        function (e) { acceptCommission(e, o.kind); }); }(offer));
    }
  }
}

function validGameOptions(o) {
  if (!saveObject(o) || typeof o.largeText !== "boolean" || typeof o.confirmRisk !== "boolean" || typeof o.hideCrewLabels !== "boolean") { return false; }
  if (o.theme !== undefined && (typeof o.theme !== "string" || !THEMES.hasOwnProperty(o.theme))) { return false; }
  if (o.soundEffects !== undefined && typeof o.soundEffects !== "boolean") { return false; }
  if (o.music !== undefined && typeof o.music !== "boolean") { return false; }
  if (o.audioLevel !== undefined && (typeof o.audioLevel !== "number" || !isFinite(o.audioLevel) || o.audioLevel < 0 || o.audioLevel > 1)) { return false; }
  return true;
}
function validChronicle(j) {
  var i, k, fields = ["banks", "projects", "dreams", "meals", "incidents"];
  if (!saveObject(j) || j.version !== 1 || !saveObject(j.systems) || !saveObject(j.regions) || !saveObject(j.earned) || !saveObject(j.claimed)) { return false; }
  for (i = 0; i < fields.length; i++) { if (!saveNumber(j[fields[i]]) || j[fields[i]] % 1) { return false; } }
  for (k in j.systems) { if (j.systems.hasOwnProperty(k) && (j.systems[k] !== true || !findById(SECTOR_BODIES, k))) { return false; } }
  for (k in j.regions) { if (j.regions.hasOwnProperty(k) && (j.regions[k] !== true || !findById(GALAXY_BODIES, k))) { return false; } }
  for (k in j.earned) { if (j.earned.hasOwnProperty(k) && (j.earned[k] !== true || !findById(COMMENDATIONS, k))) { return false; } }
  for (k in j.claimed) { if (j.claimed.hasOwnProperty(k) && (j.claimed[k] !== true || !j.earned[k] || !findById(COMMENDATIONS, k))) { return false; } }
  return true;
}
function validCommissions(c) {
  var a, b;
  if (!saveObject(c) || c.version !== 1 || !saveNumber(c.serial) || c.serial % 1 || !saveNumber(c.completed) ||
      c.completed % 1 || c.completed > c.serial) { return false; }
  a = c.active; if (a === null) { return true; }
  if (!saveObject(a) || !commissionPrice(a.kind) || a.reward !== commissionPrice(a.kind) ||
      typeof a.origin !== "string" || !PORTS.hasOwnProperty(a.origin) || !findById(BODIES, a.origin) ||
      typeof a.target !== "string" || !saveNumber(a.progress) || a.progress % 1 || a.progress > commissionGoal(a.kind)) { return false; }
  b = findById(BODIES, a.target);
  if (a.kind === "visit") { return !!b && PORTS.hasOwnProperty(a.target) && a.target !== a.origin; }
  if (a.kind === "scan") { return !!b && b.type !== "origin"; }
  return a.target === "";
}
function migrateProgression() {
  var old = !STATE.chronicle, k, b, sys, defaults = newGameOptions();
  if (!STATE.actionCooldowns || !saveObject(STATE.actionCooldowns)) { STATE.actionCooldowns = {}; }
  if (!STATE.options) { STATE.options = defaults; }
  /* Preserve preferences in pre-expansion save files while filling in
     the new presentation and audio controls. */
  if (STATE.options.theme === undefined) { STATE.options.theme = defaults.theme; }
  if (STATE.options.soundEffects === undefined) { STATE.options.soundEffects = defaults.soundEffects; }
  if (STATE.options.music === undefined) { STATE.options.music = defaults.music; }
  if (STATE.options.audioLevel === undefined) { STATE.options.audioLevel = defaults.audioLevel; }
  if (!STATE.commissions) { STATE.commissions = newCommissions(); }
  if (old) {
    STATE.chronicle = newChronicle();
    if (STATE.filterLife > 0) { STATE.chronicle.banks = 1; }
    STATE.chronicle.dreams = STATE.sim.dreams.length;
    for (k in STATE.scanned) {
      if (!STATE.scanned.hasOwnProperty(k) || STATE.scanned[k] !== true) { continue; }
      b = findById(BODIES, k); sys = b && findById(SECTOR_BODIES, bodySystem(b)); chronicleVisit(sys);
    }
    for (k in STATE.sim.observed) {
      if (!STATE.sim.observed.hasOwnProperty(k)) { continue; }
      b = findById(BODIES, k); sys = b && findById(SECTOR_BODIES, bodySystem(b)); chronicleVisit(sys);
    }
  }
  chronicleVisit(currentSystem());
  checkCommendations(true);
}
chronicleVisit(currentSystem());


/* ================================================================
  TITLE MENU AND NEW VOYAGES
  The menu pauses no clock because the game only advances on actions.
  Its image is embedded; loading uses the same validated save path.
  ================================================================ */
var BOOT_SNAPSHOT = "", TITLE_FROM_VOYAGE = false;
function removeFloatingPopups() {
  var pops = document.querySelectorAll ? document.querySelectorAll(".pop") : [], i;
  for (i = 0; i < pops.length; i++) { if (pops[i].parentNode) { pops[i].parentNode.removeChild(pops[i]); } }
}
function restartVoyage() {
  if (!BOOT_SNAPSHOT) { return; }
  var options = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(STATE.options)), motion = STATE.reducedMotion;
  removeFloatingPopups();
  while (MARKS.length) { retireMark(MARKS[0]); }
  O2_CLAIM = false; MAINT_CLAIM = false; COOK_CLAIM = false; PROJECT_CLAIM = ""; CREW_CLAIMS = {};
  DRAG.on = false;
  WIKI_VIEW.query = ""; WIKI_VIEW.selected = "first-watch";
  applySnapshot(JSON.parse(BOOT_SNAPSHOT));
  STATE.options = options; STATE.reducedMotion = motion;
  redrawAfterLoad();
}
function layoutTitle() {
  var card = $("title-card"), w, h, ratio = 1672 / 941;
  if (!card) { return; }
  w = Math.max(1, document.documentElement.clientWidth - 24);
  h = Math.max(1, document.documentElement.clientHeight - 24);
  if (w > 1672) { w = 1672; }
  if (w / ratio > h) { w = h * ratio; }
  card.style.width = Math.round(w) + "px"; card.style.height = Math.round(w / ratio) + "px";
  card.style.left = Math.round((document.documentElement.clientWidth - w) / 2) + "px";
  card.style.top = Math.round((document.documentElement.clientHeight - w / ratio) / 2) + "px";
}
function hideTitleMenu() {
  var title = $("title-screen");
  if (title) { title.parentNode.removeChild(title); }
  $("game-shell").style.display = "block";
  startAudioFromGesture(); /* browser autoplay is only attempted from the player's menu click */
  switchTab(STATE.activeTab); /* layout was measured while the dashboard was hidden */
}
function titleBack() {
  $("title-dialog").style.display = "none";
  $("title-load").focus();
}
function titlePanel(html) {
  var panel = $("title-dialog");
  panel.innerHTML = html + '<button type="button" class="title-button title-secondary" id="title-back">BACK</button>';
  panel.style.display = "block";
  on($("title-back"), "click", titleBack);
}
function titleLoadPanel() {
  titlePanel('<h2>Load a voyage</h2><p>Choose one of your three independent save slots. Slot 1 also reads the original save.</p>' +
    '<label for="title-slot">Save slot</label><select id="title-slot"><option value="1">Slot 1 (original)</option>' +
    '<option value="2">Slot 2</option><option value="3">Slot 3</option></select>' +
    '<div id="title-message" class="title-error" role="status"></div>' +
    '<button type="button" class="title-button" id="title-restore">LOAD VOYAGE</button>');
  on($("title-restore"), "click", function () {
    if (TITLE_FROM_VOYAGE && (typeof window.confirm !== "function" ||
        !window.confirm("Load this slot? Unsaved progress in the current voyage will be lost."))) { return; }
    var result = loadGame($("title-slot").value), message = $("title-message");
    if (result === "Saved voyage restored.") { hideTitleMenu(); }
    else if (message.textContent !== undefined) { message.textContent = result; }
    else { message.innerText = result; }
  });
  $("title-slot").focus();
}
function titleSettingsPanel() {
  titlePanel('<h2>Options</h2>' + popupSpec("settings").html);
  wireSettings(); $("settings-motion").focus();
}
function titleGuidePanel() {
  titlePanel('<h2>Your first watch</h2><p>Start aboard a compact Wren courier. Every committed action advances the voyage; reading, opening tabs and plotting targets are free.</p>' +
    '<p>Right-click Navigation and travel to Tolme Anchorage. Stand watch there to advance work when needed. Seat three O2 canisters and start the filter bank. At a station, use the Docked indicator to trade, accept work and visit the shipyard.</p>' +
    '<p>The larger Kestrel ship costs 4,000 shiplets. Your crew, cargo, equipment, tasks and records transfer when you buy it. Open Wiki on the ship for the full handbook.</p>');
  $("title-back").focus();
}
function showTitleMenu(fromVoyage) {
  var old = $("title-screen"), title;
  if (old) { old.parentNode.removeChild(old); }
  removeFloatingPopups(); TITLE_FROM_VOYAGE = !!fromVoyage;
  $("game-shell").style.display = "none";
  title = make("div", "", '<h1 id="title-heading" class="title-sr">Spaceship</h1>' +
    '<div id="title-card"><nav id="title-actions" aria-label="Main menu">' +
    '<button type="button" id="title-start">NEW VOYAGE</button>' +
    '<button type="button" id="title-load">LOAD VOYAGE</button>' +
    '<button type="button" id="title-options">OPTIONS</button>' +
    '<button type="button" id="title-guide">HOW TO PLAY</button>' +
    '<button type="button" id="title-resume">' + (fromVoyage ? 'RESUME' : 'EXIT') + '</button>' +
    '</nav></div><div id="title-dialog" role="dialog" aria-label="Menu details"></div>');
  title.id = "title-screen"; title.setAttribute("role", "dialog");
  title.setAttribute("aria-modal", "true"); title.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", "title-heading");
  document.body.appendChild(title); layoutTitle();
  on($("title-start"), "click", function () {
    if (TITLE_FROM_VOYAGE) {
      if (typeof window.confirm !== "function" || !window.confirm("Start a new voyage? Unsaved progress will be lost; saved slots are kept.")) { return; }
      restartVoyage();
    }
    hideTitleMenu();
  });
  on($("title-load"), "click", titleLoadPanel);
  on($("title-options"), "click", titleSettingsPanel);
  on($("title-guide"), "click", titleGuidePanel);
  on($("title-resume"), "click", function () {
    if (TITLE_FROM_VOYAGE) { hideTitleMenu(); }
    else if (window.location.protocol === "file:" && typeof ActiveXObject !== "undefined") { window.close(); }
    else { titlePanel('<h2>Leaving the game</h2><p>Close this browser tab to exit the preview.</p>'); }
  });
  $("title-start").focus();
}

window.onload = init;

</script>
</body>
</html>
